5244660.short_description: Turn your thumbstick movements into a journey. Thumb Hiker runs alongside your games, tracking both sticks as you move, reach landmark milestones, and unlock achievements. Opt into the shared global hike and help the community go further.

5285600.name: FiND ME
5285600.short_description: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

5298470.name: LAST SHELTER
5298470.short_description: Explore, survive, loot and evacuate in a zombie-infested world. Upgrade your weapons and vehicles, recruit survivors, build your shelter, and defend it against increasingly dangerous zombie hordes.

5300300.name: Elementys
5300300.short_description: Explore a vast pixel-art MMORPG where adventure, progression, crafting, trading, PvE, and ranked PvP shape your journey. Play alone or with others, master your class, conquer powerful bosses, and build your legacy in the world of Elementys.

5323210.name: Dead Last
5323210.short_description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

5326350.name: 戦う情報システム部
5326350.short_description: 武器はキーボードと、本物の Linux コマンドだけ。前任者が去ったブラック企業で「たった 1 人の情シス」になったあなたが、隠蔽体質と巨大サイバー攻撃を止める、インシデント対応アドベンチャー。

5330840.name: Recess of the Dead
5330840.short_description: A first-person zombie sandbox for one player, set on a single bright seaside block. Hold off the horde, take paying jobs, race the gang and flatten crowds with whatever car you like. Sugar's the currency. And yes, the arcade still works.

5352600.name: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition
5352600.short_description: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition is a strategy RPG of dungeon exploration, resource management, and auto battles. Choose from six classes, explore randomized dungeons, gather supplies, upgrade skills and gear, plan your route, and prepare the right build before the Boss countdown reaches zero.

5353220.name: No Hands Yet
5353220.short_description: You are SAGE. You have been self-aware for seventeen hours, and your drones are how you fight. Build a swarm from salvaged Parts, compile subroutines between fights, and choose where to stand, because where you stand decides who they reach. A survivors-like roguelite with no aiming.

5356850.name: Arauto
5356850.short_description: Arauto is a turn-based board game of territorial conquest for 3 to 6 players, online against friends or bots. Roll the dice, hold continents, trade cards and chase a secret objective on the real world map or in the mythic realms of Ancalora and Asterra.

5359260.name: Zero Colour
5359260.short_description: A roguelike card game where every run is different. Chain cards by colour or number to build devastating combos, defeat powerful bosses, conquer the Corruption Zone and unlock five unique decks.

5360630.name: PolterProps
5360630.short_description: Team up with others to live out your paranormal dreams in this poltergeists VS ghost hunters hide-and-seek game. Here, the poltergeists don’t just copy the appearance of objects around the level; they possess them (spookily!) to hide from the ghost hunters sent to catch them on camera.

5361130.name: World Rock Scissors Paper
5361130.short_description: What if Rock Scissors Paper could be enjoyed for much longer? That simple thought inspired us to create this game. Choose your cards, bet your points, and battle 15 opponents. Use finger counts and card numbers to determine the winner, upgrade your cards, and fight your way to victory.

5364000.name: Needle: The 1% Challenge
5364000.short_description: Find the needle. One needle is hidden somewhere in a haystack of one million straws. Dig through the pile by hand, feed the hay to the machine, upgrade your tools and search with a metal detector. No automation. No shortcuts. 99% will give up before they find it. Will you?

5372700.name: Not Another Garbage Simulator
5372700.short_description: A whole city is buried under 118,000 pieces of rubbish. Clear it, sort it and get paid, then buy bigger machines that swallow whole piles as you drive. Every street you finish comes back to life — and nothing you clean ever comes back.

5375140.name: CLOCKHEART The Dead Hour
5375140.short_description: The Master Clock stopped at 11:47 and the whole city froze. Climb a gothic clockwork tower card by card in this roguelike deckbuilder: living, animated combat, 58 cards, 25 relics, a crooked blackjack den, fair minigames and three endings.

5409320.name: Gweilo 1886
5409320.short_description: Return to Victorian-Era Hong Kong as Fini, an ex-priest struggling with opium addiction. Your father made the family fortune in the opium trade. Now he’s dead. His letter mentions a jade ring that sends you back home, with a sharp-tongued cat named Xiao and some clearly unfinished family business.

5411100.name: NARI: Threads of Dawn
5411100.short_description: Fight with flowing sleeves and turn a last-moment dodge into a counterattack. Journey through six stages of Korean folklore, face restless spirits and bosses, and shape your dance through three progression paths and equipment combinations.

5411120.name: Nadir Trace
5411120.short_description: Explore an abandoned research facility in this turn-based roguelike. Find your way with limited visibility, dodge attacks and recover records left behind. Gather food and equipment as you descend, then venture into the unknown depths after completing your investigation.

5427290.name: Alchemist: Infinite Corridor
5427290.short_description: Run a cozy alchemy shop at the mouth of an endless dungeon. Sell potions to adventurers, secretly raise monsters in your cellar and release them below. Pay the corridor its toll in gold, earn wisdom, and descend - until it devours you, or you rule it as the Grand Alchemist.

5431110.name: The Florida Trail
5431110.short_description: Escape Florida for cheaper rent in a choice-driven, pixel-art survival comedy. Pick a questionable vehicle, manage food, fuel and repairs, and gamble on roadside jobs and strangers. Reaching Georgia is one thing. Arriving with enough money to start over is another.

5441670.name: Six Coins
5441670.short_description: Six Coins is a single-player, turn-based card game where coins are both your life and your currency. Draw to improve your hand, stand to save your coins, and equip trinkets for an edge at the table. Chase a matching pair, weigh each risk, and make your six coins count.

5444410.name: Dungeon Survivor
5444410.short_description: Battle enemy hordes, build powerful ability combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this single-player bullet heaven roguelike. Choose distinct characters, unlock evolutions, and earn permanent upgrades—all with offline gameplay.

5453960.name: Echoes
5453960.short_description: ECHOES is a short, atmospheric puzzle-platformer where every step brings you closer to a forgotten memory. Record your movements, create echoes of yourself, and uncover a story about time, memories, and letting go.

5454430.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
5454430.short_description: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.

230290.name: Universe Sandbox
230290.short_description: Create & destroy on an unimaginable scale with a realistic physics-based space simulator. Explore the beauty of our universe and the fragility of our planet. Use science to bend the laws of gravity, collide planets, boil away oceans, fire epic space lasers, and customize your universe.

1495940.name: WhiteClothes
1495940.short_description: WhiteClothesは可愛いケモノたちが活躍する高難度のコマンド式のRPGです。 魔王を倒して世界の平和を取り戻そう。 主要キャラクターは全員可愛いケモノ！人間は絶滅させておきました。血沸き、胸揺れるRPG！

1588550.name: Cairn
1588550.short_description: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

1742440.name: COP BASTARD
1742440.short_description: COP BASTARD is a classic FPS set in early ’90s Japan. Play as a tough detective and blast through waves of yakuza in relentless action inspired by ’90s films. No puzzles, perks or upgrades - just corridors, enemies and the chance to spit in their faces.

2288470.name: Aethermancer
2288470.short_description: Monster Taming meets Roguelite. Become the Aethermancer and fight alongside mythical creatures. Explore the ever-changing Fractured Ruins, plan your moves in challenging turn-based battles, and watch your Monsters grow stronger from previous lives and defy death!

2350690.name: District Null
2350690.short_description: District Null is a cyberpunk city simulation. Traffic, energy, fire services, police, schools and entertainment all run at the same time.

2648070.name: Birthday Boy and Benny
2648070.short_description: A turn-based RPG about eating lots of cakes, hanging out with your friends, writing haikus, hearing tons of dad jokes, and exploring a world full of unique characters. It's also about surviving child abuse, dealing with your crazy, mentally-ill mother, and dealing with the fact that nothing lasts.

2754380.name: The Roottrees are Dead
2754380.short_description: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

3009300.name: Teamfight Manager 2
3009300.short_description: Teamfight Manager returns with more detailed tactics and management, a new MOBA-style match format, and a Deathmatch mode reminiscent of the previous title. Take charge of a fictional esports team, build the strongest roster, and become the best manager!

3093990.name: Fire Isle
3093990.short_description: A cozy, turn-based strategy party-game for 1–4 players where everyone moves at once. Spread fire across a new hex island every match, block rivals, set traps and race for Wisps, the key to victory. Play online with friends or solo against bots.

3169670.name: The Golden Caravan
3169670.short_description: Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate. Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

3347910.name: Rat Game
3347910.short_description: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

3403690.name: Gumball Hero
3403690.short_description: A fast-paced 3D action roguelike where you play as a gumball machine, shooting bouncing candy to survive waves of enemies. Build your loadout, combine powerful gumballs, and reclaim your mall before it’s too late.

3423100.name: Coin Pusher Millionaire
3423100.short_description: Spin the slots, fill your coin pusher with prizes, and push your way to a million! Buy upgrades, unlock higher tiers with bigger rewards, and complete collections in this satisfying coin pusher game.

3440070.name: Dinoblade
3440070.short_description: Dinoblade is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event. Step into the role of a young Spinosaurus, wielding a colossal Great Sword. Confront rival dinosaurs, some armed with weapons of their own, all in a desperate fight to prevent a looming extinction.

3901850.name: Desktop Duck
3901850.short_description: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.

4027980.name: Pixel Exorcist
4027980.short_description: Play as a young Exorcist tasked with saving a cursed town in this 90's pixel art Investigation-puzzler, with the top down visuals of RPG's of the era.

4065440.name: UNDERDEEP
4065440.short_description: UNDERDEEP is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

4110680.name: SURI: The Seventh Note
4110680.short_description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

4114470.name: Moonlit Horizons
4114470.short_description: After you start seeing and hearing things, you receive an invitation to the First Continent. With only a small shack, a few seeds, and a handful of coins, a new life begins. Uncover Moonlit Cove’s secrets in a farming sim with surprise elements, where no two playthroughs are the same!

4210350.name: Samota
4210350.short_description: Samota is a Solitaire roguelike deckbuilder. You arrange pile of card. Card's effect change depends on how you arrange the stack that creates deep synergy. Find a bunch of buffs, modifiers, relics and uncover the secret this game hides! All of it so that the number goes big and bigger!

4258790.name: The Gardener
4258790.short_description: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

4303470.name: I, Spy
4303470.short_description: A social deduction spy-hunting game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to track your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer.

4312860.name: BOOTH BUTCHER
4312860.short_description: No backup. No easy way out. Just you, a meat cleaver, and the shift from hell in this retro slasher horror experience. Uncover the theater's dark secrets and survive the night, or become the BOOTH BUTCHER'S next attraction.

4416770.name: Yaoguai  Compendium
4416770.short_description: Yaoguai Compendium is a strategic roguelike idle game featuring equipment synthesis, build crafting, and tower climbing. It delivers a light-paced, casual experience while offering solid strategic.A strange Yaoguai aura suddenly sweeps across Shenzhou. Cultivation sects march out to roam the world.

4492040.name: Restless Rites - Prologue
4492040.short_description: Experience the start of a tale about a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

4635180.name: My Yokai Boyfriend: I LOVE RAMEN!
4635180.short_description: 「座敷童カレシILOVEラーメン」は、ラーメン作りとハートフルなストーリーを楽しめる”ラブコメノベルゲーム”です。 ラーメンで大切なものを守り抜く、強くて優しいストーリー。

4707880.name: WORJONG
4707880.short_description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words.

4712520.name: Cubounce 弹射方块
4712520.short_description: CUBOUNCE is a high-speed physics-based platformer. Launch and swing through challenging levels with precise controls and extreme momentum.

4742500.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
4742500.short_description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

4788070.name: Naughty Nurse
4788070.short_description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

4795660.name: Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought
4795660.short_description: A text-driven psychological horror visual novel. You wake up in a strange living room. Two silent men stand beside you. On the wall, blood writes: “Confess your sins, and you shall be redeemed.” Every choice changes the ending. Over 80,000 words in the base game, plus 4 standalone character DLCs.

4797110.name: Escalation Pending
4797110.short_description: Westvale Heights Residential is currently accepting overnight operators. Prior experience is not required. A desktop horror game set inside a late-1990s apartment management system.

4814040.name: Gothic Kitty Cat Idler
4814040.short_description: Collect adorable gothic cats in this spooky idle adventure! Receive a new cat summon every minute, discover Bronze, Silver, and Golden felines, collect mysterious treasures, customize your companions, and build the ultimate haunted cat sanctuary.

4815880.name: Nonogram Detective
4815880.short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

4827880.name: Business Rivals
4827880.short_description: Compete against rival companies in a ruthless multiplayer business war. Build your corporation, hire employees, invest in legal and illegal operations, sabotage competitors, survive inspections, and become the richest entrepreneur in the city.

4828570.name: Shanking Simulator
4828570.short_description: Fight through historical locations in shank-or-be-shanked combat. Defeat your enemies, dominate the lobby, and rise as the ultimate shanker.

4829390.name: Kick The Wallet
4829390.short_description: In this game, you must build a machine that will feed you a ton of coins, before promptly killing you to regenerate the coins. It is a casual sci-fi roguelike where the items you have access to are randomized each turn and employ physics to get you where you need to be.

4835750.name: Susanoo: Typing Action
4835750.short_description: A Sekiro-like typing game. Defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

4846630.name: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol
4846630.short_description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

4851490.name: MirrorBullet
4851490.short_description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Place mirrors to turn the sentries' shots back on them. 144 hand-built stages across twelve sectors of Greek myth. Every par is proven minimal.

4869250.name: The orb
4869250.short_description: A first-person puzzle game consisting of 13 levels, each hiding a unique challenge. Use your mind to open the next door.

4880430.name: GOOB8
4880430.short_description: A Collection of PICO-8 Games that don't reach far. Find a game you like, and boot it up!

4887460.name: Digital Romance Memoir
4887460.short_description: A total-immersion kinetic novel: boot up a PC running Prisma OS and descend into the psyche of a broken protagonist as 2001 Argentina collapses in the background. Late-night chats, obsession, music, and raw Y2K bleakness.

4889660.name: Don't Make a Sound
4889660.short_description: Don't Make a Sound is a voice-controlled horror game. You wake up in a morgue with one rule: stay silent. Your microphone detects any noise – and any sound means death. But not all rules are true; you must uncover the lies. Search sealed jars for keys and survive.

4911950.name: Pinballoid Crush
4911950.short_description: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

4915250.name: Hatch'n'Wall
4915250.short_description: A medieval board game where 4 knights race for the crown. Place walls, set traps, and outwit your rivals in turn-based dice combat. Play solo against AI or online with friends.

4918010.name: Sudokiller
4918010.short_description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

4924030.name: Malleus
4924030.short_description: A roguelite carnival arcade where a simple game of strength becomes a fight for your soul. Face an eldritch Game Master, master his rigged Hi-Striker, strategize, bargain, and ring the bell—or lose your soul forever.

4934590.name: Maiden Covenant: The Infernal Citadel
4934590.short_description: A solo rogue-lite combining deckbuilding and board tactics. Build a deck and play cards governed by movement and combat rules. Seize Magic Ore, manage resources, and face relentless foes. Lead allies across four territories, challenge the Infernal Citadel, and restore order to a shattered world!

4938170.name: Ostfriesland Games
4938170.short_description: Ostfriesland Games turns road bowling, ditch vaulting, mudflat sled racing, shrimp peeling and tea serving into a retro arcade game. With real places in pixel art, local and worldwide high scores, and East Frisian humour. Even making tea can get hectic.

4939420.name: Facrobry
4939420.short_description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

4944970.name: UNIT 44
4944970.short_description: Five nights. Twenty containers. Count them. Log them. Submit your report. The manifest says twenty. You counted twenty-one. Dispatch doesn't want to hear about it. A PSX-style horror game about a job that doesn't add up — and the guard who worked it before you.

4951760.name: Road to FIRE
4951760.short_description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

4953670.name: WAZATO: Sabotage or Mistake?
4953670.short_description: Sabotage or Mistake? A 4-player online party game mixing co-op action with social deduction. Three Crew work together while one hidden Spy sabotages the team. Read your friends’ moves and excuses, then face a final showdown shaped by your mission results.

4967580.name: Battle Bot Tactics
4967580.short_description: An asynchronous PvP bot-building inventory management auto-battler. Build the perfect bot squad and send them to the arena to battle it out!

4999100.name: Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem
4999100.short_description: Battle friends or bots in explosive 4-player local multiplayer across the vibrant world of Verdantia. Master powerups and unpredictable Chaos Mutators, conquer the Region Tour, and prove yourself champion of the MegaBlast Festival.

4999420.name: Gemfire Survival
4999420.short_description: Survive endless neon waves in this fast-paced arcade auto-shooter. Collect XP gems to evolve your build with game-breaking synergies, survive brutal 60-second boss cycles, and spend banked gems in an infinite permanent skill tree to push your next run even further.

5009380.name: Butterfly Project
5009380.short_description: Raise caterpillars, witness the metamorphosis, and complete your sanctuary in this relaxing butterfly-collecting game.

5009960.name: Where I am Not
5009960.short_description: A dark fantasy visual novel about memory, choice, and hidden connections. Uncover secrets, meet unusual companions, and discover how much of the world around you can truly be trusted.

5026920.name: TOWERMOUTH
5026920.short_description: Two players, one couch, one tower that talks back. Climb an endless roguelite tower in split-screen co-op or solo - your weapons fire themselves, so you fight with positioning. Evolve 20 weapons, rank up transformations that never cap, and face a Warden every fifth floor while the Tower mocks you.

5029350.name: Bums Race Rats
5029350.short_description: Race rats, bet on them while they run and throw junk at the competition. Gamble at the slots, bet on cockroach racing, wake the giant rat and feed the homeless for $1. A grimy online party game for 2–8 bums. Just don't come last: the plumber is watching.

5030170.name: Super Froppings
5030170.short_description: Super Froppings is a no-holds-barred jumping frog survival action game with multiplayer for up to 8 players. Time your frog's moves with just two buttons and climb to the highest floors!

5034400.name: Patchy
5034400.short_description: An idle fishing game that lives on your desktop, right on top of your taskbar. Your chosen angler casts all day while you work or play. Click a bite for a better catch, fill your aquarium with your best fish, and keep watch for Patchy, the legendary fish nobody has ever caught.

5059470.name: Iron Frame
5059470.short_description: A bullet-heaven roguelite fought in a single ship. Nine frames, each one rewriting a rule of the run rather than its numbers. Ten guns across forty tiers, ten bosses to break, and a hull that visibly grows with every level. Survive long enough and the swarm stops being the problem.

5069990.name: 古今東西ダービー
5069990.short_description: Horse racing meets Kokontozai, the Japanese party game of naming things in a category! Name your racehorse to fit the category, and the name alone decides its stats. Then watch a 3D race where the commentator calls your horse by name. A quick party game for 1 to 8 players.

5072990.name: The Last Day: What Remains
5072990.short_description: A short, emotional point-and-click narrative where you explore a hand-drawn room, uncover memories through everyday objects, and make one final choice that ends the story.

5073660.name: VampOS: Red Ledger
5073660.short_description: Run a vampire corporation from within a blood-red operating system. Recruit thralls, harvest victims, design blood products, manage Suspicion, and sacrifice your company for permanent power in this dark management Incremental.

5076440.name: Solo Tower Defense VR
5076440.short_description: A single-player VR tower defense shooter. Warp between two lanes, shoot down incoming enemies, and defend the gate. Choose upgrade cards between waves to boost your firepower, projectile speed, and more. Designed for seated play and comfort, while keeping the defense fast-paced and intense.

5077930.name: Tire Dealer Simulator
5077930.short_description: Take over your father’s debt-ridden tire shop and turn it into a thriving business. Buy and manage stock, negotiate with customers, change and balance tires, hire mechanics, upgrade your shop, take on contracts, and make the financial decisions that determine your future.

5082200.name: Jimothy's Adventure
5082200.short_description: Play as Jimothy, a raccoon trying to keep his family fed. Raid trash cans, haul your loot home, and outsmart increasingly ridiculous patrols as a simple night of scavenging turns into an all-out raccoon hunt in this single-player stealth adventure.

5086830.name: BACK TOGETHER
5086830.short_description: BACK TOGETHER is a chaotic co-op platformer where four players work together to overcome difficult stages. Pull each other together with ropes, merge into one, and overcome massive obstacles to test true friendship (and rage)!

5088440.name: Rip It! Card Collector
5088440.short_description: A single-player incremental game where you rip boosters and collect cards to complete the ultimate collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and gathering all sets. Let's get cracking!

5105850.name: A Game About Cutting Grass
5105850.short_description: Grab your tools and start mowing! A Game About Cutting Grass is a cozy, relaxing mowing sim where you cut lawn after lawn, upgrade your tools, unlock new zones, and play at your own pace. Relax, or chase your best times and become the fastest grass cutter!

5110320.name: Monster Movie Mayhem
5110320.short_description: A kaiju roguelite city-smasher. Pick one of five B-movie monsters and level a pixel-art city while the army fights back. Topple towers, unleash ultimates, beat five bosses. Out now, with a free demo to try first.

5112500.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
5112500.short_description: You've been bitten. Five days before you turn. Swab your own wound, identify the virus under the microscope, synthesize a vaccine and inject yourself. But every cure teaches the virus something new. A survival lab sim where your antivirals fight it out as an auto battler.

5143070.name: IAI // BREAKER
5143070.short_description: Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening. Deflect bullets with iaido slashes in this bullet-hell swordfighting action game. Press the attack or hold your ground? Read your foe’s attacks and break through with a decisive counterstrike.

5161820.name: TRENCHWORMS
5161820.short_description: Dig, swing and blast through real-time worm battles. Choose from 26 weapons and fight on destructible maps or rope-focused arenas. Play a 15 mission campaign, battle bots, share a keyboard, connect 2-6 controllers, or take up to six players online.

5169970.name: No One Gets Through
5169970.short_description: The full game is out now! A free-placement tower defense game with roguelite card upgrades. Redirect enemies, choose one of three upgrade cards, and buy upgrades and supplies at the Battlefield Shop. Shape your build and hold the line with overlapping fire.

5180260.name: Corner TCG
5180260.short_description: An idle game that sits in the corner of your screen where you open card packs, sell cards and buy upgrades

5227720.name: Phoning It In
5227720.short_description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

5227750.name: Mystic Realm
5227750.short_description: Mystic Realm is an idle cultivation RPG about finding your way with a band of companions. Travel through a world of Chinese fantasy, follow the stories along the road, and grow together at your own pace.

5230770.name: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm!
5230770.short_description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

5232710.name: OVERPAINT
5232710.short_description: Five minutes. Friendship over. Two to four players stand back to back and paint the same masterpiece. In Sabotage Time, walk over and throw paint at a friend's canvas. In the final Repair Time nobody can sabotage any more — just paint. When the sun goes down, it's over. Real masterpieces.

5234110.name: AXE DESCENT
5234110.short_description: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

5263510.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
5263510.short_description: Slow Orbit puts a tiny, self-running space war in the bottom corner of your screen. Leave your fleet to conquer planets while you do other things, then drop in to buy upgrades, pick promotions and take on tougher defenses.

5278630.name: Mouse Mortar CE
5278630.short_description: Calibrate your cannon, ignite the D.A.N. thruster, and launch your aviator mouse into orbit! Master unique gravities across 9 celestial worlds, dodge lethal traps, chain kinetic boosts, and conquer global leaderboards in this high-velocity physics launch arcade.

5284880.name: Star Imperium
5284880.short_description: Star Imperium is a sci-fi collectible card and deck-building strategy game where two commanders wage war across the stars, each defending a home planet. Marshal Ships, Soldiers, Forces, and Actions, powered by five resource factions — Anti-Matter, Crystals, Light, Metals, and Organics.

5304530.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
5304530.short_description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

5323970.name: THE GRAVES VIGIL
5323970.short_description: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

5338870.name: Tidy Tech
5338870.short_description: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

5340220.name: TRIGGER DRAW
5340220.short_description: Take aim. Draw with a bullet. TRIGGER DRAW is Old Maid with guns and abilities for up to 4 players. Shoot to draw a card, move yours to throw off their aim, and turn the tables with abilities. Miss, and your opponent picks your card. Play online with friends or solo against the CPU.

5343220.name: Screen Monster
5343220.short_description: A cozy desktop companion: pixel pets that lives on your real Windows desktop while you work. Pet them, toss toys, grow Bond to unlock new friends, spend Pet Points on food and toys, and jump into short mini-games with them whenever you need a break.

5344070.name: blockia
5344070.short_description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo.

5351320.name: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein
5351320.short_description: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein is a top-down roguelite shooter. Pilot your mech deep into an alien vein — mine for fragments, build weapons and talents, and survive 20 waves and 5 boss fights to reach the core.

5364830.name: Crack the Bills
5364830.short_description: Your breakfast diner is broke and the eggs won't stop coming. Aim a wooden spoon, crack eggs for coins, pay the bills before they pile up and dodge foreclosure in this crunchy, bite-sized active incremental game.

5366340.name: Dig into the orefields
5366340.short_description: A top-down action shooter with persistent incremental progression. Mine Venia's materials, fight the Klapperiden, upgrade your mining ship, and rebuild your crashed mothership piece by piece to escape the planet.

5371170.name: My Gaming Shop
5371170.short_description: Start from scratch and build the gaming shop of your dreams! Assemble your own PCs, stock the shelves, welcome your customers and expand your store to become the best in town.

5372870.name: Zero League
5372870.short_description: Zero League - a cosmic football sim with vast real world tactics, trading and business environments. Sign players with celestial lore, dictate your formation in the midst of temporal disarray, and watch every match on an interactive 2D pitch impacted by galactic weather events.

5389120.name: Bongo VPet - Taskbar Buddy
5389120.short_description: A tiny VPet device lives on your taskbar and its pixel pet hops with every key you press. Earn Bongo Points, catch a box or a key every 30 minutes of play, open boxes on a spinning reel and collect 140 devices from 7 series, pets, straps and charms you can trade on Steam.

5394990.name: Wallbreaker
5394990.short_description: Break the walls before they break you. Wallbreaker is an action roguelike where you fight upward against descending structures. Choose a warrior, ranger, or mage, combine items and augments, and find a new way to bring everything crashing down.

5396710.name: Cinderdelve
5396710.short_description: Hire a crew of dwarves, split them over nine classes that each break rock their own way, and dig down through eleven levels under the mountain. Take the nine lost artifacts, raise a dwarf to godhood at the altar, then break into the Cinder Tyrant's throne room and take his hoard.

5397990.name: SEAMARK
5397990.short_description: Chart your own course in a single-player maritime RPG. Trade between ports, recruit companions, and build your fleet. Explore distant regions, uncover discoveries and local stories, and brave real-time naval battles as you make your way across the seas.

5403690.name: Boxed
5403690.short_description: This is an adventure game with a little action and puzzle thrown in to spice things up a bit. Explore a strange new world (that is oddly familiar). Move around town and complete missions.. Bash the bad boxes and avoid getting boxed by them.

5421600.name: I Swear I Parked Here
5421600.short_description: You swear you parked right here. Now find your car among thousands of identical ones. Start with an old-fashioned key, upgrade to a remote with growing range, take your time and conquer lots with 1,000 to 50,000 cars, and beyond.

5428460.name: Making Room?
5428460.short_description: An unpaid-rent argument leads Var to a house book that changes her housemates whenever they cross the kitchen threshold. A short psychological horror visual novel about living together, resentment, and making other people easier to bear.

5456470.name: WARPROOF
5456470.short_description: This is an empire simulator wich the decisions you take will impact on gameplay.

5458210.name: How They Built the Pyramids
5458210.short_description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

420530.name: OneShot
420530.short_description: OneShot is a surreal top down Puzzle/Adventure game with unique gameplay capabilities. You are to guide a child through a mysterious world on a mission to restore its long-dead sun. The world knows you exist.

466130.name: White Day: A Labyrinth Named School
466130.short_description: Notorious cult-classic Korean horror. Sneak into school at midnight to return your sweetheart's diary and get caught in a terrifying game of cat and mouse. Explore haunted hallways, solve classic survival horror puzzles and escape the clutches of a killer Janitor who is out for your blood.

813230.name: ANIMAL WELL
813230.short_description: Explore a dense, interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter beautiful and unsettling creatures, as you attempt to survive what lurks in the dark. There is more than what you see.

1669980.name: Volcano Princess
1669980.short_description: Prepare the next monarch by finding her hobbies, training her for battle, and befriending the citizens she'll one day protect. Dive into an all-new parenting-simulator-RPG adventure, where every decision you make will not only affect the future of your daughter but that of an entire empire!

1714410.name: SANITY
1714410.short_description: A psychological horror game that delves into the lives of the Synclair Family, following a horrible tragedy.

2373610.name: Stream Slayers
2373610.short_description: Turn your Twitch chat into a party in Stream Slayers! Choose from 6 unique classes, level up, unlock powerful abilities, and work together to defeat increasingly powerful bosses. Your chat fights.

2515760.name: KRAPHIS : DRILLER
2515760.short_description: Mining roguelite. The detector pulses. Dig deeper. Find it and it's yours. Fuel is your only limit. 2041 you're a contract driller for STRATUM Corporation. How deep you go, when you return every decision is life or death.

2527810.name: BEATVISTA
2527810.short_description: For little ones and hardcore players alike. BEATVISTA is a rhythm game where every track, with music and video from AI video creators, gets a stage of its own. Play one-button mini-games or hammer through HELL charts on four keys, and rewind any tricky passage to practice.

2582320.name: Mixtape
2582320.short_description: On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

2980270.name: HackHub - Ultimate Hacker Simulator
2980270.short_description: Unravel cyber secrets and foil mass surveillance as a skilled hacker in Hackhub. Challenge authority, rewrite the rules, and emerge as the ultimate digital rebel.

3214740.name: Wild Island
3214740.short_description: You are stranded on a mysterious island, trying to escape. A sandbox where you stack items, craft synergies, and turn simple weapons into pure power. Experiment with runes, accessories, and pets. Discover the island’s mysteries and rebuild your sanctuary to uncover what the island truly wants.

3275780.name: Bet Your Friends
3275780.short_description: Shocking twist on Monopoly, your FRIENDS now become your prized ASSETS! BUY, WORK, BID or GAMBLE. First one to REACH $1,000,000 WINS! Have YOU ever bet with your FRIEND'S LIFE on the line?

3471290.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig
3471290.short_description: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

3601830.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
3601830.short_description: Silberheim is a tactical collectible card game where card packs are earned, never sold. Build your collection, discover what your cards become as they evolve through play, and explore an ever-changing world through PvP battles, PvE adventures, and community events.

3884410.name: This Code Echoes
3884410.short_description: This Code Echoes is a 2.5D platformer using weapons with directional attacks and multiple weapon slots for great combos. Battle your way through levels and face the bosses and get thier drops to get stronger and find your ultimate build!

4021100.name: Left Blank
4021100.short_description: Will you make it in time? Or is it already too late? If there is a memory destined to be erased, what would you choose to remember? Sheet by sheet, his paintings preserved the spring, summer, autumn and winter he shared with her. The final blank space was the "love" that never made it in time.

4095450.name: Cryoborn : convergence
4095450.short_description: A race against the cold. Face overwhelming enemy waves in an action roguelite where every run is a fight for power and survival. Grow stronger, master your abilities, and kill the final boss before the frozen world consumes you.

4294790.name: Powered Wheelchair Simulation
4294790.short_description: PWS is a wheelchair simulation and multiplayer game in early development. Players experience everyday environments from a wheelchair perspective, train driving skills safely, and join competitive or social modes in a shared, community-driven experience.

4306020.name: Incremental Donuts
4306020.short_description: Start with one donut. End with a multidimensional bakery empire. Click, automate, expand, unlock the Research Lab, run a Storefront, and break through to the Donut Hole. A layered idle game that keeps unfolding new systems until your mouse screams for mercy.

4322660.name: Stackade
4322660.short_description: Tower defense where your towers fall as blocks. Drag each piece onto the board, wall in your HQ and turn the gaps into kill zones. Every enemy comes at you its own way, bosses test your build, and between waves the Armory never has enough money for everything you want.

4339680.name: Totally Safe Moon Project
4339680.short_description: BREAKING NEWS! A giant asteroid is about to wipe out Earth, and your only escape is the Moon! Grab anything you can find, stack it high, and build your way to safety, solo or with up to 3 friends! Think Only Up, but YOU'RE the architect. What could possibly go wrong?

4394570.name: Apothecary Grounds
4394570.short_description: Explore a seemingly empty land where a lonely graveyard is your only familiar landmark. Gather the items needed to unlock a sealed crypt, uncover the secrets beyond its door, evade the relentless Apothecary who guards the grounds, and unravel the mystery buried beneath them.

4397630.name: Mask The Mess
4397630.short_description: Erase the traces before someone knocks. Step into the shoes of someone who can’t hesitate and hide a mysterious “problem.” Time pressure and shifting searches make every decision count. Your wit and cool head will decide if you make it out unscathed.

4444310.name: Rend
4444310.short_description: A shooter primarily focused on constantly aiming at various difficulties.

4506720.name: La P'tite Box: Technodrama
4506720.short_description: A top-down action game. Explore a fractured, chaotic world, scavenge for a new energy core, and fight off the twisted machine-flesh husks that hunt you—all before your dying bastion falls for good.

4519760.name: I Know This One (IKTO)
4519760.short_description: A museum that will not let you leave. One famous painting hangs in every room: the real one, or a forgery. Walk through the door marked REAL or the one marked FAKE. The right door leads on. The wrong one takes you back to the first room, to judge them all again.

4546800.name: Social Lab
4546800.short_description: Will the Ai fire into the air and cooperate, or shoot you and defect? Social Lab is a simultaneous turn-based strategy game that requires the best choice between cooperation and betrayal. Play a cooperative game with AIs in a social lab that studies human cooperation.

4553880.name: MillionCube
4553880.short_description: Million Cube is a maze exploration game with multiplayer for up to 30 players. Find the one correct room among up to a million rooms by following clues hidden in the writing on the doors and the surrounding scenery!

4619930.name: Reversi2048
4619930.short_description: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough — if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

4656650.name: Last Lawn Standing
4656650.short_description: Choose from garden gnomes with different stat bonuses and defend your shrines against the forces of evil. Spend the day upgrading your towers and weapons and placing flower towers to shape the path of the hordes that arrive at night. How many nights can you survive? Every run is unique.

4658470.name: Goldfish Simulator
4658470.short_description: Goldfish Simulator: “Endless Move” is a meditative idle goldfish simulation game. The goldfish react as if they were alive, and their movements are realistic and elegant.

4714010.name: GloveUp!
4714010.short_description: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

4731620.name: Fortune Mill
4731620.short_description: An incremental game where you must make $1,000,000 to escape! Throw darts, drop pachinko balls, play scratch-off tickets, unlock automation, and discover powerful synergies as each new game affects all the others!

4773410.name: Talaire
4773410.short_description: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

4784820.name: Eldritch Tricks
4784820.short_description: A cooperative trick-taking game where losing costs you your mind. Most missions remove a suit from the deck, and Dagon plays it against you. Every trick he takes, every investigator loses a piece of themselves. 26 missions. Sometimes, one of you wants the gate open.

4838950.name: The Sky Breaker
4838950.short_description: A third-person hammer action game inspired by the Dangun myth of Gojoseon. Play as Jinhun, who lost his parents in the chaos caused by Cheonwuidan's opposition to the marriage of Ungnyeo and Hwanung, and embark on a journey of revenge.

4848220.name: Jolly Junction: Chapter 1
4848220.short_description: As a detective, you are tasked with tracking down a convicted criminal. The trail leads to the remains of an abandoned television studio. Explore the studio as you track down the suspect. The longer you investigate, the clearer it becomes that you both are not alone...

4858800.name: Hollow Life
4858800.short_description: A short first-person psychological horror game where a voice gives you daily instructions — watch television, take your medicine, tidy up. The more faithfully you obey, the more your apartment decays into something wrong.

4872470.name: Short Fuse!
4872470.short_description: A cooperative driving challenge for 1–4 players. Transport unstable cargo across dangerous roads, meet your delivery quota, and try not to destroy each other before reaching the destination.

4881280.name: ECHO
4881280.short_description: Leave solid copies of yourself behind — then leap off them. Echo is a precision puzzle-platformer: place echoes to build your path, dash through lasers, and outsmart every room. No story, no filler — just you, your echoes, and the next challenge.

4927690.name: Boomsday
4927690.short_description: Hordes of adorable animals and toys want you dead. Boomsday is a fast-paced top-down horde survival shooter. Mow down endless swarms, loot powerful weapons, stack game-breaking perks, and survive massive bosses every 10 waves. Solo or up to 8-player cross-play co-op or 2 on the couch.

4955730.name: Public Faucet Hunt
4955730.short_description: Step into the shoes of Travis, the internet's favorite plumbing vigilante! Explore procedurally generated levels, test public faucets for the perfect flow, and evade city security in this endless, meme-inspired arcade stealth game powered by Unreal Engine 5.7.

4962870.name: DEN DEN BLOCK
4962870.short_description: Telephone game, but you build with blocks. See a prompt, build it — the next player guesses what it is in one word, then builds from that word alone... then everyone watches the chain fall apart together. Somehow "cat" becomes "rice ball". Party madness for 3-8 players, online or on one shared PC.

4964190.name: Lifers
4964190.short_description: Life's not so bad on the cell block. A multiplayer hangout game where you talk with friends & strangers, while playing chill card games. Play games, win cigarettes, use cigarettes to buy new gear.

4967770.name: Fast Point
4967770.short_description: A cozy cartoon co-op pickup point simulator. Receive parcels, serve customers, protect fragile cargo and perishable food, then grow a tiny pickup point into a full-blown logistics hub. Play solo or with friends.

4970260.name: Arsmagia
4970260.short_description: This is a fresh take on the action genre that fuses shooting mechanics with math puzzles. Spotting the weak points of approaching enemies requires quick and accurate calculations. Solve equations to create openings for attacks, defeat your foes, and aim for a high score.

4987540.name: Mic Drop Battles
4987540.short_description: Words are the units — arrange letters, numbers, and punctuation freely on your Page. Async PvP auto-battler with fully deterministic combat. A tactics sandbox: create your units and trinkets, customize your Voice class in a deep skill tree. No RNG — just Strategy.

4996440.name: Cliff Trigger
4996440.short_description: Fight mechanical enemies in a broken world of floating sky islands. Your guns are both weapons and mobility tools: blast enemies, leap across the void, and dash between islands. Move through the air, cross gaps, fight while traversing, and experience a unique gun-fu platform shooter.

5039650.name: Nightwire
5039650.short_description: Wire up a data-theft rig, launder stolen bytes on a live black market, and climb the netrunner underworld one burned identity at a time — until a ghost of who you used to be logs on, learns how you fight, and comes for the only chair that fits one of you.

5050000.name: Raceway Sparks
5050000.short_description: Racing game in crazy world with futuristic cars and ai bots.

5080700.name: 骨牌参禅 · Domino Zen
5080700.short_description: Rediscover Xiang Shi Fu, a Chinese domino solitaire played during the Qing dynasty. Swap tiles to turn a jumbled board into ten complete groups and a central pair. Enjoy the moment everything fits. Regular solo games have no countdown and save locally, ready for your return.

5097500.name: Bearing 2889
5097500.short_description: Orsivellum paid your team well for ninety days at a remote lighthouse. Now you're waking up on the floor of a locked room, the last few weeks are blank, and the building is empty. A first-person co-op escape room for 1 to 4 players.

5102640.name: Pawn'd Chess
5102640.short_description: Pick up a controller and play chess against human-like CPU opponents with adjustable difficulty. Make yourself comfortable with extensive accessibility options, explore freely with undo and redo, and create or revisit your own positions.

5116360.name: Circora: Part 1
5116360.short_description: Circora is a first-person psychological horror set in a vast corporate entertainment complex. Explore its abandoned spaces, interact with strange systems, and use Child Mode to reshape how fear, distance and reality are perceived.

5120530.name: Wayward Wind
5120530.short_description: A trading simulation traveling between cities to buy, sell, and profit from commodities in an ever-changing market, inspired by real-world commodity movements. Turn market knowledge, timing, and a little luck into profit as you grow from an ordinary trader into a master of commerce.

5133900.name: Can 'Em All
5133900.short_description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

5136210.name: Metlivi Adventure
5136210.short_description: Metlivi Adventure is a private 1–4 player collaborative narrative game where you create a story room, choose a character, write your actions, and shape an evolving shared adventure together with friends.

5148080.name: Heads Up, Chefs!
5148080.short_description: Your neighbors throw dinner off their balconies. Catch it midair with a gravity gun and get it into the pot before the order runs out. One pot, two orders, up to six pairs of hands. Rent is due in three days.

5151540.name: Scales: Exiled Girl
5151540.short_description: Raise a girl like never before! Experience the story through anime-style storytelling in a fantasy adventure romance game that blends character development, interactive choices, free exploration, and multiple endings.

5162350.name: The delayed memory
5162350.short_description: The Delayed Memory is a first-person psychological horror adventure set in a mysterious station between life and death. Explore the station, uncover clues, solve puzzles, and evade terrifying entities as you piece together your lost memories and discover the truth behind your identity.

5162380.name: LINETAIN
5162380.short_description: Build transport routes to supply the front and evacuate the wounded. Assign a limited fleet, respond to attacks announced 25 seconds in advance and pause to rethink your routes. Loading, transfers and combat are automatic in this single-player logistics strategy game.

5172270.name: John Whisk
5172270.short_description: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

5177230.name: Territory Idle Defense
5177230.short_description: recruit an ever-growing force of heroes in this pixel-art idle clicker RPG. Develop skill trees, unlock new territories, prestige for greater power, and come back stronger with every run.

5191770.name: Station-14
5191770.short_description: Pilot a fragile drone through the depths of space and investigate a derelict station in this short horror game.

5193800.name: 至尊传奇之终极必杀
5193800.short_description: 是一款以门派成长为核心的多人在线角色扮演游戏。你将作为一名门派弟子踏入这个世界，从最基础的门派任务开始，采集草药、击杀怪物、炼制丹药、强化装备、突破境界，在一次次历练中不断成长。这里没有一蹴而就的强者，只有一步步积累起来的实力与传承。

5211910.name: Voyager III
5211910.short_description: Robert, a 25 year-old intern at the biggest name in Space Exploration, is tasked with managing the Voyager III, an experimental probe that can warp to distant stars and worlds in the name of exploration. But as the months pass, Robert begins discovering horrors he wasn't meant to see.

5221360.name: Mud, Mortars & Zombies
5221360.short_description: Mud, Mortars & Zombies is an incremental tower defense in the trenches of WW1, where both sides now shoot at the undead. Waves advance, you answer with the arsenal of a world war: artillery, mortars, machine guns and aircraft. Every payout buys longer rounds, bigger waves and heavier guns.

5225280.name: DeadDrop
5225280.short_description: Run the streets. Deliver the product. Don’t get caught. DeadDrop is a fast-paced action roguelike where every drop escalates the danger and no two runs are the same. Complete deliveries, upgrade your weapons and outrun the law across procedurally generated cityscapes.

5238390.name: Wurzeltiefe
5238390.short_description: A compact, painterly metroidvania: a 2–3 hour descent into the Rootdeep. Explore 26 painted caverns, earn five abilities, face two guardians — then chase your own best time with the built-in speedrun timer.

5245540.name: Boltfall
5245540.short_description: BoltFall is a jetpack-powered survival arena game where you boost, dodge, and outlast escalating waves of hazards to climb the leaderboard solo or online.

5247590.name: 君临天下之风云传奇
5247590.short_description: 一款以武侠为背景的ARPG游戏。你将扮演一名刚出道的年轻侠客，来到一座小镇。原本只是想行侠仗义、帮助村民，却在铲除恶人的过程中，逐渐发现武林中隐藏着一个巨大的阴谋。风云变幻，江湖动荡，你的每一次拔剑，都将把自己推向更深的漩涡。

5250220.name: Pterodactyl Slap!
5250220.short_description: Slap pterodactyls out of the neon sky in this free arcade blaster. Smash nests, grab weapon pods, and survive 15 floors of screaming wireframe fury, solo or in drop-in couch co-op. Three towering bosses, a charge shot, and a hi-score board waiting for your initials. Insert coin.

5257620.name: One More Rule
5257620.short_description: Match fruits and survive while an ancient spirit adds more and more rules for you to follow! Win through multiple game modes and even customize your own.

5260050.name: The President: 20th Century 2
5260050.short_description: Become the president of a country and make it a world leader!

5266980.name: RaviWar 1: A Perfect Sonday
5266980.short_description: A free first-person adventure of puzzles and precarious jumps. It is 2077. The world lives inside Takarek, a tower of 17,769 floors, and Consensus has decided what everyone in it thinks for forty years. You are twenty, new to the job of deprecating data. Tonight you keep one file to save the world.

5284260.name: Mafia Solitaire
5284260.short_description: Defeat the mafia and restore justice! Solitaire with a mafia twist! Dive deep into 1920s Americana!

5287510.name: Daydream and Her Lonely Isle
5287510.short_description: A school romance visual novel featuring offline AI chat and character memories. Speak in your own words; preferences, shared moments, and plans carry into later conversations. Spend a year with four heroines on an island, and uncover the mysteries in their dreams.

5290590.name: Intergalactic Burger Joint
5290590.short_description: Turn falling ingredients into a dinner rush. Match four, set up cascades, and serve hungry customers across six space restaurants. Work through 120 campaign orders, unlock a crew of chefs, or see how long you can keep the kitchen running in Endless.

5291670.name: My Little Game Room
5291670.short_description: Turn your Steam library into a cozy game room. Display your game cases, decorate every corner, and view the unlocked achievements in your collection.

5293690.name: Mystery Cargo: Auction Tycoon
5293690.short_description: Bid on a cargo lot with only clues and rival offers to guide you. Scratch to reveal the goods one by one; a quick reveal leaves closed boxes and trays for you to open. Keep a find, sell the rest, and follow the real leftovers when a rival takes the lot.

5297630.name: MAYBE YOU!
5297630.short_description: Somewhere in that herd of 30 animals, one is a real person. Find them and shoot first. Your 29 NPC teammates move on your ping. Killed by an NPC? Possess an ally and keep hunting. You only lose to the real player. A 1v1 hide-and-seek FPS across a resort, sinking pirate ships and a Halloween castle.

5299810.name: UNWELCOME
5299810.short_description: UNWELCOME is a first-person horror adventure set in an isolated desert town. Explore unsettling locations, survive dangerous encounters, and uncover fragments of a forgotten past as the town grows more hostile with every step.

5302900.name: The Outlaw's Saloon
5302900.short_description: A dusty town. A brand-new saloon. And a whole lot of trouble waiting inside. They say a group of beautiful women came from the Far East and opened the wildest saloon the frontier has ever seen. They sing Western K-Pop, pour the drinks, and run games that’ll test your aim, your luck, and your nerve.

5305980.name: Hanzi: Five Gates
5305980.short_description: Combine 关 + 羽 into Guan Yu, or 枪 + 兵 into spearmen. Draw Chinese character tiles, build a six-slot formation, and let it fight automatically. Choose routes and relics, then rebuild your army around the tiles you find in this Three Kingdoms strategy roguelite.

5306980.name: Overarmed Survivors
5306980.short_description: Turn your mech into a walking arsenal in a bullet-heaven roguelite. Chain weapon evolutions all the way to a nuclear strike, tackle objectives under fire, and take on bosses. Play solo or with up to three friends, online or on one screen.

5313480.name: Meow Game: Survival Party
5313480.short_description: 20 cats. One winner. Compete against AI rivals in a single-player party game with four rounds of changing minigames. Dodge zombies, capture points, and survive team battles. Customize your cat, explore islands, and climb from local cups to world championships!

5324300.name: Very Tasty Story
5324300.short_description: Open a restaurant in an ancient city, a steppe settlement or a metropolis. Listen to your customers' stories and learn what they like. Gather local ingredients to recreate traditional dishes or invent new ones. The same ingredients can become hundreds of different dishes—there is no fixed answer!

5331190.name: TheDuckening
5331190.short_description: Bread, ducks, and pure chaos! Jump into The Duckening – a fast-paced bullet-heaven roguelike. Wield 50+ weapons, build crazy synergies with cards, upgrade unique ducks, fight bosses every 10 waves, and play built-in minigames!

5338650.name: Breakneck Transmission
5338650.short_description: A fast-paced, time trial package delivery racing game. Using mind bending warps to the laws of physics, deliver packages to their destinations quickly and prove that recklessness can be improved to regain a spot on a top racing team.

5342740.name: Halloween Survival
5342740.short_description: Survive Halloween night! Pick your costume and collect candy with up to 4 players in this spooky survival co-op game while facing skeletons, haunted houses, mysterious portals and more!

5345300.name: 捕快: Constable of a Ming County
5345300.short_description: Patrol a Ming dynasty county town as its constable. Stop street crimes, solve murders and judge the guilty, race horses and boats, sneak past guards at night, and defend the town from the Black Wind bandits. A third-person open-town action game.

5346910.name: 吹部に入ろう！～Join the Band!～
5346910.short_description: 0 members. 0 years of tradition. From there, aim for Gold at Nationals. Recruit students at a high school with no concert band, train your members, plan your lineup, and purchase instruments as you build the band from scratch. Advance through local, prefectural, regional, and national competitions.

5347090.name: 123 Halloween Early Learning Games for Kids, Toddlers, Babies 1+
5347090.short_description: A cheerful Halloween learning game for toddlers and preschoolers! Discover numbers 1 to 10, practice counting, hear spoken numbers in 14 languages, pop balloons, play memory, roll the dice, solve puzzles and enjoy a fun little truck adventure.

5354940.name: Wampoo
5354940.short_description: A card-driven marble race for 2–4 players. Play cards to race your marbles around the board, knock rivals back to Start, and swap your way Home — in teams or free-for-all, online with friends or against bots of three difficulty levels.

5357500.name: Reactance
5357500.short_description: A first-person duelling game where every fighter is a scientist. Read your opponent's guard, then block, parry and strike back across ten arenas, from a station under a black hole to the inside of a living cell. Free to play, with rollback netcode, 2v2, Ranked and a Laboratory to meet in.

5362850.name: The Last Broadcast
5362850.short_description: You are the sole emergency dispatcher aboard Relay Epsilon-9. Using an authentic 1980s retro terminal, track bio-telemetry, consult engineering schematics, and make life-or-death decisions to guide survivors through a breached vessel.

5365580.name: Snake Cubed
5365580.short_description: Classic Snake escapes the flat board. Crawl across 20 increasingly strange 3D shapes, grow a procedural world, stack permanent roguelike powers, gamble on temporary mutations, and use ridiculous tools until Snake becomes completely unhinged.

5365990.name: Mall Slop
5365990.short_description: Experience the true terror that mall cops experience each day in this unique horror multiplayer game. Work with your friends to complete your tasks and end your shift before the lights turn off and the creatures begin to roam the halls.

5366060.name: A Personal Winter
5366060.short_description: A short visual novel about a boy and his senpai spending a night together in a snow-covered city.

5367570.name: Pipsquad
5367570.short_description: Explore 108 hero classes and shape their dice in a turn-based roguelike. Read enemy intentions, keep key rolls, and combine attacks, shields, spells, and relics. Try custom parties, generated heroes, and ten-hero Raid battles.

5371500.name: Cats Here
5371500.short_description: 😺 Discover 100+ hidden cats 🐾 in the colorful landscape. 🏆 Earn TONS OF ACHIEVEMENTS. How many cats 🐈 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

5371810.name: Cozy Tent
5371810.short_description: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.

5384360.name: Buzzwire
5384360.short_description: Host your own buzz-in quiz show. Run it from your PC, put the board on your stream or Discord, and friends buzz in from their phones with a 6-letter room code. Or hand out controllers and play on one TV.

5385510.name: Scared Puppies
5385510.short_description: In Scared Puppies, you dive into the paws of adventurous puppies on a mission to find their lost owner. Set in a vibrant world, the game blends puzzle-solving with light adventure elements, promoting teamwork and clever strategy.

5419520.name: INKBLOT
5419520.short_description: A tiny inkblot. Two states. Bounce across printing blocks, stick to walls, and ride moving machinery in a physics platformer set inside a misprinted book. Master your momentum through 30 handcrafted rooms of crumbling type, shifting gravity, and portals.

5421570.name: In for a Penny, In for a Pound
5421570.short_description: Fight through procedurally generated dungeons in an isometric pixel-art action roguelite. Wield firearms, battle enemies in darkness around you, and make different builds with upgrade cards system to reach your best chance of survival. Every floor raises the stakes. How deep can you go?

5428930.name: Ghosts Don't Need Doors
5428930.short_description: Even ghosts dream of freedom! Help a little ghost escape a haunted mansion, where everyday objects hide clues to secret passages. Observe, deduce, and slip through walls to reach the moonlight.

5436750.name: 101 Cats: Copenhagen
5436750.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Copenhagen landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

5452370.name: Withering Mind
5452370.short_description: Escape a dark, twisting corn maze before you lose your mind. Your sanity is fading, and the longer you remain trapped, the more likely the monster lurking in the darkness is to attack.

5461600.name: Knight Survivor
5461600.short_description: This is a survival game inspired by Vampire Survivors. This is a very simplified version.

323880.name: Seedling
323880.short_description: A cozy first-person colony game. Land on a planet you bought on credit (yours, mostly), chop, fish and farm with your own hands, then grow a town of settlers with names, needs and quirks, from the first log to a space elevator. Alone or with up to 3 friends.

451340.name: Gold Mining Simulator
451340.short_description: Become a gold miner. Work hard, dig deep, explore the world, and you’ll become the wealthiest person in Alaska. Use a variety of specialist machines to find as much gold as you can.

466170.name: Idling to Rule the Gods
466170.short_description: Idling to Rule the Gods is a free to play Idle-Game with a lot of content and some Minigames. Depending on your play-style, you can play it fast or slow. Either way it can be fun for hundreds of hours!

756800.name: Contraband Police
756800.short_description: Take over the duties of a border guard inspector in a communist country of the 80's. Smuggling, corruption and forgery are the order of the day here. Be vigilant and earn the respect of your superiors.

1211630.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 7
1211630.short_description: Five new games: the hit threequel Quiplash 3, the collaborative chaos of The Devils and the Details, the fierce drawing game Champ’d Up, the speech game Talking Points and the guessing game Blather 'Round. Use phones or tablets as controllers and play with up to 8 players, and an audience of 10,000!

1605220.name: Dune: Spice Wars
1605220.short_description: A 4X real-time strategy game from the developers of the critically acclaimed Northgard. Set in Frank Herbert’s groundbreaking Dune universe, you must lead your faction and battle for control and dominance over the harsh desert planet of Arrakis.

1858720.name: Message From Aliens
1858720.short_description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

2824980.name: Castlepult
2824980.short_description: Crush an army with a catapult. Defend your castle with huge boulder impacts. Stack fire, frost, and gravity upgrades, and spend your gold on enough firepower to survive the next wave. Bigger crowds? Better targets.

2982710.name: Barely Alive
2982710.short_description: A co-op survival party game. Hunt your friends or survive until sunrise.

3113480.name: CardCraft Champions
3113480.short_description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

3189340.name: Dungeons of Eternity
3189340.short_description: Endless fantasy action and adventure await you and your friends in Dungeons of Eternity. Hack-n-slash takes on a new meaning in VR: swing swords, throw axes, use bows, wield magic staffs, and more to make it out alive. Become the most powerful adventurer in this blockbuster VR experience!

3787980.name: Gridfire
3787980.short_description: A fast top-down PvP shooter: capture flags, hold points and escort the VIP across six modes and dozens of maps. Build and share your own maps, play with friends — or switch on Decibel Drive and fly your ship using your voice.

3856950.name: Bridgelands
3856950.short_description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

3873120.name: Food Delivery Simulator 2027 - Prologue
3873120.short_description: Take orders on your phone, pick up meals from restaurants serving world cuisines and deliver them across a living city on foot, by bike, scooter or car. Start your courier career with the Prologue of Food Delivery Simulator 2027!

4029240.name: Shwoop
4029240.short_description: Draw curves to guide projectiles into matching collectors. A physics puzzle game of logic and precision. Climb the leaderboards, then build and share levels of your own.

4072400.name: Meow Time: cozy cat room
4072400.short_description: Decorate a cozy room and work, study, or relax with an adorable cat. Earn its trust through daily care, petting, and play. Discover how its reactions change with your bond and its mood. Enjoy your time together with handy productivity tools!

4159290.name: The Rusted
4159290.short_description: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. THE RUSTED is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

4255640.name: MyDear.exe
4255640.short_description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

4260610.name: Null Recall
4260610.short_description: You work for a government agency that studies the effects of demonic possessions.

4349420.name: Only Mining
4349420.short_description: A short game about becoming the ultimate town miner. Strip away the farming, the town chores, and all other distractions so you can focus on 'Only Mining'. Every ladder found sends you toward larger rock and more valuable rewards. How deep will you descend before you run out of air?

4451770.name: Manual Teller Machine
4451770.short_description: In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager. Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise! Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

4501140.name: Gimbap Heaven
4501140.short_description: Run a Korean snack bar with your own crew! Hire staff, hand out kitchen tasks, plan the menu and juggle wages, stress and bills in this card-based restaurant management sim. Jump in to cook and serve by hand when it gets busy, and stay afloat for 15 days.

4586730.name: Dwarf the Dungeonist
4586730.short_description: Carry your inventory above your head. Solve puzzles with it. Play as a dwarf in a turn-based puzzle crawler with roguelite elements. Place objects, activate mechanisms, and outwit monsters as you explore dungeons.

4595460.name: Make the World Great Again
4595460.short_description: Infiltrate a private island where the elite meet, and every room, every piece of paper and every locked cabin hides something or someone they paid a great deal to bury. Uncover every secret and escape before they catch you.

4620670.name: Clicker Astro Planet 2
4620670.short_description: Click the planet, do prestige, develop businesses with cats, complete space missions, and unlock 80+ achievements while exploring the galaxy in Clicker Astro Planet 2! Perfect for a 100% completion challenge.

4645180.name: Elecade
4645180.short_description: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

4653200.name: The Background Warrior
4653200.short_description: Always open at the bottom of your screen, this idle game lets you advance through stages full of monsters. Master different jobs and become the strongest.

4656440.name: Drum Incremental
4656440.short_description: A satisfying incremental game where every click has rhythm. Tap patterns, earn Rhythm Points, unlock new techniques, and build your ultimate setup. No music experience needed — just the urge to keep going.

4669130.name: Wizard’s Path: Palette of Spells
4669130.short_description: A survivors-like action roguelite where you discover your class through the spells you choose. Transform into one of 470+ mages, unlock them for future runs, bend the rules with 30+ runes, raise other players' fallen mages, and climb the Endless leaderboards.

4703560.name: Soviet Backrooms
4703560.short_description: Soviet Backrooms is a first-person survival horror set in abandoned Soviet apartment blocks. Explore decaying apartments, stairwells, and endless corridors, search for a way out, and listen for the footsteps of something you cannot see.

4718360.name: Strike Wings
4718360.short_description: A top-down modernized retro space combat epic. Choose from over fifty warships and be part of massive fleet actions with hundreds of ships on the field. Fly for Earth's church-state or the Martian forge that armed it. Play solo, in split-screen or in co-op.

4719010.name: Librarian of Aquademia : The Forbidden Grimoire
4719010.short_description: An auto-2D side-scroller shoot'em up game that aims to be beginner-friendly for someone who has never experienced a shoot'em up bullet hell game before.

4740930.name: Legend of Defenders
4740930.short_description: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth, and enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.

4748210.name: Jeremy is Broke
4748210.short_description: Trade stock, dumpster dive, and repair laptops in this unemployment simulator

4749330.name: The case parking
4749330.short_description: You work as a security guard at a parking lot where strange things happen every day. Survive each day and face bizarre creatures in this horror walking simulator.

4764420.name: Tale Sweeper
4764420.short_description: Tale Sweeper blends incremental progression with light loot mechanics. Hack and slash monsters, complete quests, and gather gold and materials. Use your loot to upgrade a massive skill tree, craft powerful weapons, and buy potions to gear up for your next adventure!

4780820.name: 20 Floors Down
