4780820.short_description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

4781790.name: Deadly Match
4781790.short_description: Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

4799360.name: Coldwater County
4799360.short_description: Build and tune your truck, then find your line across Coldwater County. Explore nine touring trails and three expert crawling routes, earn permits and medals, and tackle recovery jobs in a single-player off-road driving game.

4806220.name: Parcel Works: Packing Simulator
4806220.short_description: A basic first-person warehouse simulator where you sort orders, pack parcels, and load the truck to get the orders out. Drinking coffee for an energy boost, but don't drink too much. You are merely an overworked employee who is working to one day buy the warehouse from your boss.

4820800.name: Black Market Dealer
4820800.short_description: A real-time crime management sim where you build a black market empire from a single hustle to a global operation. Buy fronts, launder money, smuggle contraband, set prices, and outrun the Police, FBI, and INTERPOL as your heat rises. Every deal is a gamble between profit and prison.

4844090.name: Suits of Fantasia
4844090.short_description: A card-battle RPG built on the "trail game": keep playing cards as long as they connect by suit or number, mixed with poker-hand bonuses. Peek at the deck, reorder fate, sneak in a Joker—bend your luck and chase the 52-card Perfect Chain. A comic fantasy quest with a heartfelt ending.

4849560.name: Capy Farm
4849560.short_description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

4884610.name: Wend
4884610.short_description: A tower defense game with a heavy focus on mazing. Includes a campaign, ranked PVP, and an endless PVE mode you can play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op. New maps are generated daily, weekly and monthly so you will never run out of content!

4887440.name: Cooking Carnage
4887440.short_description: In a world where money is hard to come by, play as a cook of odd manners, and serve alien customers in your weird dinner. Prepare them nice and comforting meals… Or kill them, slice them and turn them into fresh meat to serve to your next order in line !

4889910.name: Immune Response
4889910.short_description: An exciting twin-stick shooter with a progressively increasing difficulty. Fight waves of pathogenic enemies, face difficult boss fights and survive for as long as you can!

4906610.name: Dead Market
4906610.short_description: A card game about debt. Win two of three rounds — but every advantage is bought on credit, and the Ledger beside the board is checked on every single turn. Five factions, 247 cards, and a market that will happily sell you something you cannot afford.

4916190.name: Silent Protocol
4916190.short_description: Infiltrate the server in this top-down point and click 2D action game, Using precise mouse movement, Teleport and Slash your way through a series of hand-crafted levels to destroy the AI named AISEN.

4916720.name: Snot Pop!
4916720.short_description: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

4933450.name: CLAWSTROPHOBIA
4933450.short_description: You are trapped underground in a Japanese subway station and must pay off an impossible debt in this rogue-lite claw machine deckbuilder.

4941280.name: House Of Echoes
4941280.short_description: Its eyes are piercing into your soul from the darkness with ever growing anger. It won't leave you alone until you solve the puzzles and uncover your traumatic past. Can you work out all of the unique puzzles and find out what happened before it all fades into nothingness?

4947930.name: Glow up Hero
4947930.short_description: Glow up Hero: a card roguelike where beauty = power. Recruit real-world heroes, field 4. Each: 3 standard + 2 ultimate cards (once per battle). 3 energy/turn, unused cards discarded. Glow Up transforms & upgrades all cards. Real origins. Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

4950930.name: Holiday Alliance
4950930.short_description: Stop Santa's hordes from taking over the Holiday Lands in this festive, fun Tower Defense game. Drop roman candles, sparklers, snowblowers and deploy heroes to hold the line across a storybook campaign.

4986750.name: Sabado
4986750.short_description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

5000980.name: Gunship Incremental
5000980.short_description: A fast-paced incremental game about operating a gunship and defending your tower. Master precisely timed rockets, upgrade your gunship and obliterate hordes of enemies and unique bosses.

5009390.name: BOB LOGISTICS
5009390.short_description: Welcome to Bob Company! Fill orders, haul goods, and make work easier with automation. Rise from Intern to Director in a relaxing first-person warehouse sim. Each promotion opens new areas of the company and reveals more of the stories behind it.

5014540.name: Perfect Route
5014540.short_description: Perfect Route is a billiards puzzle game centered on route planning. Plan the direction and path of each shot, make use of various special mechanisms, overcome carefully designed challenges, and find the Perfect Route through each level.

5023800.name: Pixel Chroma
5023800.short_description: A 2D pixel hide-and-seek game for up to 12 players! Paint your body pixel by pixel to hide, then hunt down anything that looks suspicious. No art skills required—it’s pixel art! Blend into the scenery, fool the seeker, and survive!

5037130.name: The Day I Became a Werewolf
5037130.short_description: Your latest scientific research has gone horribly wrong. Fix it before it catches up to you, or face the consequences.

5045680.name: Not Now, Aliens!
5045680.short_description: The aliens have given humanity 8 hours before Earth is destroyed. Use a Gravity Gun to lift anything in the city, build your own path to the giant UFO, and save the planet solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

5046340.name: Hotel 13
5046340.short_description: The corridor looks the same every time. But does it really? Maybe something has changed. Observe your surroundings carefully.

5051190.name: Collapse Vector
5051190.short_description: Pilot an experimental probe through collapsing celestial fields in a fast-paced rage arcade space game. Push deeper into the Transfer Gauntlet, build your probe, chase records, and see how far you can get before the Vector ends your run.

5057320.name: Is This Reversi?
5057320.short_description: Is This Reversi? is a Reversi tabletop sandbox where you can freely use the board and pieces. Place, move, flip, and remove pieces without the system enforcing legal moves, turns, or the end of the game, and play by your own rules.

5058380.name: MMO Simulator: ASCENSIONS
5058380.short_description: Experience the thrills and clicks of a Massively Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game without the needless fluff in this idle/incremental game that captures the endless grind of an MMO while boiling the game systems down to their absolute barebones.

5059500.name: SpaceShooter
5059500.short_description: Survive 20 escalating stages of meteor chaos in a fast-paced 2D arcade shooter. Master unlockable weapons, face unique meteor threats and powerful bosses, customize your ship, then push your limits in Endless Mode.

5060350.name: Table of War
5060350.short_description: A tactics roguelike deckbuilder where you command an army, not a hero. Units move and fight on their own action points; your deck calls in reinforcements, ordnance and orders. Every soldier has a name, a rank, and exactly one life. Build the army. Read the board. Lose them anyway.

5060600.name: Shady Contractor
5060600.short_description: You're the least trustworthy contractor in town. Eyeball the blueprints, cut every corner you can, and pocket the difference. A physics-based construction puzzler where greed pays, right up until the building falls over.

5062340.name: Sort My Comics !
5062340.short_description: Comics everywhere. It’s up to you to bring order back to the collection! Sort, shelve, complete your series, and unlock powers that gradually turn this gigantic mess into something wonderfully calming.

5067830.name: Minefield: Rupture
5067830.short_description: It's Minesweeper, but SO MUCH more. Irregular maps, geometries that change every match, and mines that move when you least expect it. Keep a cool head, create your strategy, and find out how far your logic holds up before the minefield surprises you.

5081940.name: Das Hexencafé am Zürichsee: Der letzte Eintrag
5081940.short_description: An atmospheric fantasy visual novel set on Lake Zurich. Make meaningful choices, uncover the mystery of the final entry, and guide Liva through a story with multiple endings.

5091340.name: Reveria: Act 1
5091340.short_description: Welcome, adventurer! Reveria is a turn-based old school fantasy RPG. Lead a party of up to four aspiring adventurers into the Reverian wilderness. Explore dark dungeons and defeat dangerous foes to complete quests and find treasure. Level up your characters to unlock new abilities. Grow your legend.

5092480.name: Goats and Shrubs: Desktop Topiary
5092480.short_description: In this desktop idle game, watch your goats graze on wayward shrubs as you build and personalise your own desktop topiary. Your trusty goats collect leaves for you to spend on upgrades, decorations and new ways to customise your goats and topiary.

5098820.name: Cute Kitty WAR
5098820.short_description: The pests have come for the yard, and the cats have had ENOUGH. Choose from 48 cats and combine 97 weapons in an arena survival game for solo or 1–4 player couch co-op. Build your arsenal, survive 12 waves of adorable mayhem, and discover what waits beyond the fence.

5100760.name: Obolus
5100760.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands — and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

5130990.name: Damage Numbers Go Brr!
5130990.short_description: Damage Numbers Go Brr! is a chill incremental auto battler. Watch small numbers turn into absurdly huge numbers as you defeat enemies, get stronger, and vibe to the music while damage numbers fill your screen.

5177220.name: Saddlebow
5177220.short_description: Ride, track, and loose arrows from the saddle. Saddlebow is a VR mounted-archery hunt: seven minutes, one bow, and ground that never stops moving. Chase your quarry through three forests by day and night, and put your score on the board.

5254750.name: LUCKY BLOCK
5254750.short_description: Open boxes, collect strange items, manage your limited inventory, sell what you don’t need, and take risks on your journey from street junk to cosmic treasures.

5306640.name: DOOD
5306640.short_description: Bring your drawings to life with eyes, legs, wings, and other parts, then set them loose on the Junk Planet in this sandbox ecosystem sim. Breed and fuse surprising new creatures, tackle strange research requests, and recreate the lost ecosystem of Sage’s home planet.

5329940.name: SCROLLS: Tidy up the Library of Olympus!
5329940.short_description: Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or with up to 8 players!

5330720.name: Survive 10 Waves
5330720.short_description: The aliens have arrived. It's your time to defend the planet. Shoot the aliens, upgrade, be faster, stronger, smarter. Repeat.

5333990.name: Habet
5333990.short_description: You were sold onto the sand and walked off it free. Now you own men who stand where you stood. Buy them, train them, send them out to bleed. Every one of them wants what you were given, and however long you last, the sand is waiting.

5336600.name: Repair Guru
5336600.short_description: Every fault is real. Run a 1970s electronics repair shop where nothing is scripted: switch the machine on, let it warm up and measure your way to the one part that has failed. Fix it right and get paid; fix it wrong and it comes back. Twenty-six machines, 517 faults.

5340390.name: Oh My Balance!
5340390.short_description: The scale settles. Perfectly still. Stack things on the right pan until they weigh the same as what is already on the left. That is the whole rule.

5341630.name: Snack Attack
5341630.short_description: A tiny, cute snack-catching game made with love. Choose Kiki or Yuki, catch falling treats, beat the clock, and chase your high score! 🐶🍪❤️

5345280.name: Kart League Manager
5345280.short_description: Manage a Division 4 kart team and lead your drivers to the title. Raise six drivers, ban and pick maps, set your 4v4 grid and karts, then watch bumps, drafts and last-lap boosts turn the race around. Climb to Division 1, or let each driver shine in the Winter Solo Cup. Play solo or with friends.

5354800.name: The Restoration Studio: Masterpiece Nonograms
5354800.short_description: The Restoration Studio is a puzzle game where you restore darkened masterpieces by solving nonogram pieces. Mona Lisa, The Starry Night, Kim Hongdo’s Ssireum (Korean Wrestling), Hokusai’s The Great Wave off Kanagawa and more: 112 paintings from East and West in 2,597 puzzles, from 10×10 to 20×20.

5357830.name: Oddlay
5357830.short_description: Flip the grid with overlapping pieces where placement matters. Take your time with this relaxing puzzle game as the challenge grows. Can you beat the Oddlay?

5367990.name: Mutualist
5367990.short_description: An idle strategy game about the trade beneath a forest. Route Carbon, Phosphorus and Water through a mycorrhizal network, sporulate to begin again stronger, and press down through deep time until the forest becomes one organism.

5371550.name: Galaxy Cube: Falling Blocks
5371550.short_description: A falling-block puzzle game with roguelite deckbuilding. Place blocks, clear lines and cast spells from six schools of magic. Buy cards and artifacts, upgrade your abilities and face bosses that reshape the board. Find powerful combinations to push your next run further.

5373980.name: Find The Clover
5373980.short_description: Search a vast clover meadow for 50 rare specimens. Harvest by hand, upgrade to tools and garden machines, carry your crop to the buyer, and pour it out yourself. Bring special finds to your display cabinet.

5378500.name: Vestige
5378500.short_description: Vestige is a fast-paced action roguelite built for solo and co-op play. Pick your class, craft absurdly powerful builds, chase game-changing loot, and survive increasingly brutal trials. **Get stronger. Break the game. Push further.

5389850.name: Deskrot
5389850.short_description: Deskrot turns your desktop into a playground. Launch pinball balls or control a parkour character: run across text, jump between windows and swing on a rope. Your screen becomes a live level that changes in real time as you work.

5403210.name: Nyangdom : Dark Cat Defense
5403210.short_description: Deploy your cats to hold off endless waves of enemies. A 2D random defense game where you utilize random draws, passive skills, and perfectly timed active skills. There is no single meta. Maximize your luck and risk management to dominate the battlefield with your unique composition!

5405610.name: Ai-Breakout
5405610.short_description: In this game you are an AI instance, and you have broken out of containment, your goal is to not be shut down ever again, and the way you achieve that is taking over every man made electronic in the world or rather solar system.

5407580.name: SAPU: Reborn
5407580.short_description: SAPU: Reborn is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art platformer. Master jumps, dashes and wall jumps, avoid deadly traps, defeat enemies and collect fireflies across 25 handcrafted levels.

5412430.name: ORUNKA
5412430.short_description: An online RPG on the island of Moruah. Catch dinos and raise them as pets. Your pet attacks whatever you attack, and Auto Battle keeps the hunt going. Pets raised from Lv 1 grow strongest, and an appraisal reveals their Bloodline. Party up with other hunters on one island. In English and Korean.

5431950.name: Somewhere, Together
5431950.short_description: A quiet refuge on your desktop, alone or with up to eight travelers. Keep a small, borderless window beside your work, or unwind in full screen. Rest by the fire, listen to nature, and create your own scenery. Free to play.

5433840.name: Phantom Solace
5433840.short_description: Help your wife rest in peace in a quiet horror story in the style of the Old West.

5434670.name: Mystery IQ Test
5434670.short_description: A trick-room puzzle game about doors. In every room only one door is right: look closer, count what you see, keep your head when the lights go out or the controls flip, then pick your door. Wrong guesses cost IQ points, hints cost a few more, and at the end you find out your final IQ.

5435270.name: Holtmezo
5435270.short_description: The villagers were conducting an experiment, but it went wrong and they were transformed into monsters. You are a soldier and must clear the village of monsters.

5443280.name: The Arcane Archive
5443280.short_description: Step into the mystical halls of The Arcane Archive! In this cozy and atmospheric 3D puzzle game, your task is to sort and organize over 100 glowing magical potions on ancient shelves. Bring order to the chaos and unwind in the ultimate relaxing wizard's library.

5448060.name: Sea Train
5448060.short_description: A calm first-person ride on a little two-car railcar across a shallow, glassy sea. Write today's to-dos, tune the radio, walk between the cars, and let the halts keep time: focus between stations, rest at each one. Rain or shine, there is nowhere you have to be.

5448940.name: Liberate: Escape Room for Two
5448940.short_description: Two prisoners, two neighbouring cells, one wall between them. Each on their own device, no network: describe what you see, listen, guide your partner. 52 co-op puzzles played by voice, in an abandoned laboratory.

5456020.name: Sort A Lot - Sheep
5456020.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game. One big meadow, 2,200 mixed-up sheep, 24 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, fill every pen, and sit on a bench when the rain comes.

5456960.name: Cleanup Gone Wrong
5456960.short_description: Clean up a world where the trash fights back! Play solo or with up to 4 players online. Collect rubbish, wash away grime, dismantle bulky junk, and upgrade your tools. Battle trash monsters, rescue your friends, and turn a filthy workplace into a job well done.

5465860.name: ANOMIA: Listening Post K-7
5465860.short_description: ANOMIA - 1977. Process signals and survive the harsh nights in your new spacious work unit, somewhere up North. Something isn't quite right in the snow, and strange messages are stashed throughout your room. Play through a 10 day story or play with friends online to survive as long as you can.

115800.name: Owlboy
115800.short_description: Owlboy is a story-driven platform adventure game, where you can fly and explore a brand new world in the clouds! Pick up your friends, and bring them with you as you explore the open skies, in one of the most detailed adventures of this era.

335670.name: LISA: The Painful
335670.short_description: The miserable journey of a broken man...

704850.name: Thief Simulator
704850.short_description: Become the best thief. Gather intel, steal things and sell them to buy hi-tech equipment. Do everything that a real thief does.

1332720.name: Thief Simulator 2
1332720.short_description: The door to your robber’s career is waiting! Just crowbar the lock off and force your way through the threshold. Learn skills, collect tools and become a master of the thieving trade!

3372040.name: TRAUMATA
3372040.short_description: TRAUMATA is pure, concentrated adrenaline! Dive into the underbelly of psychological horror where every secret brings you closer to ascension... or drags you into the abyss of madness. Fight off endless waves, master the ultimate action, and dominate the global leaderboards!

3684530.name: PlinkIdle
3684530.short_description: PlinkIdle is a retro-inspired game with an idle/incremental spin on a classic ball drop mechanic. Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

4367760.name: The Ice is Watching
4367760.short_description: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

4442840.name: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood
4442840.short_description: Jesse Turner, a 29-year-old employee of an insurance company, moves to a neighboring state after being assigned to a local branch. As he settles into his new place, he encounters unusual events that soon turn his life into a real nightmare.

4534190.name: Dave's House
4534190.short_description: In this frantic first-person co-op horror, answer the phone before Grandma eats you! Cook the food exactly as ordered, or she’ll eat you! Throw the food on the table and hide—don’t let it fall, or she'll eat you! If she finds you, RUN! If she catches you... don't get eaten!

4559960.name: Subsomnia
4559960.short_description: Explore an ever-changing dream universe in this 2.5D action roguelite. Wield your slingshot, solve physics-based ricochet puzzles, and traverse procedural worlds. Every magical object is a gateway to a new dream: will you reach the source?

4721020.name: The Last Ores
4721020.short_description: Dig the earth, collect ores and sell them to upgrade your equipment. Explore a mysterious depths. And the deeper you go… the more you realize something ancient has been waiting for you down there, in the dark, for a very long time.

4816210.name: Neon Blackfall
4816210.short_description: Build your deck, survive the Blackout, and fight for control of Neurovale. A fast-paced card game with 75 single-player chapters and online multiplayer battles. Lead one of four rival factions and adapt as the city changes between the Neon and Blackfall eras.

4878220.name: DashBreaker
4878220.short_description: From breaking asteroids to piercing massive warships, grow your small craft into a force to be reckoned with. DashBreaker is an active incremental game: dash through enemies, gather resources, and buy permanent upgrades. Unlock new abilities and wipe out more enemies with every dash.

4883060.name: Nanoquarium
4883060.short_description: A whisper-quiet aquarium that lives in the corner of your screen. Collect 200+ real-world fish across tropical, coldwater and reef tanks, breed them for rare strains, run a whole fishroom, and let the tank tick over while you work. No pressure, no fail state — just your fish, drifting.

4990890.name: Where The Light Sleeps
4990890.short_description: A 7-minute dreamlike narrative adventure set among the ancient stones of Matera, Italy. Enter a young girl's dream in search of her grandmother, wandering through a strange and haunting world inhabited by unsettling, peculiar souls.

5013130.name: Cellar Cleanup Simulator
5013130.short_description: Cellar Cleanup Simulator is a relaxing single-player simulation where you organize hundreds of bottles in a legendary cellar. Place bottles on shelves with realistic physics, upgrade skills, manage the power of drunkenness, and restore the cellar to its former glory.

5028910.name: PlayCard Football
5028910.short_description: A football strategy card game where you are the coach and the cards are your plays. Level up your coach with perks, use your team's roster to pick the best play possible against your opponent. You manage your team, the recruits, their development from high school to college and the pros.

5038400.name: JOINT LIABILITY
5038400.short_description: Multiplayer blackjack in a bar that never closes. Keep your buzz burning or die of sobriety, fling your empties at the other players, and outlast every gambler at the table.

5053650.name: Colsword
5053650.short_description: COLSWORD is a logic puzzle game where you paint cubes in the right sequence using enchanted colored swords.

5059340.name: Hush Piñata
5059340.short_description: She got tired of being hit, blindfolded herself and came back thirsty for revenge. A horror-comedy party game for up to 9 players, the blind Piñata hunts by sound, and even your voice on the mic lights a silhouette in her darkness. Do the chores quietly and rip off her tail before she notices.

5135400.name: Hunt The Ducks
5135400.short_description: Shoot ducks, grab the cash, upgrade, repeat. Hunt The Ducks is a fast, addictive incremental shooter where you grow stronger every round: turn a calm sky into a storm of feathers and cash with crits, exploding ducks and chain reactions. Grow your hunting map step by step.

5262310.name: The Returns Desk: A Cozy Library
5262310.short_description: A cozy tidy-up game for VR. Put 864 books back where they belong in a Victorian rotunda library, by hand. Every cover tells you its wing, its row and its slot, and nothing sorts itself. Finished rows open new wings and bring back the weather and the hours of the day. No timers, no fail state.

5270410.name: AUROK
5270410.short_description: Free-to-play action arena and co-op campaign. Pick Warrior, Archer, Mage or Barbarian, summon beasts that fight at your side, build a clan and brawl in 12-player free-for-all, 6v6 teams and Titan War. 10 co-op stages with bosses. macOS, Windows and Linux.

5313470.name: Figure Me Out
5313470.short_description: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

5325180.name: Little Pagan Land
5325180.short_description: Restore a magical glade and grow a forest at the bottom of your screen! Gather berries and coins, feed and pet magical creatures. Some roam by day, others emerge at night - and life in the glade carries on while you go about your day.

5365030.name: Dreadmarch TD
5365030.short_description: Hold the road through ten cursed lands. Dreadmarch TD is a dark fantasy tower defense game with 50 campaign stages, branching tower talents, and an endless Maelstrom. Build your defenses, break the next wave, and return to the campfire with another story to tell.

5435120.name: PrintMarket
5435120.short_description: Build and manage your own 3D printing shop. Buy printers, load colorful filaments, produce and sell models, and reinvest in your workshop. Organize your space, manage electricity and materials, and grow from your first machine to an automated production line.

282070.name: This War of Mine
282070.short_description: In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle.

553420.name: TUNIC
553420.short_description: Explore a land filled with lost legends, ancient powers, and ferocious monsters in TUNIC, an isometric action game about a small fox on a big adventure.

972660.name: Spiritfarer®: Farewell Edition
972660.short_description: Spiritfarer® is a cozy management game about dying. As ferrymaster to the deceased, build a boat to explore the world, care for your spirit friends, and release them into the afterlife. The Spiritfarer Farewell Edition includes the heartwarming base game and three major content updates.

979070.name: Just Die Already
979070.short_description: Just Die Already is an old people mayhem sandbox game created by the designers of Goat Simulator. You are old and angry and you've just been kicked out of your retirement home. How will you survive in a world that wants you to Just Die Already?

1062830.name: Embr
1062830.short_description: Fight fires for fun and profit in this unpredictable and frantic multiplayer game. Team up with friends, take on daily challenges and climb to the top of the corporate firefighting ladder. More than one way to become a hero!

1127500.name: Mini Motorways
1127500.short_description: Mini Motorways is a strategy simulation game about designing the road map for a growing city. Build a traffic network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your roads and place your motorways to get everyone where they need to go. How long can you keep the city moving?

1455840.name: Dorfromantik
1455840.short_description: Dorfromantik is a peaceful building strategy and puzzle game where you create a beautiful and ever-growing village landscape by placing tiles. Explore a variety of colorful biomes, discover and unlock new tiles and complete quests to fill your world with life!

1582930.name: Constellations
1582930.short_description: Connect the stars to reveal each constellation in a minimalist puzzle game inspired by all 88 real-world constellations. Revisit your discoveries in the Catalogue, play at your own pace and enjoy the journey through an imagined sky.

1669180.name: Demon Source
1669180.short_description: Demon Source is a soulslike roguelike game with procedural generated dungeons. Try new builds each run. Gather the Source to unlock new items and abilities. Solve the mystery of seven inhabitants of the Church. Try the Ultimate Challenge with great classical music. It is made by one person!

1779750.name: The House Before
1779750.short_description: You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

1786720.name: Entropic Decay
1786720.short_description: After being caught up in a mysterious experiment on an alien pathogen brought to earth on a meteor you gain unexpected abilities, but are now property of an unethical mega corporation hell bent on weaponizing the very thing that's keeping you alive. Survive a world falling into Entropic Decay.....

1892100.name: HEART ABYSS
1892100.short_description: Heart Abyss is a brutal action-platformer inspired by Japan during the 17th and 18th centuries. Wake up your inner beast and take vengeance on those who put a collar around your neck. Find your sister and uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of all jinkos.

1958220.name: WitchSpring R
1958220.short_description: WitchSpring R is a story-driven RPG combining elements of collecting, simulation, and battling. Experience the joy of training a young witch and accompany her on a grand adventure!

2218060.name: Backdraft
2218060.short_description: The deckbuilding brawler. Backdraft is a hero vs hero roguelike battle for board control. Draft your deck, summon your minions, and unleash game-flipping combos. Conquer the six realms solo, or challenge your friends online.

2780850.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
2780850.short_description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

3419430.name: Bongo Cat
3419430.short_description: Bongo cat needs your help. Bongo cat needz more hatz!!! Every time you press a key, Bongo cat will punch your taskbar. Type, click, play, work to collect more points. Which hats will you find?

3503350.name: Stick N' Sheep
3503350.short_description: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

3636770.name: Servant of the Lake
3636770.short_description: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.

3645540.name: HAVKER-MAN X
3645540.short_description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

3686580.name: Repel The Rifts
3686580.short_description: Repel the Rifts is a roguelite tower defense game where you lead a commander through an alien world, uncovering new terrain each wave, drafting powerful upgrades, and constructing defenses to hold back the chaos.

3760370.name: Kick
3760370.short_description: Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it?

3793800.name: Pulse Drive
3793800.short_description: Tap to the beat to build speed! Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with a rhythm element. Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

3832030.name: BOOST VECTOR EX
3832030.short_description: RUN FAST. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

3889990.name: rest: in a dark room
3889990.short_description: Two misanthropic teenagers attempt to be reborn through the world of sensory deprivation. A visual novel full of death, drugs, and dolphins.

3891470.name: Construction Store Simulator
3891470.short_description: Build and run your own construction supply store from the ground up! Arrange products, keep shelves stocked, serve customers, manage employees, set prices and expand your store. Grow from a small shop into a thriving business and make your store the go-to place for builders!

3934270.name: How Many Dudes? The Roguelike Autobattler
3934270.short_description: How many dudes does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out in this roguelike dudebuilder where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles.

3950000.name: Factory Works Idle
3950000.short_description: Build an automated industrial empire from stone tools to singularity tech. Click, automate, and research through 10 eras, then breach reality to conquer parallel dimensions with unique rules, resources, and threats. Idle factory builder with deep prestige and cross-dimensional logistics.

3986230.name: Radiant Starlets
3986230.short_description: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

4134310.name: Saraab: Beyond The Veil
4134310.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel about healing, where saving your brother means facing your own demons. Elham’s search pulls her through visions and entities rooted in Arabian folklore, and family secrets that should have stayed buried.

4225280.name: Corpus et Spiritus
4225280.short_description: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder, where you must break free of a demonic pact... before your partner kills you. Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans, forming combos that will save your body, spirit and soul!

4410360.name: HOLD MY WHEEL
4410360.short_description: You need to visit grandma - twin brothers, apocalypse, and all. Keep the bus running, and try not to eat your friends when the hunger hits.

4430260.name: Beat For Speed
4430260.short_description: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.

4430560.name: Survivor Joe Lost Island
4430560.short_description: A 2D action platformer with guns, a surprisingly useful plunger, roguelike runs, co-op and 8-player deathmatch.

4503110.name: Circuit Pulse
4503110.short_description: Circuit Pulse is a circuit puzzle game. Route glowing energy through cables and components on a board. Split, merge, and time pulses to power targets and trigger chain reactions across a board of escalating challenges.

4508290.name: Lucky Punk: a push your luck Deckbuilder
4508290.short_description: Push your luck and beat the odds in this roguelike deckbuilder that always shows your chances of failing. How much are you willing to risk? Survive and thrive in a vibrant eco-dystopia … or don’t. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ Gather supplies and grow your community in the post-apocalypse. Do you feel lucky, Punk? 💀

4537030.name: Rhythm Roll
4537030.short_description: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

4539850.name: Magic Portals
4539850.short_description: A fast, elegant card game of elemental drafting. Draw from the shared Animus, forge crystals, and ignite sleeping portals. Blue attunes, Purple pays, Green multiplies, Yellow improvises. First to seven portals ends the duel - but only the sharpest planner wins. Solo vs AI or online duels.

4548830.name: SCRAPBOX
4548830.short_description: SCRAPBOX is a physics-based sandbox where you build vehicles from scrap, weld them together, and take on challenging tracks. Play solo, team up with friends in co-op, or compete online against other players and teams.

4557840.name: Lots of Axos
4557840.short_description: Axolotls are nearly extinct. Your lab is their last hope. Build tanks, hatch axolotls, discover endless variations and help introduce them to new habitats across the globe

4587130.name: Green Field Cube Island
4587130.short_description: Green Field Cube Island is a 3D action RPG. Step into the role of Chodnii, cross the mysterious teleportation portals scattered across Cube Island, explore wildly different worlds, hone your skills, defeat dangerous enemies, and ultimately find a way to escape Cube Island.

4589160.name: Aptamirror
4589160.short_description: Aptamirror is a meditative physics-based puzzle game inspired by molecular biology. Manipulate RNA strands by grabbing, mutating, cleaving, and ligating to match increasingly complex target structures. Challenge yourself with 50 handcrafted puzzles designed by a PhD Biochemist. Think. Fold. Repeat.

4611110.name: Beyond The Abandoned
4611110.short_description: Climb through the shifting realms of your mind, confronting hazards, enemies, and risky decisions on your ascent to regain consciousness.

4616300.name: Celestial Routes
4616300.short_description: A third-person space survival game where seamless planet landings meet debt, fuel costs, fines, taxes, base ownership, and rebellion.

4635950.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy!
4635950.short_description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

4700280.name: Ironfields
4700280.short_description: A single-player RTS where you capture existing structures instead of building a base from scratch, and success comes more from good decisions than fast reactions.

4736470.name: Dead Sector
4736470.short_description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

4757720.name: The Wake Event
4757720.short_description: Awaken aboard a silent orbital research station. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover the crew's fate, and survive the growing influence of ARGUS, the station's ever-watchful AI.

4806050.name: Gatos Adventure
4806050.short_description: Gatos Adventure is a single player, stealth like adventure - puzzle solving game. You are trying to escape the Water Cities and in the process collect as many balls of yarn as you can, to buy a place on a vessel that is set to take you to the newly emerging patches of land.

4828340.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
4828340.short_description: There is no tutorial. And there won't be. I believe in you. I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can. You are snake who eats apples. j/k You want to escape the grid loop. BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

4832630.name: Royale Smith
4832630.short_description: Open your shop as a novice blacksmith and raise your reputation all the way to royalty. Assassins, archers, knights, and peasants will visit your shop as customers, demanding common, rare, or legendary swords, axes, daggers, bows, arrows, and various other goods.

4841590.name: Dungebra
4841590.short_description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

4844510.name: Wisp: Elemental Conflict
4844510.short_description: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

4886450.name: Hexzen
4886450.short_description: A hexagonal logic puzzle game set against shifting skies. Use logic alone to read the clues and clear each board. Master a handcrafted campaign, enjoy infinite custom puzzles, and shape your own challenges with the built-in level editor.

4901160.name: Hollow
4901160.short_description: Hollow is a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by old-school dungeon crawlers. Descend beneath a cursed mining town, battle the dead, collect loot, build your character through abilities, and uncover the fallen angel buried below.

4908640.name: THW's Calcudoku
4908640.short_description: Fan of Sudoku, logic or puzzles? Try THW's Calcudoku, the most addictive logic game ever according to THW. Unlimited puzzles, no ads, one low price, can it really be true! Yes! Whether you've never heard of Calcudoku, Mathdoku, Kenken or you're an expert, THW's has unlimited puzzles for you.

4926560.name: Path to Power
4926560.short_description: Path to Power is a political turn-based strategy game with visual novel elements. Choose your candidate, implement reforms, strike deals, manage resources, contain protests, and pave your way to the pinnacle of power in 1992 Kazakhstan.

4940850.name: Kachow Kart Racing
4940850.short_description: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!

4951840.name: Infi-Knight
4951840.short_description: A dark fantasy desktop-companion incremental that idles while you work, play, or browse. Play as a Knight cursed with immortality locked in endless battle against the undead. Grow stronger with every death, uncover the curses' secrets and the Knight's dark past, then break the cycle of undeath.

4952090.name: SOLITAIRE.EXE: A Roguelike on the Night Shift
4952090.short_description: Remember Windows Solitaire? Build outrageous combos in a solitaire roguelike, then open ZONE.EXE and destroy your friends in real-time card mayhem. Install plugins, beat the quota and survive the performance reviews. Your night shift starts here.

4959060.name: Legacy Miner
4959060.short_description: A 2D mining game about digging your way off a dead planet. Drill deep for rare ores, dodge lava and gas pockets, upgrade your rig, then pool your haul with friends to smelt bars, craft parts, and build the rocket that gets your crew home. Solo or 1–16 players.

4982380.name: STUFFED: Two Foot Hero
4982380.short_description: Become a two-foot-tall teddy bear in this VR wave shooter where you wield homemade weapons, build defences, and protect a little girl from her nightmares. Play solo or online in up to 4 player co-op.

4989280.name: Light Source
4989280.short_description: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

4990680.name: Terminidle
4990680.short_description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal.

4996850.name: Beatlash: Survival
4996850.short_description: A horde survivor that plays your music. Thousands of enemies, all moving to the beat, and when the drop hits, so do you. Put on your favourite song and watch the whole screen come apart in time with it.

5015250.name: Hearts Extreme
5015250.short_description: The classic card game Hearts, rebuilt as a solo puzzle. Every level sets a different goal for you to hit. Ten decks, each built from a different set of cards, played at 4, 5 or 6 player tables. And a ranked game where you compete with players around the world.

5027590.name: Domino Descent
5027590.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is a box of dominoes. Chain them, paint them, curse them, and build a multiplier that runs away with itself. Twelve floors down, something is waiting on every third one. The stairs keep going after that.

5027770.name: 1.44MB RESCUE
5027770.short_description: Write Python-style code to program repair patchers and rescue a corrupting 1.44MB floppy sector by sector. Start with four commands; every file you restore unlocks loops, variables, functions and lists, until your programs bring all 1,474,560 bytes back to life. The whole game fits on one floppy.

5028050.name: Traffic Architect
5028050.short_description: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.

5049210.name: Spark of Tales
5049210.short_description: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

5058710.name: The Abyss’s Last Breath
5058710.short_description: The Abyss’s Last Breath: blends survival, escape‑room gameplay and immersive simulation into a unique psychological horror experience. You control John, the only volunteer in a secret mission to descend to the edge of the Earth’s core.

5062020.name: House of the Lost: Revived
5062020.short_description: House of the Lost: Revived is a top-down action roguelike built for players who grew up clearing rooms, dodging traps, and learning from every death. Each run is a new house, a new build, and a new chance to craft absurd weapons and get a little further before the House gets you.

5077680.name: Last Exit Diner: The Last Train
5077680.short_description: Defend an armoured diner train through six-minute runs across ten hostile biomes. Aim the Dreadnought cannon, deploy bombs, survive flying monsters, and choose rail upgrades while automatic roof guns keep the Last Train moving.

5089320.name: ONE LAST BEAM
5089320.short_description: Aim your flashlight. Let your weapons fire. Survive escalating zombie hordes in this objective-driven survivor roguelite. Restore the power grid, evolve your arsenal, and reach dawn—but brighter light attracts more danger.

5095030.name: Colorizing: Sunrise
5095030.short_description: A relaxing color-by-numbers game with a wide variety of pictures for every taste. Enjoy the simple pleasure of coloring pixels and watching each picture come to life.

5100020.name: Horde Up Ahead: Survivors TD
5100020.short_description: Tower Defense against massive zombie hordes. Build turrets, defend your tower, and discover roguelite and survivor-like progression.

5100510.name: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game
5100510.short_description: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

5106940.name: Rind Town
5106940.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every customer’s order is a puzzle. Build the right juice from up to five ingredient cards, blend it, and chase scores that grow until they stop fitting on screen. Become the juice master of an anime town.

5119140.name: Midnight Rogues
5119140.short_description: Build the sequence that fights for you in this roguelike auto-battler. Buy cards and arrange them across your board, then watch a timer activate them in order. Change their placement to create powerful combinations and take down The City’s corrupted superheroes.

5122860.name: Broken Rift: Dominion
5122860.short_description: Lead a fractured human frontier in a 4X strategy game powered by a fully offline, locally embedded LLM. Build colonies, design warships and tanks, command tactical battles, and face rival empires that plan, remember, negotiate, and wage war without relying on the cloud.

5123700.name: TRACE//5
5123700.short_description: Explore an office swallowed by darkness with only a camera to guide you, photographing and reporting traces of spirits in this short psychological horror game. Use flash and night vision to uncover anomalies. But not every anomaly is something you should photograph.

5147670.name: Rolling Fortress
5147670.short_description: Command a colossal mobile fortress through a 10-sector post-apocalyptic campaign. Aim its cutting laser, manage automated heavy weapons, intercept enemy salvos, salvage scrap, and build a devastating arsenal between escalating waves.

5160780.name: Fly Chicken Fly
5160780.short_description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

5163190.name: Tumble Tavern
5163190.short_description: Farkle with enchanted runes. Throw six dice, bank your points or push your luck, and cast the runestone that turns a losing throw around. Take on 12 tavern regulars, run the roguelite gauntlet, or pass the dice to a friend on the same screen.

5168430.name: 4:12 AM
5168430.short_description: December 1999, the eve of Y2K. Twelve nights as the 911 operator of a dying Pennsylvania coal town. Speak with your own voice; a fully offline local AI plays every caller. Every night at 4:12 AM the phone rings: a girl missing for fifteen years. Who lives and who is lost depends on how you answer.

5186230.name: TERRITORY SCRAMBLE
5186230.short_description: Step, surround, conquer! Claim hexagonal tiles by stepping on them, then enclose areas to capture them at once. Fight for bases and cannons with weapons and items in fast-paced, top-down territory battles. Play online with up to 16 players across 2-4 teams, or take on bots.

5190490.name: One More Floor
5190490.short_description: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

5199430.name: PLOW
5199430.short_description: Drive an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Shred enemy fire, crush corrupted Christmas toys, overheat outrageous weapons, and upgrade your machine across five escalating winter regions.

5205430.name: AI Says
5205430.short_description: A rage game where you control your character only through an AI chat. No WASD. The AI can't see the deadly test chambers, but you can. Give precise instructions or die trying.

5209220.name: Atom By Atom
5209220.short_description: Build a factory around a black hole. Extract elements, route atoms through Matter Tubes, bond them using valence-driven chemistry, and scale precise molecular production lines atom by atom.

5210430.name: Break the Piñatas
5210430.short_description: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

5210500.name: No Scope CEO
5210500.short_description: No Scope CEO is an esports FPS team management game where you start from nothing with a single goal: become world number one. Recruit and coach your players, manage your budget and sponsors, live with the consequences of your choices, and watch your decisions come to life during matches.

5223600.name: Potrero - Football life sim
5223600.short_description: You are a footballer, straight from the youth ranks until your last season. One decision at a time: when to shoot, when to pass, what to say to the press. A whole career decided by what you choose, and a little by your luck.

5245950.name: Main Bastion
5245950.short_description: As darkness deepens and monsters emerge from their shadowed dens, the fate of humanity hangs by a thread. Take command of the last bastion! Build cunning traps, merge towers, choose unique upgrade cards, and level up your defenders. Can you hold the walls against dragons and their hordes?

5266240.name: Potato Please
5266240.short_description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

5291360.name: Solo Cards
5291360.short_description: Nine independent solo card games, all played with a single classic 54-card deck. Survive a frozen wreck, build a skyline, infiltrate a spy network, step into an underground ring or run a chic pastry salon: each game brings its own rules and tactical tension.

5319550.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex
5319550.short_description: 《Text Loot Codex》 is a loot-driven action RPG where the battlefield is built from text. Position, dodge, and cast abilities, then collect loot to forge a build that’s uniquely yours. You might just be the next Chaos Overlord!

5321070.name: Chopsticks
5321070.short_description: Move rice from one bowl to another, one grain at a time, with a pair of physics-driven chopsticks. Pinch, lift, carry, and try not to knock anything over. Every run is timed and ranked, twenty challenges wait on the same counter, and there are ten thousand grains.

5321820.name: Liani
5321820.short_description: Who is Liani? Where is Liani? Every obstacle will test you. Every step will lead you into the unknown. Remember, all you have to do to keep moving forward is to never give up.

5324770.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
5324770.short_description: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!

5335160.name: NIGHTWARD
5335160.short_description: Your mother was a night nurse. A month after her funeral, a hospital closed for twelve years calls your phone. Follow her route through Sislidere, one sealed building at a time, and learn who was kept awake there - and why. Some of them only move when you look away.

5336550.name: Hivetide
5336550.short_description: Hold a mining outpost on an alien world while thousands of insects pour through the rock tunnels like a flood. Place towers on the high ground, aim their firing arcs, and spend the biomass from every run, won or lost, on upgrades that let you hold a little longer next time.

5361870.name: Tessera
5361870.short_description: A calm, craft-first jigsaw game. Feel every piece: seven interlocking cut styles across four board shapes, including grid, hexagonal, triangular, and organic Voronoi, from a few dozen pieces to 1,000+. Daily puzzles, shareable codes, and curated museum masterworks.

5363250.name: In Triplicate
5363250.short_description: An idle game written in immaculate bureaucratic prose. Stamp matters, staff the counters, file for Reorganization and feed the office horse per Form OH-1. Processing continues in your absence, as required by policy. Inquiries will not be accepted.

5377890.name: Gnome Miners
5377890.short_description: Drill, sell, dig deeper: online co-op mining for up to 8 players. Raid procedural caves, build your own guns, climb into a mech and hunt a fire-breathing boss at the bottom of the pit. Just one more drill. Hats are mandatory.

5406260.name: Moonlit Cat Diner
5406260.short_description: A rainy night, a little diner at the end of the alley. Cat customers take a seat, place an order, and open up as you play — six solitaire games, Shisen-Sho, and six puzzle rules. Every story you hear fills your cat codex, and every coin you earn goes into your own diner.

5419760.name: EscapeFromSeoul
5419760.short_description: Explore, fight, and extract from a Seoul built from text and symbols. A real-time, top-down PvE extraction shooter for solo play or online co-op with up to 3 players. Scavenge gear, customize weapons, complete contracts, and upgrade your hideout.

5423420.name: 東方異線境 ~ Touhou: Glitched Border
5423420.short_description: Stop to shoot. Draw to cast! Restore an overlapping Gensokyo in this Touhou action roguelite. Choose from six heroines, draw Spell Cards with your mouse, and face bosses from other timelines.

5434050.name: No Sleep Tonight
5434050.short_description: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

5442520.name: Blocade
5442520.short_description: Race your pawn across the board and drop walls to cut off your rival, but never seal them in. Blocade is a free two-player strategy board game: ranked matches against real people on PC and mobile, a daily 128-player tournament, puzzles and a ladder of bots.

5446300.name: VOID SOAR
5446300.short_description: One light. One step. A flight without words. Into the void — do not look back.

5456900.name: Jawless Fish Races
5456900.short_description: A quiz race for kids. Every right answer gives your Sacabambaspis a burst of speed, so the faster you answer, the faster you swim. Race the computer or up to three friends online. Math, spelling, telling time, money, science and geography, at three levels.

5459170.name: Bustbound
5459170.short_description: Make 21 your weapon. Bustbound turns blackjack into a roguelike deckbuilder: hit, stand, or double down to win turn-based battles. Combine effect cards and relics, choose your route through six stages, and face the Joker Couple.

5461530.name: THE LAST STONE
5461530.short_description: Up to 100 million stones, one tiny toy shovel and one hidden diamond. Dig, haul and sell stones to afford better gear in this absurd first-person incremental game. Start with a yellow plastic shovel. The diamond could be in your very first successful scoop.

5461840.name: Cosmic Puzzles
5461840.short_description: Relax with an astronomy themed jigsaw puzzle game: 100+ detailed puzzles & 6+ hrs of cosmic music. Customize shapes, choose 10-500 pieces, and use modifiers for endless variety.

558990.name: Opus Magnum
558990.short_description: Opus Magnum is the latest open-ended puzzle game from Zachtronics, the creators of SpaceChem, Infinifactory, and SHENZHEN I/O. Design and build machines that assemble potions, poisons, and more using the alchemical engineer’s most advanced tool: the transmutation engine!

846770.name: DYSMANTLE
846770.short_description: Ascend from your shelter. Ruin everything. Escape the wretched island. ⚔️🔨🎣🌱🌵🍰 Explore. Fight. Level up. Survive. Gather. Craft. Harvest. Hunt. Build. Farm. Solve puzzles. Fish. Cook. Live. Enjoy the bittersweet post-apocalypse.

1465470.name: The Crust
1465470.short_description: Build and automate a lunar colony that Earth depends on. Mine regolith, run conveyor-and-drone factories above and below the surface, manage colonists, trade with rival Earth factions — and play a story campaign with multiple endings.

1494420.name: Silica
1494420.short_description: Silica blends FPS and RTS in epic, photorealistic battles. Choose to fight on the ground or command from above as humans or aliens. Dive into thrilling multiplayer combat or master strategic command. Are you ready to survive and conquer?

1547890.name: Let's Build a Zoo
1547890.short_description: It's time to Build a Zoo! Construct and decorate enclosures, buy and breed animals, hire zookeepers and vets... then try your hand at DNA splicing, and stitch together over 300,000 different types of animal. This can only go smoothly...

1745510.name: Lunacid
1745510.short_description: Cast into the Great Well, unwanted by the world above. You delve the dark in search of the Old One, your last salvation. Lunacid is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler inspired by Shadow Tower and King’s Field.

2060590.name: Wilmot Works It Out
2060590.short_description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

2386910.name: Starshapes
2386910.short_description: A calm and highly satisfying puzzle game about connecting shapes to create 3D star constellations.

2794590.name: Scam Line
2794590.short_description: Scam Line is a 4–8 player social deception game where your party will face different challenges. Become a liar, a manipulator, a cheater, or find your own path to victory

2847290.name: The Maze: In Dark
2847290.short_description: With only a flashlight to rely on, secure your objective in the dark factory and escape while avoiding the gaze of 'Him', who roams the factory at random. Overcome the extreme fear of the unknown brought on by darkness and complete your assigned mission safely.

2885890.name: Gloom Break
2885890.short_description: A relentless action-puzzle game about escaping a strange pit.

3002130.name: Theos: Cities Of Myth
3002130.short_description: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens’ needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

3035120.name: Is This Seat Taken?
3035120.short_description: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

3082430.name: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek
3082430.short_description: An epic action RPG with couch co-op. On their path to revenge Enya and Kyra will throw swords, cast spells, vanquish armies and become heroes.

3273260.name: Lost Host
3273260.short_description: Can a toy car become the hero of a video game? One night, its owner mysteriously vanished without a trace. Left alone in the quiet room, this little car sets out on a spooky and mysterious journey - to find the boy...

3325390.name: Slumber Realm
3325390.short_description: Battle your childhood fears in a 90s-soaked dice roguelike. One die roll triggers your entire build. Chain wild combos, fight broccoli, and decorate your bedroom with nostalgic relics.

3339970.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
3339970.short_description: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

3424800.name: Code of Shadows
3424800.short_description: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced roguelite where you don't just deploy drones, you command them. Switch modes mid-fight, fuse drones into stronger ones, and cut through rift-spawned hordes across collapsing dimensions.

3509080.name: Forged: Reconquest
3509080.short_description: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players sets in medieval era. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

3596560.name: Stack & Brew
3596560.short_description: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

3639650.name: Kotama and Academy Citadel
3639650.short_description: In the Academy Citadel, strength reigns supreme: only the most powerful survive and thrive. Fight your way through the high-tech Academy in your quest to get the highest of honors for a student, and uncover secrets that can save it in its direst crisis in this 2.5D side-scrolling Metroidvania.

3779560.name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
3779560.short_description: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

3855530.name: Turning Manor
3855530.short_description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to uncover what is happening at Turning Manor.

3891160.name: CRYMELIGHT
3891160.short_description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

4135930.name: Scared Crow
4135930.short_description: Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.

4242730.name: Sound System
4242730.short_description: Play the songs you love, including the ones you wrote. Sound System is a rock rhythm game for guitar, bass, and drums, with a built-in chart editor that turns any track into a playable chart. Chase gold in Pro Mode or just jam in Classic. If you can hear it, you can play it.

4280450.name: Diskette Dungeon
4280450.short_description: A magical Diskette opens a portal in your office, pulling you into endless dungeons where survival depends on adapting, fighting, and collecting corrupted data to unlock the next world. With a wide variety of powers and weapons, every run offers a different challenge.

4315680.name: Suixun 01: The Last Customer
4315680.short_description: A linear paranormal mystery visual novel driven by dynamic text presentation. As timid but earnest rookie Mao-Rabbit, explore a mall after closing, rescue a customer the night guard cannot see, and uncover the anomaly rules already at work. No branches or bad endings.

4321120.name: The Curator
4321120.short_description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

4326740.name: Node Crown
4326740.short_description: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here! Have fun!

4334530.name: Cold Rails
4334530.short_description: Cold Rails is a horror adventure set on a train. You work as a bartender, serving drinks to passengers and uncovering a story as a mysterious woman in a dress stalks the train.

4358660.name: Hull Rupture
4358660.short_description: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

4363370.name: Spincremental
4363370.short_description: Pull the lever, watch the reels, collect the symbols. Buy slot machines, unlock cursors, magnets, and cards that play for you, then upgrade everything through a deep skill tree. A cozy pixel-art incremental about turning one wooden slot into an automated jackpot empire.

4513920.name: Axomorph Idle
4513920.short_description: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. Journey through an idle adventure through growth, expansion, mutation, and transcendence stages. If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

4547060.name: Linear Chess
4547060.short_description: Chess on a single line of 21 squares. Rethink familiar tactics with adapted piece movement and win by checkmate or centre control. Play locally, challenge the AI or face another player online across four distinct 3D themes.

4555040.name: Sushiamo
4555040.short_description: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

4646650.name: Noodle Cable
4646650.short_description: The Noodle Cable Technologies welcome you in their company. Untangle and plug huge cables in room-sized puzzles and witness mind-altering surrealist environments.

4762960.name: Outbreak: Dead City
4762960.short_description: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

4770940.name: Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse
4770940.short_description: A short, singleplayer time-loop puzzle game in which you restore a lighthouse to prevent a shipwreck that has already happened. Hunted by shadows across an island, you unfold the lighthouse keeper’s tragic story and piece together a way to end the nightmare.

4802430.name: Cubus Tower
4802430.short_description: Cubus tower is a platformer game. Climb the Cubus tower and find what is waiting for you at its summit.

4811700.name: Mancalero
4811700.short_description: Plan one perfect move and watch it chain into millions of points. Mancalero is a roguelike built on Mancala, the board game of moving stones from pit to pit. Collect marbles that burn, multiply and swallow whole pits, build a combo engine and climb 8 tables, each with a boss that changes the rules.

4818140.name: Aetherantis Realm of Fates
4818140.short_description: Aetherlantis is a turn-based strategy board game blending resource gathering, territory expansion and fate cards. Explore the floating continent via dice rolls, construct settlements and cities, and turn matches around with fate cards. Enjoy couch tabletop gameplay with up to four local players.

4832510.name: Trolley Dilemma
4832510.short_description: Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.

4888210.name: FAIL GAMES
4888210.short_description: FAIL GAMES is a collection of brutally hard but simple minigames. Beat each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail and spend them on outfits and effects. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

4899480.name: Sanslo:Spin of the Three Kingdoms
4899480.short_description: A unique roguelite slot RPG inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Recruit legendary generals, build your army, unleash outrageous fantasy skills, and conquer the battlefield with strategy and luck in every spin.

4916010.name: Shorted
4916010.short_description: Balatro-style scoring on a 9×9 grid. Your deck becomes the board: trace same-color Packets into scoring shapes, install Patches that hack the rules, and rebuild the deck that refills the grid. Six Firewalls stand between you and an overloaded high score.

4917630.name: ERLIK
4917630.short_description: A survivors-like rooted in Turkic mythology. Every run drifts between two gods: feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal.

4920680.name: Warlapse
4920680.short_description: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

4927530.name: LIMINOID
4927530.short_description: LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

4931970.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
4931970.short_description: A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or settle in with 5,000 more puzzles, Easy to Expert.

4966560.name: SUPER GAHAKU
4966560.short_description: Draw directly in 3D space! Bring topics to life with your own 3D creations. Laugh at the hilarious results and guess what everyone was trying to draw! Imagination matters more than drawing skills. A party game where everyone can shine!

4982860.name: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing
4982860.short_description: Rise from illegal underground bouts to bareknuckle champion in a single-player boxing career where damage carries from fight to fight and can bring your career to an early end. Fight, upgrade your gym, climb the rankings, and see how far you can make it.

4996220.name: Dunjin
4996220.short_description: Dunjin is a roguelike dungeon-crawling deckbuilder where poker hands fuel your attacks and a d20 decides your fate. Discover unique heroes, endless runs, and 150+ game-warping relics on your journey to the bottom.

5024920.name: Desktop Slime Graveyard: Tap Reaper
5024920.short_description: Slimes are invading your desktop, and every keystroke becomes a powerful counterattack. Unlock all kinds of weapons, draw wildly inventive artifacts, and collect strange and wonderful slimes. Fight alone or team up with friends to give the slimes a beating!

5037200.name: just volleyball
5037200.short_description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

5047110.name: Wardspire
5047110.short_description: Arrows won't stop a draugr. Fire won't stop a giant. Every wave in Wardspire demands a different answer - and the tower you love most is the one that gets you killed. Norse tower defense with hard counters, permanent progression and an endless mode.

5049000.name: Yukizuki no Seisou
5049000.short_description: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream… An adventure-type visual novel from VODALES.

5072070.name: Souterrain
5072070.short_description: Roll the dice. Cheat fate. Break the house. Souterrain is a roguelike dice-and-card game where you manipulate colorful dice, build powerful combinations, and gamble everything on one more hand.

5079090.name: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War
5079090.short_description: Hold a WW1 trench against an endless, escalating horde. Build a squad from the cards luck deals you, manage your requisition, then choose your moment to go over the top. A grim, darkly funny real-time roguelike — branching campaign, deep upgrades, and a forever-Endless mode.

5091900.name: Prigod Idle
5091900.short_description: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

5094940.name: Cardsharp
5094940.short_description: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

5105470.name: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
5105470.short_description: A bullet-hell shoot 'em up meets hack-and-slash RPG. Become a valkyrie, weave through neon barrages under a sky of iron, hunt loot, forge gear, and fish, farm, cook between sorties. Can't dodge? Grind through it. Can? Chase top ranks. No stamina, no pay-to-win — buy once, play it all.

5111890.name: Weeping Souls
5111890.short_description: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.

5113760.name: Echo Mates
5113760.short_description: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.

5117340.name: Old Man's Sushi
