5117340.short_description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

5121140.name: Nozile
5121140.short_description: Nozile is a fast-paced hack-and-slash roguelike where you start with a fully realized build. Pick 2 styles, swap in real-time, absorb Stat Orbs directly from fallen enemies, and break the game in intense 5-minute runs.

5130070.name: Wonderful Time
5130070.short_description: Control time to manipulate the movement of objects in this third-person puzzle game. Use the flow of time to reach places that were once inaccessible. The reward you seek awaits you.

5139380.name: Marble Stars
5139380.short_description: Marble Stars is a challenging platformer made by one person. Explore 55 handcrafted levels suspended above the ocean, discover special abilities, speedrun each course to compete on the global leaderboards, and earn prestigious medals as you progress.

5141440.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle
5141440.short_description: Every hand must win. ALL-HU is a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up: read the wall, plan each draw and discard, and guide two — or four — hands to victory at once. 1,100+ solver-verified puzzles, including Steam-exclusive Gambit mode. No luck, no in-app purchases: pure tile logic.

5163960.name: TinyBriks
5163960.short_description: TinyBriks is a relaxing minimalist plastic brick building game where there are no objectives, no building instructions, no time pressure and no maximizing shareholder value. Make whatever YOU want. Create fantastic dioramas from a plethora of brick styles and colors. Your imagination is the limit.

5169720.name: Dialshift
5169720.short_description: Dialshift is a fast score-chasing arcade game played on one relentless ring. Every turn is also a hit. Read the targets, choose your route, and hold your nerve as seven modes twist the rules.

5176070.name: Bush League Baseball
5176070.short_description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, eight ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, and trade club codes with friends. One or two players.

5182840.name: Way Too Many Eggs
5182840.short_description: Way Too Many Eggs is an incremental game about turning a tiny chicken farm into egg-filled chaos. Collect eggs, grow your flock, hire helpers, crack giant eggs and unlock permanent upgrades in the skill tree!

5182970.name: Objecipher
5182970.short_description: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

5194660.name: Caesar: The Gallic Campaign
5194660.short_description: 58 BC. You are a nameless ranker of Rome's Tenth Legion, crossing eight years of Caesar's Gallic campaign at spear height. No turns: one click is your movement and your strike. Build out of affixes and runes, hunt the titled elites, and see eight chapters through to the epilogue.

5205270.name: Knight's Party
5205270.short_description: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

5208780.name: Find The Box
5208780.short_description: There is a box buried in a cube of a million blocks. Find it. Be Happy. Dig slow and relaxing, or fast and destructive: level up and pick spells and modifiers that change your playstyle. Beat your personal best, or race the world on global leaderboards. A cozy or crazy first-person digging game.

5211940.name: Nine Provinces
5211940.short_description: "The Nine Provinces" is an adventure-management text-based game. Set foot on the lands of the Nine Provinces, seek the ancient Nine Tripod Cauldrons, and encounter the moving tales that have been passed down through these realms. Different protagonists weave different stories.

5219330.name: Life Tycoon
5219330.short_description: A life management sim where you start from nothing and face 365 days of work, study, and risky choices. Unlock careers, improve your home, and manage money, health, and mood. Can you build a better life without going broke?

5221650.name: Heroes & Co.
5221650.short_description: Hire the worst misfits in town and form the perfect team to face every disaster. Your mission? Survive one full week. Get ready for seven days of cascading emergencies, exhausted heroes, and impossible choices to save the day.

5233410.name: Wildixir
5233410.short_description: Wildixir is a fantasy survivor roguelite about dangerous alchemy. Combine automatic spells, dodge growing hordes, and turn cleansed shrines into healing groves or deadly gardens. Unlock alchemists and confront the bosses of three corrupted lands.

5233480.name: Compactor Baron
5233480.short_description: Point and the hammer swings in this active incremental. Crush cans, toasters and safes into cubes, pay bills that grow as you earn, and build a bench of machines and a helper robot that work right alongside you.

5234980.name: Wickwood
5234980.short_description: A top-down pixel action game set across one long night. No crafting, no hunger, no inventory — just a bat, an axe, and a lantern burning down. The shrinking circle of light is the only clock you get. Find the parts for a dead car and drive out of Wickwood before the light goes.

5235010.name: TURF FIGHT
5235010.short_description: Command specials. Command throws. In a beat 'em up.

5238060.name: Lucky Shot VR
5238060.short_description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot VR is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

5243280.name: A Game About Picking Fruits
5243280.short_description: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

5260090.name: Event Horizon Research
5260090.short_description: A first-person sci-fi descent into a black hole. Study it from a research station, design and assemble your own capsule from real engines and hull materials, then pilot it through the accretion disk and past the event horizon. You have limited lives.

5338170.name: Magic Clicker
5338170.short_description: Blast through hordes with magic and grow wildly powerful! Play as Shiina in a mix of 3D action and clicker progression. Defeat enemies to upgrade and awaken spells, from Magic Ball to Laser Beam. Use Rebirth to grow stronger, and reach new heights of power with your little dragon companion!

5343850.name: I Hate Scalpers
5343850.short_description: I just hate scalpers. So I made a game about bonking them so they don't come back! Figure out who the scalpers and sitters are and BONK THEM! Duel people in Cut The Line and be the hero the city.

5344290.name: Make it! Karaage
5344290.short_description: Get ready for a delicious karaage-making challenge! Make tons of karaage and watch your food cart prosper!

5347500.name: Kamikaze Aliens
5347500.short_description: Welcome to Kamikaze Aliens, a game with no big bosses or awe-inspiring enemies—just you, your ship, and an endless horde of aliens spawned from randomized spawners that will make you see stars at the slightest touch!

5362330.name: Good Boy, Good Girl!
5362330.short_description: Train your loyal dog to fetch balls and frisbees across challenging parks, but watch out for wild dogs trying to disrupt your fun! Clear every park to reach the ultimate finale at the sunny beach.

5365860.name: Zombie BBQ House
5365860.short_description: Zombie BBQ House is an online co-op restaurant sim for 1–8 players. Spot disguised zombies. Butcher, grill, serve. Hit the wrong person, the police come. Burn it, dinner hits back. Made money? Casino's across the street. With friends, someone's always slacking and someone's always causing trouble.

5397550.name: Goninkan
5397550.short_description: A five-player trick-taking card game from Tsugaru, Japan. The two "Insiders" holding the trump Ace and the Joker battle three "Outsiders" for the picture cards. Play CPUs of different skill levels, race the clock in Time Attack, or take on the Daily Challenge.

5405590.name: Lazy Cat - Mini Game Collection
5405590.short_description: Take a cosy break with cute cats and 14 mini-games, from classic puzzles and solitaire to arcade favourites. Enjoy charming stylised visuals, relaxing music, and day and night themes. Pick a game, settle in, and let the everyday rush fade away.

5411580.name: Block Guy
5411580.short_description: Block Guys, giant walking war machines built from colored blocks, are marching on your base. Slide their blocks with the mouse, line up three or more of a color to clear them, and drop the Bloquians riding on top to the ground. Call in fire from your base and pop PSI balloons for special powers.

5428620.name: IMYEON : Yokai Survivor
5428620.short_description: A pixel-art survivors game where you fight swarms of yokai with old Korean weapons and shaman tools like the Horn Bow and Spirit Knives. Pick an upgrade on every level-up and fuse two maxed weapons into one. 6 stages, a 30-minute Endless mode, 20 heroes and 12 fusion weapons.

5446080.name: Deuce Agency 2027
5446080.short_description: Run a tennis agency, not a player. Scout unknown juniors, negotiate contracts and sponsorships, plan every player's season across a 52-week world tour, and give tactical orders between sets — a deep management sim built on how professional tennis really makes money.

5452520.name: Piratocon: Dig, Restore & Collect
5452520.short_description: A cozy first-person collecting game. Dig lost model ships out of a sunny beach dune, rebuild each one on the shelf of her kind aboard an old galleon and scrub her back to her true colours. No combat, no rush, just sand, sea and a collection that grows a little every day.

5460740.name: High Lance
5460740.short_description: Tap to flap. Higher lance wins. A one-button arcade game: ride a griffin over an endless world of floating ledges, unseat rival riders from above, and catch them as they parachute down to build a capture streak. Miss them, and they'll return a rank tougher. Five lands, each ending with a dragon.

5466620.name: 가문의 영광
5466620.short_description: A single-player idle RPG with classic K-MMORPG spirit and no paid gacha. Switch between nostalgic and painted visuals, hunt manually or automatically, and grow through loot, crafting, equipment enhancement, and family progression.

5479840.name: Village in Bloom
5479840.short_description: Build a new life on Grandpa Rıza’s farm in this cozy, single-player farming adventure. Grow crops, care for animals, fish, cook, craft, and fulfill your neighbors’ letters and orders on the way to the village fair.

5480070.name: Heroes of Underhollow
5480070.short_description: Descend into Underhollow, a turn-based tactical roguelike where the battlefield is your weapon. Ignite oil, electrify water, and shove enemies into hazards. Choose from three heroes, shape your build, and chart a dangerous route through four dungeon floors.

246620.name: Plague Inc: Evolved
246620.short_description: Plague Inc: Evolved is a unique mix of high strategy and terrifyingly realistic simulation. Your pathogen has just infected 'Patient Zero' - now you must bring about the end of human history by evolving a deadly, global Plague whilst adapting against everything humanity can do to defend itself.

269210.name: Hero Siege
269210.short_description: Hero Siege is a fast paced Pixel Art ARPG featuring an expansive roster of unique classes, deep build experimentation, and a player driven economy.

910550.name: MONO CHAMELEON
910550.short_description: Hide-and-seek, tag and prop hunt with a retro handheld look in four shades of olive and cream. Paint yourself into the walls, drop decoys, or slip from shadow to shadow in Tag. 2–10 players, 5 modes, bots. Built for streams: 239 audience seats, viewer votes and turns, plus a director mode.

985890.name: Streets of Rage 4
985890.short_description: Amongst the best beat’em up series ever created, jammin’ ‘90s beats and over the top street fighting, the iconic series Streets of Rage comes back with a masterful tribute to and revitalization of the classic action fans adore.

1361510.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
1361510.short_description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder’s Revenge reunites Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael as they kick shell in a beautifully realized beat ’em up.

1721110.name: Abyssus
1721110.short_description: Choose your loadout, blast through the corrupted denizens of a sunken civilization, and wield godly powers in Abyssus – a fast-paced 1-to-4 players FPS and roguelite brinepunk adventure.

1904480.name: Absolum
1904480.short_description: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

2460020.name: Soar Up The Charts
2460020.short_description: A fast-paced rhythm game and arcade-style rail shooter where music is your weapon! 🎸With tracks provided by Alden Ave and Keep Flying, be ready to turn it up and blast your way through those radio robots! 🎺

2542120.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
2542120.short_description: A brand-new side-scrolling entry to the NINJA GAIDEN series from the team behind Blasphemous, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound redefines the classic platformer saga in a spectacular, thrilling and challenging ninja adventure.

2802340.name: Ragdoll Robotics
2802340.short_description: Build ridiculous trap combinations, launch a helpless robot across the laboratory, and watch spectacular chain reactions unfold! Experiment with mines, spikes, turrets, and catapults to solve physics-based challenges and cause maximum chaos.

2831000.name: Faraway
2831000.short_description: Faraway is an endless procedurally generated, mastery-driven arcade game about a shooting star that creates constellations to stay alive.

2881370.name: Thank You For Your Application
2881370.short_description: Thank You for Your Application is a story-driven interview simulation game. After 15 rounds of interviews, you are reassigned as a junior interviewer, tasked with screening candidates’ resumes according to company requirements and issuing the appropriate thank letters.

3204330.name: County of Fortune
3204330.short_description: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

3299080.name: Snow Resort Simulator
3299080.short_description: Start with nothing but a ticket booth in the mountains. Clear snow, chop wood, crack ice off rooftops, all by hand, all in first person. Serve drinks, cook meals, repair ski gear, and turn a rundown mountain stop into a full-blown resort with a hotel, restaurant, bar, and shop.

3301840.name: fanxiu
3301840.short_description: Fan Xiu is an idle cultivation game. Break through realms while elixirs, artifacts, and rare treasures drop over time. Every item you earn can be freely listed and traded on the Steam Market — idle your way to immortality, and to real profit. Limited-time events regularly drop exclusive items

3476610.name: AI Clicker
3476610.short_description: Click Your Way to World Domination (Or Doom)! Welcome to AI Clicker, the only game where mindless clicking actually makes you smarter… or creates a future where AI replaces you!

3575280.name: Build A Bot
3575280.short_description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

3591900.name: Chivalware
3591900.short_description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

3810240.name: In Full Bloom
3810240.short_description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for the world around it. There is only one way.

3844580.name: Rosavane Borers LLC
3844580.short_description: Rosavane Borers LLC is a mining exploration simulator. Excavate underground caverns to uncover rare gems and valuable ores. Customize your miner, upgrade your tools, and delve ever deeper in a hand‑drawn pixel world!

4080030.name: The Message from Deep Space
4080030.short_description: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

4132280.name: PHUY
4132280.short_description: You’re a crew of hapless thieves with one job: rob a museum and make it out alive. Hunt for valuables, solve puzzles, and survive the locals. Just try not to become part of the exhibit. A co-op horror game for 1–4 players.

4146650.name: MUPO
4146650.short_description: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

4171800.name: Storm Grill
4171800.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as a grill and fight against the storm! Evaporate raindrops, earn coins, unlock new upgrades and skills, grow stronger until you can outlast the downpour.

4195140.name: PIX Football Manager
4195140.short_description: An online football manager. Scout talent from 350+ clubs, trust your eye to find the right players, and outbid rival managers in auctions. Build squad chemistry, shape your tactics, and face other managers’ clubs in weekly leagues, on your own schedule.

4235160.name: Traders Life Simulator
4235160.short_description: Run your own shop in a first-person trading sim where you buy low, negotiate smart deals, and sell for profit.

4252720.name: DERAIL
4252720.short_description: DERAIL is a horror anomaly game where instead of spotting anomalies you have to cleanse them with your camera to escape the loop.

4349320.name: Pre-Warp Age
4349320.short_description: A turn-based economic strategy game about settling space, from the first flight to the invention of the warp drive. Plan the development of your colonies, assign workers, research technologies and mine resources in randomly generated star systems.

4354830.name: Dark Alley
4354830.short_description: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett's shoes and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

4420660.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
4420660.short_description: YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

4446030.name: Stellar Smash
4446030.short_description: Save the universe from complete darkness by destroying bricks one by one in this brick breaking game. Challenge bosses, master ball control and upgrade your ship. Let the main character, Astra, guide you through the game.

4449510.name: Great Achievements
4449510.short_description: Great Achievements is an online multiplayer role-playing game that takes you to an epic world filled with swords and magic. Choose multiple roles and form your own team. Explore the vast continent with friends, challenge legendary dungeons, and write your own adventure legends.

4511690.name: Moto Rogue
4511690.short_description: Race your way up to world champion and show your true grit!

4551150.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
4551150.short_description: A binary decision-driven city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

4553100.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
4553100.short_description: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

4556050.name: Tzelem
4556050.short_description: The world is your playground, experiment to learn how it works. Tzelem (צֶלֶם) is an action dungeon-crawler, where you use cards to change the world, your weapon and yourself.

4564800.name: Dictatorship Simulator
4564800.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about manipulating a political simulation and becoming a dictator. Change how the political system works so it tears itself apart. 5% of profits donated to the godot and blender foundations.

4572120.name: Dirt Clicker
4572120.short_description: Start with a spoon and a dream. Dig for treasures, unlock upgrades, get help from friendly pals and flip tools to dig up mountains of dirt. Will you find out what secrets are hidden beneath the dirt?

4586230.name: Last Inspection
4586230.short_description: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside — all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

4593950.name: Gold Express
4593950.short_description: Jump gaps, grind rails and land flips in a fast-paced minecart runner. Collect gold, upgrade your gear and unlock carts, characters and hats as you ride through different biomes. Watch out for the Danger Train!

4633120.name: Voxotron
4633120.short_description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

4641190.name: Idle Golf
4641190.short_description: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.

4656560.name: Not My Son
4656560.short_description: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

4685680.name: Italian Street Food Simulator
4685680.short_description: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

4691400.name: Performance Review: Survivor
4691400.short_description: AI is taking your job and capitalism is trying to kill you. Fight back. This office roguelite throws hordes of coworkers and AI managers at you — snowball office supplies into a screen-clearing build and outlast 30 brutal years of reviews, debt, and firings. Clock in. Get rich. Retire. Maybe.

4714850.name: Sheepscape
4714850.short_description: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding: from your first muddy field to the open highlands.

4772200.name: Type Me Home
4772200.short_description: Type in commands with your keyboard to guide a lost baby lizard through wild platforming challenges and reunite it with its mama.

4794170.name: Swarmslam
4794170.short_description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

4835870.name: Table Of Truth
4835870.short_description: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

4865360.name: Novalex Project Zero
4865360.short_description: A turn-based car-company tycoon. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, undercut on price, and out-engineer a field that grows to 30 AI rivals across a century of motoring. Build the carmaker that lasts, or go bankrupt trying.

4914970.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
4914970.short_description: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.

4919460.name: THE UNREMEMBERED
4919460.short_description: A dark fantasy, choice-driven roguelite. The king died without an heir, four great houses and the court are fighting over the throne, and you're a sellsword who belongs to none of them. Swipe left or right to take or refuse jobs, and your choices change the events and endings that follow.

4931720.name: Camera 5
4931720.short_description: Five cameras. Five nights. One caretaker who's starting to notice too much. A slow-burn surveillance horror where the building lies to you — and the system does too.

4938660.name: LINE WARLORD
4938660.short_description: A real-time lane-defense roguelite. Spend rations to send troops down the line, stack relics, promote your units, and break the enemy stronghold with a different army every run.

4951310.name: FLIP OVER
4951310.short_description: FLIP OVER is a puzzle game where you flip tiles to turn every tile white. Flip tiles with different rules and enjoy puzzles in many forms.

4982990.name: Nova Survivors
4982990.short_description: Blast through endless alien hordes in space and climb the Steam leaderboards. Pick from 21 ships, each with its own weapon and ultimate, stack cards and weapon evolutions, and push through a 100-level campaign or endless Survival until your build breaks the game.

4992940.name: Rogue Belt
4992940.short_description: Fight through a storm-wracked asteroid belt in this top-down space roguelite, solo or in online co-op. Mix ships and weapons, choose an upgrade every minute, and face the boss after ten minutes. Break through to unlock new ships, weapons, and permanent upgrades.

5000880.name: Coverage
5000880.short_description: Grow to cover the board with your pieces--or absorb all of your opponent's. A board game similar to Othello and Ataxx, playable by up to 2 players online or offline, with a built-in board editor and 3 game modes! Relax with a classic experience or try a fast-paced simultaneous movement mode!

5004790.name: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
5004790.short_description: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

5013150.name: Nonet Concerto R
5013150.short_description: Blast through hordes of monsters with magic in this third-person 3D loot action game. Build your loadout from around 100 magic stones and take on 50+ stages solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Stream on Twitch or YouTube and your viewers' chat can trigger monster reinforcements and storms.

5017810.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
5017810.short_description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

5018790.name: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
5018790.short_description: No guns. No swords. No aiming. Your weapon is the path you walk. Enemies touching your trail get shredded — and the instant it closes into a loop, everything inside blows up at once. Survive 15 minutes, slay the boss, grow your charm deck — a survivors-like where walking IS attacking.

5040610.name: Moon Swarm
5040610.short_description: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

5042190.name: Retail Nation: My Supermarket
5042190.short_description: Build, customize and manage your own supermarket in this first-person retail simulation. Order stock, fill shelves, serve customers, manage and develop employees, and grow a small shop into a thriving supermarket.

5043660.name: DriveGear
5043660.short_description: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament. Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

5045430.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
5045430.short_description: Japanese anomaly-horror mystery at an inn on the afterlife's border. Obey each night's new rule as something creeps in; stare to note earlier guests' traces as it comes. By morning, write in the Register who they were, how they died. The rules never lie; a thing may pose as what the rules name.

5048700.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust
5048700.short_description: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

5051540.name: Continuum
5051540.short_description: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

5052450.name: Desktop Wallet Heroes
5052450.short_description: An intense idle RPG that unfolds right on your desktop! Desktop Wallet Heroes is an overlay idle RPG where characters endlessly hunt monsters at the bottom of your screen—without ever interrupting your work or web browsing. Continuously upgrade items to defeat enemies and rake in mountains of loot!

5063860.name: DeepCorp Rescue
5063860.short_description: DeepCorp Rescue is a physics-based arcade rescue game where you pilot a fragile rocket through dangerous caves, dodge traps, save workers, recover cargo, and land safely. Upgrade your ship, master tricky missions, and survive DeepCorp’s hazardous underground world.

5066680.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
5066680.short_description: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a true 4v4 team esport. Across a shared central Nexus, pieces invade neighboring boards to flank opponents and rescue allies in synchronized team volleys. It's the world's first true multi-board competitive team chess.

5078230.name: Unpredictable Cake
5078230.short_description: A village of farmers is in trouble... A rageful and salty wizard, a huge rotten cake and a mouse as hero? Yes, you'll find all of these inside Unpredictable Cake, a 3D platform game where the main character is a mouse and the other characters are even more strange.

5099920.name: A Little Faraway
5099920.short_description: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

5119610.name: Trust Me, It Binds
5119610.short_description: A procedural deckbuilder where you build real molecules and sell increasingly questionable confidence. Play cards, chase the target, stack absurd bonuses, and turn strange chemistry into an irresistible valuation. Nobody really understands molecules. Fortunately everyone understands numbers.

5167220.name: Another Cat`s Tale
5167220.short_description: A girl named Anna hides in a cursed mansion where the all-knowing Cat brought a fairy tale with no ending. He is patiently waiting for someone to finish it. In this first-person adventure, Anna must explore the mansion, solve puzzles, fight, and finally uncover its secrets.

5194150.name: Zukontide
5194150.short_description: Swarm-scale tower defense: up to 40,000 aliens per siege, thousands on screen, physically crushing into your chokepoints. You are expected to fall — every kill banks credits, even in defeat. Grind the war economy, research deadlier guns, mount them on the ruins, and return to hold the line.

5247120.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue
5247120.short_description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

5247170.name: Sheep Go!
5247170.short_description: Ram, punch or fire cannons! Sheep Go! is a plush-style action roguelite. Mix wool-ball throws, static charge from rubbing, Sheep Shadows and summoned flocks of sheep into your own build. Become a little sheep on a journey from farm to town to rescue Mom, with surprises along the way.

5287290.name: 浴血淞沪
developers: 重庆灵溪网络科技有限公司
publishers: 重庆灵溪网络科技有限公司
5287290.short_description: Command Chinese troops in a 2D single-player real-time tactics game set during the 1937 Battle of Shanghai. Deploy infantry and heavy weapons, direct your defenses, and personally aim mortars as you face armored assaults, air raids, and amphibious landings.

5294200.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em
5294200.short_description: A casual Texas Hold’em game with solo runs and online play for 2–8 players on Steam. One-time purchase, no paid chip top-ups. All chips are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

5296640.name: Sort Them Fish
5296640.short_description: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

5302490.name: THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread
5302490.short_description: You died waiting for a train. A goddess reincarnated you as a 5 mm worker ant with one errand: steal a 72 cm loaf of bread — the whole thing, crumb by crumb — through a 9 mm crack, without the Human noticing you exist. That's 7,600 crumbs. Start with one.

5315570.name: ZERO VISIBILITY
5315570.short_description: Survive one day at a time in a fog-drowned American town overrun by the dead. Scavenge for supplies, get back to base before dark, take in survivors and hold off night raids. Every sound draws them closer. Find five fragments of research data to learn what happened here.

5329860.name: Overtime : Development Hell
5329860.short_description: Play as Frank, a developer at a highly secretive game development studio rushing to finish the studio's most anticipated release, while being disrupted by an obsessed fan trying to gain information on the long awaited game. Survive Frank's final night alone in this Psychological Horror experience.

5337120.name: Monster Club League Manager
5337120.short_description: Take charge of a monster club and aim for the Division 1 title in this single-player management sim. Recruit and develop players, choose a nine-monster lineup, and manage contracts, transfers, and club finances. Matches play out automatically as you build your squad over many seasons.

5356480.name: KPOP Idol Factory
5356480.short_description: Form your own K-pop group – and live through fresh drama every day. Scout talent, plan training and comebacks, battle rivals on a 3D stage and make choices that change careers. It doesn't end at debut: your story runs through three acts all the way to the world tour.

5359600.name: BIGGER BANG
5359600.short_description: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

5367700.name: Cuby Clicker
5367700.short_description: Cuby Clicker is an incremental arcade game with idle elements. Destroy cubes, collect fragments, and power up through the skill tree. Face bosses, advance through new Ascensions, and unlock arcade cabinets that produce resources. Created by a solo indie developer.

5372430.name: Neuroflip
5372430.short_description: A card-based memory roguelike. Flip cards, remember where each face appeared and match pairs to defeat the Scribe, the Lady and the King. Missing on a new card is free; forgetting a pair you've already seen can cost you dearly.

5379330.name: Hazzard Hearth
5379330.short_description: Survive the known (hunt, craft, fish, treat illness, mend bones, ration supplies, wolves, bears) and unknown (volatile weather, mutated beasts), stranded on a mountain. Solve the mystery and try to re-establish communications for rescue. Free roam or follow the story. Play single player or co-op.

5380560.name: False Feed
5380560.short_description: Compare four surveillance feeds and find the one that contradicts the other three. Pause, rewind, and examine the same event from different angles in this deduction game. Work through 18 recordings across six work sites at your own pace.

5396310.name: Minion's Revenge: Take Everything They Took
5396310.short_description: Beat a hero. Steal their skill. Turn it on the next one. A hands-on 2D pixel-art action roguelite: 13 heroes, 52 skills to steal and 34 special augments to stack into a broken build. No levels, no XP — only what you take.

5400200.name: Spring Breeze Shokudo
5400200.short_description: 1978, southern Taiwan. Come home to reopen your grandmother's shuttered shokudo: shop the morning market, set the menu, hire staff and win the street back from the flashy restaurant across the road. Currently available in Traditional and Simplified Chinese only.

5402190.name: Digging Up Together
5402190.short_description: Dig up the Egyptian desert. Sweep with a metal detector, shovel and drill through the layers in 1–4 player co-op, brush off ancient treasures and real-size dinosaur bones, haul them home by wheelbarrow or minecart, and build your own museum.

5411480.name: Holdopolis
5411480.short_description: One toilet. An entire city desperate to use it. Build districts, draw queues, deliver paper and haul away waste. Handle breakdowns, strikes and elections in a satirical city builder where one locked door can bring everything to a standstill.

5424530.name: PlayASM
5424530.short_description: Build a computer from the inside out. Write real assembly, watch every register and byte change live, then draw graphics, compose chiptune music, program a robot arm and build 3D voxel worlds. 100+ missions. Full mod support. No black boxes.

5433260.name: 魔女牌Witch Card‌
5433260.short_description: As a Witch Intern, you will engage in card duel exams with the two witch examiners Little Red Riding Hood and Alice, using your starting deck, treasure cards, passive skills and divination. You need to clear 10 floors to become an official witch.

5436740.name: Hoof Trimmer Simulator
5436740.short_description: Clean, pare and treat sore cow hooves in a cozy barn. Scrape off the crust, carve satisfying horn curls, find the abscess with hoof testers and release the pressure — then watch your patient walk away sound. Nine breeds, endless cases, oddly satisfying.

5444160.name: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
5444160.short_description: Fly through a huge workshop as a tiny fairy and sort 3,200 keys by colour, head and shape. Play solo or in a group of up to 4, learn useful magic, restore the workshop, collect picture pieces and spoil the resident cat.

5450150.name: Wildacre: Farm Life Simulator
5450150.short_description: Build a homestead on a wild island in first person. Till, plant and water your fields, chop timber for a log cabin and hunt the forest with a bow. Seasons shift market prices, rain waters your crops, and well-tended fields can yield gold-quality harvests.

5474530.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
5474530.short_description: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

5481010.name: The Cruel Guardians
5481010.short_description: Your manor is threatened from every side by brigands, anarchist revolutionaries, and a demigod. Will you resort to forbidden magic or pray for divine aid? An interactive fantasy novel, 181,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

5481110.name: Gold Miner Online: Claw Chaos
5481110.short_description: Swing, drop, grab! The classic gold-mining arcade game goes online. Race up to 3 rivals in ranked or private matches, or dig through 60 levels, 6 worlds and bosses. Four claws. Total chaos.

5487280.name: Penguin Colony
5487280.short_description: Send your penguins waddling off to gather pebbles, fish the Shore and grow a bustling colony. Buy upgrades until the whole flock works on its own, then Migrate for Feathers and come back stronger. A cosy incremental game with a real ending, and an Endless mode if you never want to stop.

527230.name: For The King
527230.short_description: For The King is a strategic RPG that blends tabletop and roguelike elements in a challenging adventure that spans the realms. Set off on a single player experience or play cooperatively both online and locally.

584980.name: Late Shift
584980.short_description: Late Shift is a high stakes FMV crime thriller. Forced into a brutal London heist, your choices matter in this interactive cinematic experience with adaptable storylines that lead to one of seven conclusions. Your decisions are you.

636040.name: Pixel Worlds: MMO Sandbox
636040.short_description: Pixel Worlds is a free-to-play sandbox MMO where players build worlds, craft items, explore dungeons, farm resources, and trade in a player-driven economy, all within a shared online universe rebuilt as a fresh start for a fair and stable long-term experience.

724930.name: Last Chickenburg
724930.short_description: Last Chickenburg is an offbeat action RPG blending survival, strategy, and puzzle elements. Survive the Humanfolk’s arena, rise as the Chicken King, and lead the Chickenkind to reclaim its homeland.

1106840.name: Hydroneer
1106840.short_description: Hydroneer is a mining and base building sandbox. Dig for gold and other resources to turn a profit and enhance your mining operation. Build a base of operations, forge weapons, go fishing, and dig deep!

1498330.name: Little Lands
1498330.short_description: Build your world, one hex at a time. Little Lands is a peaceful, low-stress world builder where you gather resources, expand your landscape, and create a world of your own. No timers, no game overs, just build, decorate, and enjoy.

1746030.name: Murders on the Yangtze River
1746030.short_description: "Murders on Yangtze River" is an Ace Attorney-like detective game that takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases. Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries.

2385930.name: Gnart's Escape
2385930.short_description: To escape the maze, you must survive turn-based combats in which cards will activate your weapons, and they will perform according to dice rolls. Gnart's Escape is a Deck-building Roguelike RPG.

2806540.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
2806540.short_description: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advent calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this relaxing hidden object game for the whole family by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

2904040.name: Cheap Car Repair
2904040.short_description: Cheap Car Repair - go back in time to Poland of the 90's. Run your own Cheap Car Repair shop. Look for savings wherever you can. Make lots of money and avoid angry customers!

3208460.name: Rogue Braver | 勇者ローグ
3208460.short_description: A Classic Turn-Based Roguelike RPG with Procedurally Generated Dungeons

3314690.name: Cardalaxy
3314690.short_description: 4X distilled into a card game with 5 different ways to win.

3393120.name: Tidy Up Mall
3393120.short_description: Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 5,000 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

3433110.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
3433110.short_description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

3445440.name: Fablery
3445440.short_description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

3549030.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound
3549030.short_description: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.

3570680.name: Meltdown
3570680.short_description: Meltdown is a nuclear reactor desk-job simulation where you, as a newly recruited operator, must control the reactor to keep the surrounding city powered up. Maintain the wires in the power grid, regulate the water tank’s flow, and tune the steam ventilation to keep the reactor from overheating.

3618480.name: Journey Under The Pyramids
3618480.short_description: Follow in the footsteps of a missing Egyptologist as you explore mysterious passageways beneath the Great Pyramids. Solve 50 unique and challenging puzzles, uncover ancient artifacts, and discover the truth behind his disappearance.

3823530.name: Emberbound: Three Pyres
3823530.short_description: Leave a trail of fire and close loops to burn the horde in this solo survival action game. Chain captures, combine ten powers and brave intense pyre trials before facing the guardians of three haunted realms.

3941350.name: Mine It All!
3941350.short_description: Mine blocks across the screen, gather resources, and upgrade your tools. Build furnaces and automation systems to improve efficiency, then trigger chain reactions with special blocks to clear huge sections of the screen at once.

3958390.name: Project: Haste
3958390.short_description: Break in. Tear it up. Get out before the cops show up. Wall run, slide, double jump and rocket-jump off your own shotgun across places you don't belong. Headshot your friends mid-air and chain eliminations in a lightning-fast 4-player arena shooter you can pick up in a single match.

3997770.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
3997770.short_description: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

4010820.name: Eye of Darkness
4010820.short_description: Eye of Darkness is a survivor game with a focus on exploration. You take on the role of a dark cultist on the path to awaken ancient evil - the Eye of Darkness. The forces of Light throw everything at you to stop you from plunging the world into eternal darkness.

4088360.name: Funeral for the Sun
4088360.short_description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

4099810.name: 1999TOKOYO Building
4099810.short_description: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

4145780.name: Abracademia
4145780.short_description: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

4157120.name: Slimies
4157120.short_description: Slimies is a top-down action roguelike where you evolve and absorb waves of enemies, growing stronger after each round. Craft your own playstyle by unlocking slimes and items to make a unique build each run.

4165190.name: Tricolo
4165190.short_description: A minimalist logic puzzle played on a 3×3 grid. Take on 200+ puzzles built around simple rules and intuitive controls.

4176000.name: False Myth 2
4176000.short_description: The true sequel to False Myth— a true classic JRPG × beautiful-heroine adventure! Rouge, the agile assassin, sets off with his companions to uncover the truth behind the mysterious girl Sylphina, weaving the most heartrending and fiery “Tale of Hearts.”

4289700.name: Flowers to Honey
4289700.short_description: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

4459320.name: Desktop Goofy Guys
4459320.short_description: Tiny goofy guys have moved onto your desktop and they're not leaving. They haul coins to your dock, play with toys, and get absolutely obliterated by your death ray. Click-through, always there, always up to something.

4459590.name: Slotbound
4459590.short_description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

4459600.name: PICK A BOO
4459600.short_description: PICK A BOO is an online co-op roguelike escape action game for up to 6 players. Explore ever-changing stages and haul furniture and cargo with magnetic power. Upgrade your character, evade enemies, or fight back. How greedy will you get? When will you escape? It's up to you!

4475970.name: Prerolled
4475970.short_description: Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder! Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box! Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

4481330.name: Frankenmine
4481330.short_description: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.

4492480.name: Pick Squad
4492480.short_description: A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.

4492500.name: The Cinder Throne
4492500.short_description: The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you passively kill enemies, level up, loot enemies, change pieces of equipment and find spells. Create powerfull synergies. Rebirth and come back stronger than ever

4515500.name: Seferia Matrix
4515500.short_description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

4541350.name: Fraga
4541350.short_description: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Celtic mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

4559930.name: Oboro no Ichi
4559930.short_description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

4611240.name: Music Manager
4611240.short_description: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.

4621940.name: Leviticus
4621940.short_description: Leviticus is a bullet hell sci-fi action indie game where you play as a biblically accurate angel sent to guard those made in the image of GOD. you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders that aren't made in his image. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.

4646360.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor
4646360.short_description: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.

4658520.name: Cards of Bellum
4658520.short_description: Master the Deck & overthrow the King in this roguelike tabletop deckbuilder featuring strategy, dice and a little luck. Dominate suit-based combat with strength-boosting dice, or recruit and use unique heroes, powerful wizards, and legendary knights.

4662100.name: Rocket.io
4662100.short_description: Rocket.io is an online multiplayer arena game where hover-cars battle for territory. Leave a trail, claim ground, and cut off your rivals! Play quick matches, private rooms, and battles with 2 to 8 teams, or take on the AI. Collect and customize over 25 vehicles.

4733570.name: Another Card Game
4733570.short_description: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

4743040.name: Tiny Village
4743040.short_description: 《Tiny Village》 is an incremental game where you gather resources with your mouse, unlock new buildings with the resources you collect, and develop your village. Strengthen your gathering abilities, unlock a variety of buildings one by one, and turn your small village into a thriving home!

4774370.name: GymPup
4774370.short_description: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that blends desktop idle gameplay with visual novel elements. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.

4832970.name: What the Buck?!
4832970.short_description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

4852570.name: Pidgeon Pocket
4852570.short_description: A cozy incremental with beautiful pixel art and a flock of adorable pigeons. Aim at a busy park, bring the coins home and spend them on upgrades. Every pigeon gets its own superpower. Swoop, collect, upgrade.

4862530.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
4862530.short_description: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

4863180.name: Defend The HexCore
4863180.short_description: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

4863540.name: Progress98
4863540.short_description: A satisfying incremental idle game that drops the pretense to give you pure unadulterated progress. Boost, earn bonuses and buy upgrades to speed up your progress or take it easy and let it make progress by itself while you make progress elsewhere. No stress, only progress!

4874380.name: Idle Camp Tale
4874380.short_description: A fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

4886710.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!
4886710.short_description: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.

4901540.name: Brick Buddies
4901540.short_description: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

4901860.name: The Big Suck
4901860.short_description: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.

4920280.name: 喵呜风云
4920280.short_description: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.

4947250.name: Kebab Dynasty
4947250.short_description: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

4959600.name: Path to Catakombs
4959600.short_description: Build and defend an armored train through ever-changing underground routes. Recruit gunners, alchemists, and mechanics, upgrade your wagons, choose your path, and survive relentless kobold raids and colossal bosses.

4978080.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan’s Deal
4978080.short_description: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.

4981570.name: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
4981570.short_description: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

4993270.name: Palisade
4993270.short_description: Command frontlines directly in a real time territorial strategy game. Push borders, link settlements with supply roads, and break defenses with cavalry and naval landings. Includes six historical campaigns, Skirmish, a built in map editor, and online matches for up to eight players.

5033060.name: Menthal
5033060.short_description: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

5052860.name: Supercar Collection Together
5052860.short_description: Manage your own diecast store with friends! In this 1-4 player collection game, open surprise car packs, build your collection, race against customers, trade cards online, and grow your business together.

5060780.name: Twin-stick Japanese
5060780.short_description: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

5064170.name: Go Next!
5064170.short_description: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

5076240.name: Megachest
5076240.short_description: Megachest is an incremental game about opening chests, discovering legendary loot, and building your ultimate fortune empire! Start with simple rewards and grow into a master of magic and riches as you unlock rare items, upgrade your power, and hire helpers to automate your chest-opening journey

5085890.name: Bouncemetry
5085890.short_description: An incremental game made of seven physics simulations. Drop balls into a ring until it shatters, steal links on a gravity-free lattice, sweep a reactor with a beam. Upgrades change the physics itself, and automated simulations keep earning while you work on the next one.

5086460.name: PeeVPee
5086460.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

5089680.name: Magua: Twenty Sorrows
5089680.short_description: An autobattler focused on the creating synergies to buff your team. Upgrade your units and defeat increasingly stronger enemies in this rogue-like game.

5095020.name: Picronix 2
5095020.short_description: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

5096660.name: 怪談寺
5096660.short_description: 山の中にてあなたは偶然にも、怪談寺に迷い込む――。そこにいたのはとある4人の人物だった。まともな人物はゼロ。もはや語り手のほうが怖い？聞かされる怪談話の数々。王道ホラーから人怖、SFホラー、ホラーコメディなど多岐に渡る癖の強い物語たち。VHS風画面短編集邪道ホラーノベルゲーム。

5097530.name: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder
5097530.short_description: It moves the way you built it. It wins the way you built it. Assemble the 18cm-tall autonomous hobby robot “SIGNOS” and program its behavior logic with flowchart-style “Thought Tiles.” No controls during battle — SIGNOS fights on its own, guided solely by the logic you designed.

5118500.name: Safari-TV
5118500.short_description: Run a safari agency with friends in chaotic 2–4 player co-op. Drive a fully destructible, physics-based truck, take care of tourists, and survive wildlife encounters. Film the chaos, watch your videos together, and grow your in-game channel.

5157340.name: March and Conquer
5157340.short_description: March and Conquer is a short autobattler game. During the battle, use the skill tree to train units to fight against enemies on the battlefield. Gain gold and mana from wins and train different units and upgrade your army. March across multiple lands and fight fearsome foes!

5160800.name: Find The Needle
5160800.short_description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

5168960.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
5168960.short_description: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

5182360.name: Boss After Boss
5182360.short_description: Boss After Boss is a short incremental game about breaking chests, collecting powerful skills, and taking down increasingly dangerous bosses. Upgrade your stats, unlock higher-tier chests, build stronger skill combinations, and exploit each boss's weaknesses.

5182720.name: Waifu Curator
5182720.short_description: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying 420 collectible figures made up of over 3,600 scattered pieces. Organize every collection and bring the ultimate waifu exhibition to life!

5206500.name: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey
5206500.short_description: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

5342150.name: Mazehold
5342150.short_description: Build the maze. Hold the keep. A tower defense roguelite without waves: wall in an endless horde across 7 worlds, combine 15 towers into 104 combos, draft cards as you level up – and survive 20 minutes until the final boss marches on your castle.

5352470.name: Corgi Race Live
5352470.short_description: Bring the greatest sport in the world to your Twitch stream with Corgi Race Live! Stream corgi races and have your chat compete with you; picking winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard. Take on the mantle of corgi racing host and bring everyone to the party.

5359660.name: StackOver
5359660.short_description: Stack, hold on, higher! Drop various objects and stack them as high and steadily as possible within the limited space. Consider the object's weight, balance, and collisions as you stack them, and use various augmentations to overcome dangerous moments.

5378100.name: Autistic Romance
5378100.short_description: What makes divorce a justified decision? Does it even need to be justified? Each night, choose who to spend your time with. Decide what you believe about relationships at 'The End' of this visual novel.

5379260.name: REC:REWIND
5379260.short_description: Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him. Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

5391510.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer
5391510.short_description: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.

5398160.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator
5398160.short_description: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.

5405460.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic
5405460.short_description: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.

5416650.name: Masyu: Line Logic
5416650.short_description: A relaxing logic puzzle where you draw one loop through every circle, going straight through the white ones and turning on the black ones. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 15,000 more, Easy to Expert.

5424890.name: Backrooms: 1977
5424890.short_description: This is a video game based on the Backrooms myth, but it breaks away from its lore to tell an original story. It features a variety of gameplay sections with different creatures and a narrative-driven approach that sets it apart from other games based on these locations.

5427570.name: The Staring Man | 凝視男
5427570.short_description: A first-person horror game set in a Japanese convenience store. You work the night shift alone. Across the street, a man stands staring at you every night. As you encounter inexplicable events, you investigate the mystery of a former employee who disappeared.

5429470.name: The Guiding Light
5429470.short_description: The Guiding Light is a single-player action RPG with pixel heroes and a 3D fantasy world. Choose Warrior, Mage, Tank, Archer, or Swordsman; master unique skills, explore villages and dungeons, and defeat foes and bosses. Find your fighting style, grow stronger, and light the way home.

5446390.name: Mediotorum
5446390.short_description: Enter Mediotorum, a fantasy world torn by rival factions. Collect cards, forge your deck, and face other players in turn-based duels where every decision can tip the balance of the war.

5451020.name: Gotching
5451020.short_description: Raise a creature with a brain of its own: seventeen instincts, senses that mutate between runs, and a memory that lasts its whole life. Play it by hand to teach it, or watch it descend alone. Every floor is built from scratch, nothing comes identified, and it never truly dies.

5455340.name: Punch The Walls
5455340.short_description: Locked in a cell with nothing but your fists. Punch the walls into cubes, vacuum up the rubble and shred it for cash. Upgrade, dig through harder rock, and find the notes the prisoners before you left behind: they hold the code to the door.

5456360.name: 昭幽：阴阳渡
5456360.short_description: A tower defense game with team building and online co-op. Recruit heroes, combine synergies, forge equipment and choose Heavenly Gifts. Manage resources between waves, counter invisible and flying enemies, and defend the crossing between two realms, solo or with friends.

5463460.name: Veltarum
5463460.short_description: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

5464620.name: Terrified Gorillas
5464620.short_description: A co-op VR horror game. You're a gorilla trapped in Primal Dynamics' abandoned test facilities, and the monsters know you're here. Climb, run and hide through mazes, sewers and the backrooms with your friends, or become the monster in Monster Hunt.

5466100.name: Hunter Bro VR
5466100.short_description: Bow-hunt big game across five wild grounds in VR. Draw a real bow, track and call trophy animals, and survive the night when the woods hunt you back. Use a rifle, play it like a hunting sim, or open the cheats and bring a rocket launcher to a deer hunt or set the woods on fire with your flamethrower

5466110.name: ZOLGE STATION: HUGA Waiwai Academy
5466110.short_description: Free Issue 00 includes an exclusive special stage of the wild run & gun HIJURA SCARLET GEAR! A disk-magazine-style collection of indie studio HU-GA's work, also with the Final Re:Quest movie trailer in TRUE PIXEL, a special booklet and four Zolge Station talk specials. New issues arrive as DLC.

5467060.name: Score Circuit
5467060.short_description: Chain risky scoring nodes, cash out before the circuit burns out, and unlock 80 modifiers that bend every run. Score Circuit is a compact neon score-attack roguelite about one more carefully calculated push.

5469310.name: Haste Makes Waste
5469310.short_description: Start with an empty account and load the first cargo yourself. Hire and train workers, add wagons and expand your station and warehouse. In this railway idle game, watch the flow of goods, spot bottlenecks and decide which upgrade will make the biggest difference.

5471970.name: Rubber Stamp Legend
5471970.short_description: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless business expenses, outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

5474650.name: The Horror
5474650.short_description: A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross multiple maps and modes.

5476040.name: Gilded Shoals
5476040.short_description: Start with a small fishing net and build toward electric chains, drifting storms and automated helpers. Catch fish on short voyages, choose lasting upgrades, explore five coastal locations and collect rare fish for your aquarium in this relaxing incremental game.

5476770.name: Armed Prisoner III
5476770.short_description: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket small game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration

5477930.name: Boris & the Second Sun
5477930.short_description: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.

5482530.name: Shai & Shatta
5482530.short_description: Run a lively Egyptian street kitchen solo or with friends. Brew shai, build ful sandwiches, and master koshary as orders pile up and the neighborhood causes chaos. Cook with up to 4 players locally or 8 online.

5486050.name: ART NOIRE: Paris
5486050.short_description: ART NOIRE: Paris: a relaxing, atmospheric ring puzzle game in romantic 1960s Paris. Rotate concentric rings in 50 picture puzzles. Enjoy elegant film noir art, soothing music and a shift from black and white to full color. Play solo with a mouse.

5486060.name: Your account has been banned
5486060.short_description: This is a surreal and hilarious choice-based dialogue game. You’ve signed up for the latest AI assistant, but its decision-making algorithm clearly has some issues—it’s currently banning users left and right.

5511640.name: Mini Battleships
5511640.short_description: Start with a tiny boat and a single gun. Sink ships, salvage their gold and turn your vessel into a gloriously over-armed floating fortress. A calm, minimalist naval roguelike with an ever-changing soundtrack, where the sea always wins in the end, but never before you look magnificent.

361420.name: ASTRONEER
361420.short_description: Interact with strange new worlds in a unique and tactile way, molding the environment itself as if it were clay in your hands. Build your base, master resource management, automate your production lines, and more as you unravel the mysteries of the universe, alone or with friends.

553640.name: ICEY
553640.short_description: ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action game and a META game in disguise. As you follow the narrator's omnipresent voice, you will see through ICEY's eyes and learn the truth about her world. The narrator will constantly urge you in one direction, but you must ask, "Why? Why am I following his directions?“ Obey? Rebel?

1066780.name: Transport Fever 2
1066780.short_description: The classic transport simulation genre has a new gold standard with Transport Fever 2. Discover a whole new world by navigating transport routes through land, water and air. May progress and prosperity find their way!

1227690.name: Severed Steel
1227690.short_description: An intense single-player FPS featuring a stylish movement system, completely destructible levels, and an acclaimed OST.

1369630.name: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights
1369630.short_description: ENDER LILIES is a dark fantasy 2D action RPG about unraveling the mysteries of a destroyed kingdom. On this sorrowful journey, encounter horrific enemies against whom a moment of inattention could be fatal. Overcome these hardships and seek the truth with the help of fallen knights.

1562700.name: SANABI
1562700.short_description: SANABI is an exhilarating stylish dystopian action-platformer. Play as a legendary retired veteran and use your signature prosthetic arm to jump over cliffs and skyscrapers, zip through bullets and traps and defeat powerful enemies.

2319360.name: Memento Dawn
2319360.short_description: A colorful puzzle adventure about a lost child searching for her memories, guiding her through darkness by mastering light and shadow.

2725260.name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
2725260.short_description: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?

3127230.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2026
3127230.short_description: Rise from amateur to PBA legend in the most realistic bowling simulation ever made, featuring advanced physics, realistic oil pattern transition, licensed PBA pros, deep career progression, and multiple competitive game modes.

4298880.name: Timber Rush
4298880.short_description: Timber Rush is a fast-paced incremental roguelite where every swing explodes into upgrades, chaos, and massive numbers.

4351380.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
4351380.short_description: Run a men's hair removal salon! Zap body hair with a laser, watch the pain meter, and pitch aftercare packages for every budget. Earn good reviews to bring in new clients, then use your profits to upgrade your gear, hire staff, and make your shop the go-to spot for hairy hunks.

4380710.name: DNA FIGHT
4380710.short_description: 3D Pretty Girl Dress-Up Fighting Game, earn DNA in battles to unlock skills and outfits. Experience the authentic feel of an arcade-style fighting game, with an original combat system, delivering exhilarating infinite combos and counter-infinite combos.

4575700.name: Vida:Unslain
4575700.short_description: Act first, or let your opponent go first? Card battles where cost, movement, and turn order are tightly intertwined. Choose your path, shape your options with the items you find, and press deeper into the labyrinth.

4626050.name: Apawcalypse: Gang War
4626050.short_description: The world has fallen. Animals have risen and evolved intelligence. Build your deck, fortify your hideout, position your army, then watch your animal gang battle automatically through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic war.

4789240.name: TALES: INK GUARDIAN
4789240.short_description: A 2D roguelike where ink and plants define your fate. Combine skills, relics, and plant abilities to craft a unique build every run. Purify the Void Ink threatening to consume the world — because no two runs, and no two strategies, are ever the same.

5175310.name: Worst Class Ever
5175310.short_description: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.

5232160.name: Between Cats
5232160.short_description: Slide cats of all shapes and sizes to leave exactly one empty space in each row and column. Meet 40 adorable cats and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test across 120 challenging levels.

5287500.name: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas
5287500.short_description: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas is a cozy first-person present sorting game where you help Santa and his elves sort 2,352 presents! With each present you sort, you get one step closer to unlocking Santa's gifts, which will help you sort even faster. Are you willing to help Santa this year?

5298050.name: Scrapline
