5298050.short_description: Scrapline is a third-person wave-survival roguelite shooter. Rogue robots fill a live-fire range, and you have one gun. Pick a weapon aspect: Bounce, Turrets, Burn or Blast. Spend salvage, pick one of 20 characters with real trade-offs, survive 20 waves, then chase your Endless record.

5345650.name: ASCENT: MASKLINGS
5345650.short_description: Fight through a shifting rift in a 3D action roguelite. Choose Lumi, Bram, or Nox and master melee, shield, or rune abilities; shape each two-stage, sixteen-area expedition with routes and blessings; and face the Swarm Heart and the Rift Warden with friends in online co-op or with AI companions.

5345780.name: BlockBabe
5345780.short_description: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.

5461620.name: Ironline
5461620.short_description: Build a transport company across a living, changing country. Lay railways, run trams through growing towns, send steamers between ports and mail planes between cities, and connect mines, farms and mills to the people who need what they make, from 1920 to the present day.

210970.name: The Witness
210970.short_description: You wake up, alone, on a strange island full of puzzles that will challenge and surprise you.

475550.name: Beholder
475550.short_description: You’re a state-installed landlord in a totalitarian country. Place listening devices, steal and sneak into your tenants’ apartments. Use what you uncovered to report anyone capable of plotting against the state. You MUST! But WILL you?

599140.name: Graveyard Keeper
599140.short_description: Build and manage a medieval graveyard while facing ethical dilemmas and making questionable decisions. Welcome to Graveyard Keeper, the most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim of the year.

1236720.name: Spirit Island
1236720.short_description: Become the spirits of the land, and defend the island from colonizing Invaders spreading blight and destruction! Your spirits work with the native islanders to increase your power and drive the invading colonists from your island in this strategic area-control game.

1308700.name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals
1308700.short_description: Welcome to the world of dungeon crawling! The classic dungeon crawler released back in 2006, returns to Steam with improved UI and more.

1894430.name: Plan B: Terraform
1894430.short_description: Terraform a lifeless rock into a lush and habitable world. Build trucks, trains, and sprawling factories on an enormous hexagonal planet. Grow its population to millions. Enjoy a dynamic simulation of atmosphere, temperature, water, and forests.

2062430.name: BALL x PIT
2062430.short_description: BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes.

2742830.name: Monster Train 2
2742830.short_description: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

2793540.name: No Love No Money
2793540.short_description: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

2847780.name: Nocturnal 2
2847780.short_description: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

2944770.name: A Snail's Tale
2944770.short_description: A retro jRPG with a twist. Have you heard the one about the million dollars and the immortal snail? A Snail's Tale will let you play out the story and answer the question once and for all - can he be stopped?

2991650.name: DAWN AEROWAR
2991650.short_description: A two-hour animated film. Follow Zodiac 1, an ace pilot out for revenge against the Empire, across 12 episodes of 3D dogfights and hand-drawn 2D animation, with a full voice cast and an original orchestral score. Nearly five years of work by a handful of independent artists.

3014860.name: Icy Tower
3014860.short_description: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

3129790.name: Pocket Legend : Inventory Roguelike Deckbuilder
3129790.short_description: In Pocket Legend, a roguelike deck-builder, you control a hero transported to a world of legendary weapons. Strategically arrange items in your inventory to defeat enemies with unique attack patterns. Create powerful card combinations, and uncover the fate of the dark forces in Lumensia!

3166920.name: Tears Apart
3166920.short_description: Tears Apart is an action roguelite built on five consecutive dash attacks called Tears. Equip upgrades to the Tears you choose, master your combat cycle, and carve through the Decay.

3218570.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
3218570.short_description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

3301000.name: The Vast White
3301000.short_description: A snowy mountain, the stillness, and you. With the help of your snowboard, rediscover the memories buried in the snow. Meet the locals, explore every path, and bring the ski resort back to life.

3326230.name: Hozy
3326230.short_description: Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In Hozy, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. Enjoy the little details as you interact with tools, items and furniture to bring each space back to life.

3551820.name: Castlebound
3551820.short_description: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!

3669620.name: Warhammer Survivors
3669620.short_description: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

3672660.name: Caramel Creek
3672660.short_description: ☕ Turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe of your own design: grow and brew your coffee, paint and furnish the place, and get to know the neighbours of a quiet town - and keep Ostin the cat company. Early Access.

3677850.name: Springs, Eternal
3677850.short_description: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

3718540.name: Brickino: The 3D Domino Game
3718540.short_description: Tabletop Gaming Inspired, Brickino is The 1st 3D Domino Game, where matching numbers horizontal and vertical gains points on the scorecard; Don't knock or tip them over or Game Over! This is an Ancient Game with a Right-Now Vision, made into digital.

3769420.name: Hill-Z
3769420.short_description: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

3810960.name: Sting Operation
3810960.short_description: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed! Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!

3830080.name: Twilight Requiem
3830080.short_description: Embark on a Dark Fantasy odyssey in Twilight Requiem, an action RPG blending heart-pounding combat and mystical exploration. Wield cosmic powers, master fluid combos inspired by Kingdom Hearts 2 Final Mix, and traverse haunting realms through enigmatic portals.

3850230.name: 99Day Survival Guide
3850230.short_description: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

3946460.name: Shroomy Garden
3946460.short_description: Design a beautiful cozy theme park or water park filled with rides, slides, decorations, and charm. Attract lovable Shroomies who wander around and bring your creation to life. A calm, cozy game about creativity and building your perfect little getaway.

3994800.name: White Whisper
3994800.short_description: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...

4051290.name: Tape Man
4051290.short_description: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.

4131730.name: VHOLUME
4131730.short_description: VHOLUME is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

4174620.name: Market Moe
4174620.short_description: Work the night shift on a Japanese street… where something shouldn’t be there.

4185040.name: The Great 48
4185040.short_description: A collection 48 lovingly hand crafted and hand-drawn micro games. Play with just a mouse and shoot for ALL the high scores! Try a random selection of games, or play each individually!

4249520.name: 異界ノ宿帳
4249520.short_description: Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.

4289450.name: PegLotto!
4289450.short_description: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!

4289830.name: Watch Eye
4289830.short_description: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.

4335460.name: BOXROOM
4335460.short_description: BOXROOM allows you to design, define and decorate a room - a sanctuary - for your Steam library, and then revel in the organisation of your game collection.

4364650.name: Space Numbers Go Up
4364650.short_description: A short incremental game about space mining. Walk around your ship, physically interact with it's systems, blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your gear and watch numbers go up.

4390080.name: Bottled by Bears
4390080.short_description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

4411170.name: Rapid Escalation
4411170.short_description: A fast-paced incremental space shooter where short battles fuel permanent upgrades and exponential growth.

4521650.name: Farm & Feast
4521650.short_description: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

4530340.name: Physics Clicker
4530340.short_description: A click-based incremental game themed around "physics". You will start with the most fundamental classical mechanics and gradually unlock more concepts. Through the process of easy clicking and growth, with the familiar media - PHYSICS, experience the fun of resource exploration and growth.

4562310.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2
4562310.short_description: A fast-paced local multiplayer party racing game for up to 8 players, featuring chaotic battles, multiple game modes, and responsive car controls.

4567020.name: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus
4567020.short_description: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For twenty-five years children have been born without souls, and a soul can only be restored by taking another’s. Ilaya Cassette wants to know what’s wrong with her. A gothic visual novel, fully voiced in Russian. Prologue and Part I out now.

4574820.name: Rejected Draft
4574820.short_description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

4634930.name: Cow Online World
4634930.short_description: Design your own animal self and meet other creatures in this colourful MMO! Graze with your friends and level skills like Basket Weaving, Trivia, Kindness, and more in a world that humans have left behind.

4660470.name: Near Mint
4660470.short_description: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

4696540.name: Working95
4696540.short_description: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

4719870.name: Ore Legacy
4719870.short_description: A retro CRT-style incremental mining game set in deep space. Expand your station, automate extraction fleets, harvest stars, and pay down an impossible debt.

4731250.name: Moonberry Clock: Idle Pet
4731250.short_description: Watch the clock and your idle pet passively gain money to unlock clothes, toys, and fun accessories. Either customize your pet yourself, or schedule them to change looks on their own.

4750760.name: La Agencia del Riel
4750760.short_description: The Rail Agency assigns a mission to Alena, who—along with the gaucho Don Orlando Soles and Pachomba—must prevent the theft of the "Train of the 7 Colors" in Jujuy. This is a multidirectional shooter that can be played solo or in a cooperative multiplayer mode for up to 3 players.

4764110.name: Mining Away!
4764110.short_description: Mining Away! is a short incremental game in which you mine ores, collect resources, progress through the vast skill tree, find rare relics, and unlock powerful pickaxes!

4780870.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector
4780870.short_description: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

4842090.name: Grab Your Deck
4842090.short_description: Build real skateboard tricks from cards: an Ollie paired with a Kickflip and two Shove-its fuse into a Tre Flip. Roll each trick into a manual or grind and land the line before bailing. Beat bosses that tape over your stickers to climb the ranks from AM to PRO. A press-your-luck skate deckbuilder.

4852840.name: Boltz
4852840.short_description: Boltz is a minimalist logic puzzle where you try to remove all the target bolts and nuts on the screen. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new mechanics added approximately every 10 levels.

4857160.name: Elsewhere
4857160.short_description: Activate every shape in abstract logic puzzles built from gems, signals, and shifting paths. Learn each gem's rule, solve the campaign, then build and share your own levels through the editor and Steam Workshop.

4896870.name: Click Dystopia
4896870.short_description: Click Dystopia is a casual clicker Incremental game, where you click a button to slay virtual people for cash.

4904730.name: Achievement Fly Clicker
4904730.short_description: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.

4916290.name: Dream Glitcher
4916290.short_description: Enter the fractured mind of Luna, an android learning to feel. Explore memories, solve puzzles, and influence her perception through your choices in a hand-drawn cyberpunk point-and-click adventure where identity, control, and reality are never quite what they seem.

4933810.name: Akuro and Bahaku VS Pollution Monsters
4933810.short_description: Brick-building auto-battle Roguelite. Pick a character, explore random labyrinths, collect Combat Bricks to boost stats and Legendary Bricks with special effects. Dozens of enemies, a corruption system, multiple endings, and exclusive Defeat CGs for every character-monster combo.

4937640.name: The Offering Hour
4937640.short_description: A strategy-action roguelike where time is your only currency, and your life. Every summon, spell and deal costs seconds; even opening your grimoire costs one. Summon monsters against cunning hero bosses, then sacrifice three of your own to become a demon and fight in person.

4939710.name: SYNTAX WARS
4939710.short_description: A cyberpunk duel of pure reads. Both fighters lock in a move in secret, then flip at the same instant — no reflexes, no combos, just mind games. Strong eats Weak, Weak pierces Guard, Guard parries Strong. Matches are quick. Every choice is heavy. Step into the arena.

4951630.name: Soundway
4951630.short_description: Ride your own music. Soundway transforms any song into a neon roller coaster racing through deep space, with every burst of speed, climb, drop, and turn shaped by the track itself. Catch the beat, build massive combos, dodge hazards, and chase the music across the stars.

4956460.name: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR
4956460.short_description: A happy North American neighborhood awaits you! Play solo or with up to 9 friends. Build your crew, take on jobs around the neighborhood, earn money and buy houses. Create your own cash flow and happily build your real estate empire!

4957320.name: Dear Nobody
4957320.short_description: The letters between two pen-pals who have never met cross your censor's desk behind a nameless front. Their romance exists only on paper, so a line you strike is gone from it for good. Partway through, a letter answers a question you only asked in your head. A melancholy epistolary romance.

4971410.name: Tankii
4971410.short_description: A multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.

4975340.name: 3D Bumper Billiards
4975340.short_description: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

4977170.name: ROBOTEKA
4977170.short_description: A unique robot fighting action game built around simple controls, precise timing, and martial arts-inspired combat.

4983460.name: The Rouge Casino
4983460.short_description: Eight crooked casino tables, one roguelite spine. Rig the wheel, load the dice, mark the cards — stack charms, omens and gilded editions until the house edge is yours. Eight antes, eight stakes, eighty challenges, Endless beyond. No real gambling — just a casino you finally get to cheat.

4994890.name: Become Blackhole
4994890.short_description: A space incremental game where you start as a speck of dust. Smash celestial bodies and absorb their fragments to gain mass. Grow from an asteroid into a moon, a planet, a star, and finally a black hole.

5008120.name: Ice Cream Truck Simulator
5008120.short_description: Start your engine and cool down the city! Hop into your fully interactive ice cream truck, drive through the neighborhood, and build your own ice cream empire. Take orders, scoop the perfect flavors, operate the card terminal, and manage your inventory on your in game laptop.

5039030.name: Wheel Be Fine
5039030.short_description: The world has gone dark! and only your hamsters can fix it. Spin the wheel, collect strange little hamsters and upgrade until your room powers the city, the country and the whole planet. A cozy incremental clicker that keeps running while you're away.

5045380.name: The Lacuna Tapes: Analog Signal Archive
5045380.short_description: Operate a modular tape-decoding machine and solve hands-on puzzles to restore corrupted data and reconstruct the story behind a deadly attack.

5051080.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
5051080.short_description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

5051090.name: The Cozy Funemployment
5051090.short_description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

5081060.name: Just Up: 2D Platformer
5081060.short_description: Just Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top...

5084410.name: Journey TD
5084410.short_description: Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds. Every week, battle other players on the same seed to top the leaderboard.

5091990.name: Hell is Neon Colored
5091990.short_description: A minimalist twin-stick shooter drenched in neon glow. Deep weapon customization and more than 350 weapon and ability combinations provide your arsenal as you delve deep in rogue-lite progression and complex mounting challenges.

5094930.name: Armory Keeper
5094930.short_description: Restore order to a massive armory solo or with friends in co-op! Sort over 3,000 weapons based on real-world firearms, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment into their proper places. Unlock abilities to work faster, or take a break at the shooting range!

5106240.name: Prospect
5106240.short_description: Prospect is a mining roguelike where you carve through the depths of the mines on a perilous journey towards the world above. Vanquish your foes, find mythical artifacts, and forge your own path with your trusty pickaxe. Will you be the first dwarf to ever reach the surface?

5109900.name: Super Piotr Deluxe
5109900.short_description: Jump from platform to platform, survive enemy waves and defeat bizarre bosses as Piotr descends through giant toilet portals into an ever-stranger arcade universe guided, questioned and occasionally mocked by Peypi, his living toiletpaper companion.

5110270.name: Ghost Express
5110270.short_description: Ghost Express" is a 2D storage-organizing puzzle game about Spooky, a ghost who's too cute to scare anyone. Fit each shop's goods into boxes piece by piece, then deliver them to the apartment next door. As the orders pile up and space runs out, can Spooky get the job done?

5115730.name: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill
5115730.short_description: An absurd rhythm-arcade shooter: on a green hill, a man performs every note of the soundtrack live on his didgeridoo. Hit your targets, build combos, and whatever you do, don't miss, or he'll literally blow his top.

5131950.name: Retro Shop: Tidy Up the Video Game Store!
5131950.short_description: Retro Shop: Tidy Up the Game Store! — Sort games, consoles, and accessories in a retro game store. Restore messy shelves, unlock useful upgrades, and enjoy turning chaos into perfect order.

5161560.name: A Bun Above
5161560.short_description: Layers score off their neighbors: cheese melts onto the patty, tomato lifts the bacon, a full BLT multiplies the lot. Every layer adds to the score — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down. A physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder.

5170980.name: Crime and Punishment
5170980.short_description: Dostoevsky’s complete, unabridged Russian text staged as a visual novel, with illustrated scenes and optional choices that preserve the original.

5191540.name: The Keyless: Forbidden Door
5191540.short_description: The Keyless: Forbidden Door is a dreamlike and surreal journey, witness bizarre metaphorical and surreal scenes in a world that changes shape as you overcome simple challenges.

5241700.name: Close the strait !
5241700.short_description: Close the Strait is an incremental modern warfare tower defense roguelite. Choose between the rival Meridian Compact and Vostra Union, defend your oil with tanks, missiles, aircraft, warships, and submarines, and upgrade after every defeat until you control the strait.

5283210.name: Crossfire 2D
5283210.short_description: Crossfire 2D — a crazy 2D action where every wall is deadly. Ricochets, ragdoll physics, and paranoia. Survive the chaos of multiplayer battles!

5293840.name: Vesper Drift
5293840.short_description: Reclaim the five Singularities in this Asteroids-inspired roguelite. Play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op, destroy asteroids, combine weapons, fusions and passive abilities, and fight across 150 combat zones on 30 planets spread over 5 star systems.

5323500.name: DEEP SEAL
5323500.short_description: DEEP SEAL is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Dive into dark, labyrinthine caves to recover bodies, find your way through the depths, and avoid the shark that's always hunting you. Grab what you can, find your teammates, and swim back alive.

5332990.name: Roadweave
5332990.short_description: A night atlas you draw roads across. Link towns, untangle jams with junctions and highways, throw bridges, run ferries and air links. Four worlds — from a 16-area island to a map of 120 — and a new map every day.

5343380.name: Shelves Full of Figures
5343380.short_description: A room full of empty shelves and a floor full of little figures. Pick up each one, find the shelf where it belongs and put it back on! Earn ability points as you go and unlock new ways to move and sort in this relaxing first-person organizing game.

5375890.name: Sort Them Dice
5375890.short_description: Turn a scattered hoard into a collection worth admiring. Collect, inspect and sort 4,235 dice into 605 sets across six themed areas. Fill wooden displays and unlock helpful upgrades in this cozy first-person organizing game.

5382120.name: The Crime Archive
5382120.short_description: A story-driven noir detective game. Search crime scenes, crack evidence puzzles, interrogate suspects, and accuse the killer. Six cases, from a locked office to a lighthouse. Get it wrong, and the killer walks free.

5403190.name: Project Babel
5403190.short_description: Create custom maps and share your puzzles for others to conquer. Race on global leaderboards in a falling-block roguelite with typing, rune combos and strategic builds. Choose Oaths, raise the Heat and adapt as sanity shifts.

5415560.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket
5415560.short_description: Eat your way through an entire supermarket! Start with snacks, earn money from everything you eat, and buy upgrades to eat faster and devour bigger things. Go from a bag of chips to entire shelves, fridges and even the checkouts. Can you eat the whole store?

5420970.name: SNIP SNAP
5420970.short_description: Snap it. Snip it. Stick it. An online party game: take photos in a colorful 3D world, cut them up and stick the pieces together to make what the round asks for. Then vote and guess who made what. No drawing skills needed.

5429500.name: Abnormal Rules Cafe
5429500.short_description: In a strange household, a family member is a pig-headed impostor. Read the rules, study their routines, search for supplies, and survive the night. Execute an innocent, and they become a chicken-headed hunter.

5431220.name: Rummage Row
5431220.short_description: Open your own stall at the flea market. Buy cheap from the secondhand dealer, set out your goods, name your price and haggle with every customer. Grow your reputation, trade with neighboring sellers and find the pieces your story customers are hunting for. A warm, relaxing secondhand business game.

5433870.name: Ghosts Before Dawn
5433870.short_description: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.

5438730.name: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up
5438730.short_description: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person game where you bring order to a messy fishing shop. Pick up scattered items, sort them by category, color, and size, place them on the right shelves, upgrade your abilities, and choose music to match your mood!

5443580.name: Three Kingdoms: Wardens of the Pass
5443580.short_description: Hold the passes of a nightmare-haunted Three Kingdoms. Build defenses, recruit legendary generals, trigger battlefield mechanisms and turn the tide with tactical spells in pausable real-time tower defense. 18 battlefields, 13 generals, 7 defense types.

5444570.name: Clay Galaxy
5444570.short_description: Clay Galaxy is a cozy casual puzzle game set in a unique clay-crafted space universe. Explore small planets, solve logic challenges, and progress location by location to move further.

5450030.name: We Have a Sheep Problem
5450030.short_description: Every sheep on the farm has escaped from its stand. Catch them, carry them home and put each one back in its own spot. Hats, costumes, a whole meadow of runaways and a few silly tools to help. A cosy, woolly tidy up game.

5455700.name: Island Crusade
5455700.short_description: Click monsters, recruit knights and free 100 pixel-art islands. When the sky splits, a second army fights in the Underside, a blood-soaked mirror of the kingdom, alongside your crusade. Timed bosses, a celestial sword, daily challenges and two worlds.

5456460.name: GAEKGWI
5456460.short_description: A first-person horror game rooted in Korean folklore. Navigate a village whose paths change with each visit. Learn how its ghosts hunt, conserve your lantern oil, and use charms and ritual tools to escape danger—or fight back.

5458260.name: 모야이게임
5458260.short_description: Dodge enemy fire and challenge the bosses in this quirky arcade shoot 'em up. Collect Power, hold Shift for precise movement, and use Spell and Lightning to escape danger. Tackle four stages and a final boss, then chase your best local score.

5471990.name: Disk Defragmenter
5471990.short_description: You watched the defragmenter as a kid. Now it's your turn. Sweep the read head across scrambled disks, hear fragments click into place, and upgrade your machine from a 1998 floppy to a 2032 archive array, recovering thirty years of one ordinary life along the way.

5472580.name: Hypermarket: Sort & Stock
5472580.short_description: A large-scale sorting simulator set in a two-storey hypermarket: organize 65,146 products and boxes across 23 departments, stock shelves and warehouse racks, and use boosters to find, carry and place items.

5476640.name: FIRE CHESS
5476640.short_description: FIRE CHESS is a serious strategy game that puts players in command of an emergency-response team to contain spreading wildfires. Recruit and manage units across a hex-grid map, use your limited resources to contain a spreading fire, protect residential communities, and respond to critical alerts.

5484400.name: Military Base Tidy Up
5484400.short_description: A relaxing first-person sim about tidying up a forgotten military underground base. Shelve ammo crates, weapons, drones and gear, unlock new sectors and level up your skills – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. No timers, no pressure.

5488250.name: Zomking
5488250.short_description: Hunt zombies, collect powerful loot, and grow stronger in this third-person action RPG. Find pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, and equipment with randomized stats and effects, build your character, fight through five increasingly dangerous stages, and ultimately challenge the Zomking.

5489550.name: Xiqiao Chronicles
5489550.short_description: Build a village in Song-era China with knowledge from the modern world. Plan homes and workshops, assign villagers, research and trade. Muster a roster of up to 24 soldiers for two three-battle campaigns, then return home to tend your growing settlement.

5492040.name: MYELORIFT
5492040.short_description: A third-person action roguelite inside a cosmic creature. Become Lume: face waves of enemies, absorb random grafts and alter the monster’s organs. Reach the Core and sever the Black Signal transmitting Earth’s coordinates.

5500200.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer
5500200.short_description: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.

5505730.name: Drift: Beyond Grip
5505730.short_description: A top-down arcade drift game. Flick into slides, link corners into massive combos and chase medals across neon cities, snowy passes and desert canyons. Customize your car with 230+ parts, beat daily challenges, or cruise a living city in the Chill Zone.

5518990.name: Cubetoria: Build. Think. Solve.
5518990.short_description: Fill the cube with no gaps. 100 hand-made 3D polycube challenges from the Cubetoria Series 1 puzzle book, from your first 2×2×2 to expert Pro builds. Turn, tilt and snap colourful pieces into place, find every answer, keep a daily streak and build your own puzzles.

1025560.name: Flea Madness
1025560.short_description: Jump into shooter where armed fleas fight over objectives with guns, bites, and rideable insects. Capture points, support your allies, and cause complete chaos using a mix of firearms, hilarious bite attacks, and strange insect companions that can carry you into battle.

1830970.name: The Last Flame
1830970.short_description: Recruit a party of unique heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create thousands of synergetic builds! The Last Flame is an endless roguelike auto-battler in which you guide a righteous party of heroes through many challenges.

2239150.name: Thronefall
2239150.short_description: A minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom.

2450350.name: Fat Goblins
2450350.short_description: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & classes, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

2599690.name: Better Than Dead
2599690.short_description: A brutal bodycam revenge FPS set in Hong Kong. Slide into bullet time, fight up close, learn each environment's rhythm, and turn every run into a faster, bloodier revenge scene.

2660460.name: Aviassembly
2660460.short_description: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.

2820820.name: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
2820820.short_description: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Viking Deities, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

3046540.name: 10 Second Mixtape
3046540.short_description: Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

3256890.name: Flexible Frosty
3256890.short_description: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

3721530.name: Motorcycle For Sale Simulator
3721530.short_description: Buy rusty motorcycles, restore every part, add custom paint and decals, then take them for a test ride and sell them for a profit. Turn barn finds into superbikes and grow your small garage into the best dealership in town.

3751490.name: Sitter
3751490.short_description: Investigating his grandmother's mysterious death, a detective enters her home in search of the truth. But the house begins to toy with him. Space twists, fears take shape, and there's no way out. Every step, every room, every loop brings him closer to madness.

3802500.name: Splatchinko
3802500.short_description: Play as a lovestruck alien in this chaotic roguelike pachinko in pixel art! Launch your EYES across hostile planets, unlock bizarre mutations and build devastating combos as you tear through the galaxy to rescue your beloved.

3837450.name: Wizzy the Wood
3837450.short_description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

3856990.name: Spin Tactics
3856990.short_description: A roguelike strategy game inside a slot machine. Pick your Companions, set the order they fire in, change your symbols with Gems, and build an engine that keeps growing, until the machine is wonderfully broken and the bosses can’t keep up. No real-money gambling.

4043580.name: RADZIMA
4043580.short_description: RADZIMA is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror set in an underground research facility. Find radioactive items, avoid the mutants, and power the elevator reactor to descend deeper - all in service of the Party’s will.

4304060.name: SONIC PICO PARK
4304060.short_description: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

4383030.name: Rolls and Dungeons
4383030.short_description: An incremental game about casinos and dungeons! Assemble a team of debtor-heroes, clear dungeons, hoard chips, and spin the slot machine in combat to defeat monsters and bosses. Level up your luck, hunt for loot and artifacts, unlock new dungeon levels – the ultimate jackpot awaits at the very end!

4403780.name: InCowMental
4403780.short_description: InCowMental is a cute and colorful tiny incremental game where you collect milk from your cows to sell it and make cheese. Upgrade your farm, and between upgrades, play mini-games to boost your production and sales!

4412000.name: Zad Archery
4412000.short_description: Shoot down waves of targets, collect their loot, and grow stronger through upgrades and skills in this expanding incremental game.

4463520.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
4463520.short_description: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

4532830.name: BAD STUDENT LOVE
4532830.short_description: Labeled a “troublemaker,” you transfer to the worst high school. There, you become entangled in dangerous relationships driven by desire, jealousy, and manipulation. Will you get closer, be used, or get hurt— your choices will determine how your story with them ends.

4545470.name: The Totemist
4545470.short_description: Craft uncanny totems. Aid troubled townsfolk. Uncover the darkness below. The Totemist is a narrative-driven occult shop sim set in a quietly strange town, where you craft charms inspired by real witchcraft, aid troubled townspeople, and uncover the ancient force festering beneath them.

4549920.name: Coastal Cargo
4549920.short_description: Coastal Cargo is a strategy simulation game about becoming the world's best Naval Logistician. Chart trade routes between ports in a sprawling archipelago. Drop boats, start transporting cargo, and earn your rewards. How long can your empire last in this ever more challenging environment?

4572260.name: Shadow Mist Idle
4572260.short_description: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.

4590150.name: Deskpot
4590150.short_description: A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!

4593380.name: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys
4593380.short_description: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).

4594630.name: Night Stocker
4594630.short_description: Immerse yourself in the neon nostalgia of the 90s! Nightstoker is a cozy organization game where you task yourself with bringing order to a chaotic video and music rental store. Sort through thousands of tapes and listen to retro hits. The pure joy of a perfectly organized shelf.

4602120.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
4602120.short_description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

4623570.name: Deskrawl: Idle ARPG
4623570.short_description: Grind mobs, farm loot and capture enemies to serve you. Deskrawl is an epic idle ARPG that plays at the bottom of your desktop. Farm legendary items and build overpowered heroes while you work or chill.

4629330.name: Keystones: Foundations
4629330.short_description: Grab, slide, rotate and tumble stone pieces as a little slime in a 3D puzzle game. Match faces, rearrange supports and plan your next foothold across 100 campaign levels, each with five difficulty variants.

4639740.name: Gnat Pack
4639740.short_description: A short incremental game about feeding a swarm of hungry gnats. Guide your bugs to the fruit, and unlock upgrades to grow your pack of buzzing buddies one bite at a time.

4657320.name: The Lifeline
4657320.short_description: To escape this terrifying hospital, you must leave your fears behind. Can you do it? Explore, face zombies, use weapons, avoid traps, and react fast to survive.

4763980.name: Your Sweet Little Kitty
4763980.short_description: Your cozy desktop companion! This adorable cat hangs out on your screen while you work or study, gently reminding you to hydrate and take breaks. Feed it to unlock cute animations and level up your bond. Ready to be the ultimate cat servant?

4767430.name: Love in Summer
4767430.short_description: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

4827000.name: Quarterheart
4827000.short_description: A cozy arcade roguelite. An old coin-op machine you find in the attic, and it still works. Aim true and time your hits in 2–4 minute runs. Every new monster you beat prints a sticker — where you stick it on the cabinet decides what it upgrades or unlocks. Insert coin to play?

4832420.name: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
4832420.short_description: Turn-based martial arts RPG set in the mid-Ming Dynasty. Play as Cyrus, an Azure Peak disciple, to recruit companion heroes in a corrupt world. Master tactical party-based combat to defeat foes, unravel imperial conspiracies, and choose between personal vengeance and state righteousness.

4854220.name: Stick Crisis
4854220.short_description: A stickman roguelite shooter where every run reshuffles combat. Fight from cover across rain-soaked city streets, a hidden jungle base and a desert pursuit, build a powerful loadout, and uncover Project Obelisk’s connection to an impossible artifact.

4866170.name: Disaster Scenario
4866170.short_description: A comedic deckbuilder dressed up as a game show. Clear a gauntlet of absurd disasters with ridiculous tool combos and a little luck. Bring a crowd for the raucous pitch-and-bet party game — or go solo and 1v1 for a sharper, strategic run. First to the finish wins.

4889630.name: RefishingLife
4889630.short_description: Roguelike × Fishing × Reincarnation. No learning curve — master the pure joy of fishing in 1 minute. Mix 100+ talents & gear for a fresh experience every run; unlock rich stories through endless cycles. Embark on an East Asian fishing adventure. —— You met me at a very Chinese time in your life.

4921660.name: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!
4921660.short_description: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!

4927090.name: DemonBlade Pixel: Hyakki Senkou
4927090.short_description: A 2D bullet-hell action roguelite steeped in yokai fantasy. Collect demon blades across 8 playable fighters, refine solo builds, cut through 35 story chapters, climb Kimon Renrou, and challenge post-story bosses.

4931480.name: Harvest Together
4931480.short_description: Build a cozy farm with friends or solo! Grow crops, raise animals, and ride your horse across the meadows. Dynamic weather waters your crops when it rains and blankets your farm in winter snow. Online co-op for up to 4 players — sow together, grow together.

4932820.name: Bottle Flip Inc
4932820.short_description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

4934620.name: STARCINDER
4934620.short_description: The stars are dying. Pilot an evolving warship across the Milky Way in this third-person 3D space roguelite. Fight interceptors, shatter asteroids, build your arsenal, and carry the last spark from Earth orbit to the far-side beacon.

4990840.name: FAKE ME
4990840.short_description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

5012690.name: Flock Fight
5012690.short_description: A minimalist couch fighting game with a twist: you are a flock of health units. Balance offense and defense as you use weapons to survive quick match ups online or locally.

5021510.name: MUTARIUM: Mutant Aquarium Defense
5021510.short_description: Feed them and they mutate. Overfeed them and they turn on you. Mix MEAT, GLOW and ORE to grow your fish into adorable little horrors, then let them fight the failed experiments breaking into your tank. You never control a unit — what you feed is the whole strategy.

5053000.name: From Zero: Idle Factory
5053000.short_description: Start with a worn-out workshop and grow through eight increasingly advanced factories. Produce, ship, reinvest and automate with robots in an active incremental management campaign that progresses only while you play.

5054700.name: Fakin It XL
5054700.short_description: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

5058280.name: Grazed - Incremental Arcade
5058280.short_description: Every kill means brushing past death. Grazed is a skill-based incremental arcade game: graze enemies with your blades, build your combo, and ignite absurd powers. Runs last seconds to minutes. Beat your score, upgrade, repeat.

5074650.name: Memento Resonance
5074650.short_description: Forge a Resonance with enemy monsters and welcome them into your party. Equip their skills with relics to shape your own battle style, then climb an ever-changing tower as you follow the trail of lost memories in this monster-collecting roguelite turn-based strategy game.

5096100.name: Siegecrawler
5096100.short_description: Load your crew onto a rumbling siege engine and smash through physics-driven castle walls! Battles run themselves — you steer the tide with spells, three war horns, and perfectly timed ram strikes. Pick a commander, swear an oath, equip skills: every run builds different. 30 stages, then Endless.

5104160.name: ChromaFlow
5104160.short_description: Build a factory powered by color. Extract red, green, and blue, route them through conveyor networks, and mix them into an expanding spectrum. Fulfil requests for the Chroma Core, unlock new technology, and optimize every production line.

5105740.name: Hanzi Grimoire
5105740.short_description: Hanzi Grimoire is a single-player deduction puzzle where Chinese characters become spells. Combine glyph cards, study failed rituals, and use two catalyst systems to overcome eight arcane laws. Uncover alternate characters, seven schools of magic, and more than 2,800 unique spells.

5109460.name: Desktop Ball
5109460.short_description: A little ball that lives on top of your desktop and can blow it up, zap it, flood it, haunt it, or grow a garden all over it. Fidget with it through meetings, queues and compiles, and when you're done, it gets out of the way. Seven weird balls, and every one of them beats doomscrolling.

5109550.name: ALL EYES ON ME
5109550.short_description: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play co-op locally or online, or join online conquests.

5118710.name: TapTrapGrow
5118710.short_description: Light up a pest-filled garden and turn a well-placed swat into a chain reaction. Hunt, earn gold, and unlock lasting upgrades as you discover elemental pests and take on bosses in this action-focused incremental game.

5133230.name: Can You Beat The AI God?
5133230.short_description: Can You Beat The AI God? is an action-packed bullet-heaven roguelite. Survive endless swarms of robotic enemies, unlock devastating synergies, and upgrade your abilities. Test your limits and see if you can defeat the ultimate AI God!

5135440.name: DPS: Desktop Pension Squad
5135440.short_description: A desktop idle RPG where monsters battle on their own while you work or study! Recruit a colorful cast of monsters, build your own squad, and reclaim the Dungeon Cores stolen by humans.

5155100.name: BATTLE: PARTS & POWER
5155100.short_description: Build robots, equip factories and defend your headquarters in a strategy auto-battler. Collect parts, refine your army and take on Campaign, Endless Solo, co-op Duo or a Duel with a friend.

5168130.name: Hit or Die
5168130.short_description: Four players, one table, the number 21. Draw, stand, or bluff. Whoever ends the round furthest from the target gets the mallet, the anvil, or the revolver. Cheat with scissors, dice and a syringe you keep in your own drawer. Chips are your health. Last one breathing wins.

5169470.name: Below The Blades
5169470.short_description: Climb, repair and survive Turbine 46 in a first-person horror game where every handhold matters. Survive a violent storm, manage your grip and stamina, and uncover what happened to the technician who came before you while trying not to get caught by what's crawling around the turbine.

5171580.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew
5171580.short_description: Scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear apocalypse incremental game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

5179950.name: Tick & Tired
5179950.short_description: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

5186400.name: 687 Days on Mars - First Steps
5186400.short_description: Take your first steps on Mars and face the challenge of surviving alone on the Red Planet. Build your first shelter, secure vital resources, grow food, research new technologies, and explore the hostile Martian landscape. Your survival starts here.

5195200.name: Engagement
5195200.short_description: Command a capital ship alone or up to 4 players co-op and hold the Belt of Ashes against the Hollow and more until relief arrives. Every upgrade is a turret bolted to a hardpoint you can see, your escorts you recruit keep their names and kills, and every fight has variety to make it new.

5202730.name: Nana's Game Dev Diary
5202730.short_description: Nana's Game Dev Diary is a relaxing life sim about making games. Join Nana in her cozy little home as she follows her dream, planning each day around development, learning, part-time work, and rest. Enjoy the simple pleasures of everyday life with Nana.

5203240.name: Bar Owner Simulator
5203240.short_description: Take over a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a thriving nightlife venue. Mix cocktails, serve customers, manage stock, add pool and karaoke, upgrade your bar, and handle the chaos of every busy night.

5236680.name: Fish Battle Champion
5236680.short_description: A strategic fishing roguelike autobattler with 'fish deckbuilding'. Catch bizarre fish, discover rare bonuses, collect powerful items and build unexpected synergies. Every night, send your team into the tournament and see if your strategy survives!

5251030.name: TaskBarStudio
5251030.short_description: Grow a small game studio in the corner of your desktop. Hire developers, build a team, and create and release games. Keep the game running and close the main window: development continues while you get on with other tasks. Use reviews and sales to shape your next project.

5264160.name: Bloodlines & Banners
5264160.short_description: A historical 4X where you rule a dynasty, not just an empire. 88 civilizations across ten eras of real history on a hex map of Earth. Your rulers age and die; the heir you raised inherits their traits, their rivalries, and your bloodline's standing.

5283320.name: Quarantine Zombies - Prologue 2
5283320.short_description: The prologue continues with new exclusive quests and a deadly dungeon. Survive the first 6 days in post-apocalyptic Chicago, where FPS action meets quarantine inspection. Repair your car and fight your way to the main checkpoint to save your younger brother. The army arrives in 30 days.

5286160.name: Tidyspell
5286160.short_description: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

5291620.name: Loadpath
5291620.short_description: LOADPATH is a physics-driven demolition game about finding the supports that matter. Cut through industrial structures, trigger massive collapses, recover Salvage, upgrade your demolition rig and descend deeper through seven increasingly dangerous sites.

5302890.name: Moonbased
5302890.short_description: A Top-Down Lunar Rogue Lite. Four hulls, 23 weapons, and a fusion lab that fuses any two of them into one of 422 combined turrets! Four unique worlds, four bosses, mini-bosses, scalable difficulty modifiers and one more run! How long can you survive and can you top the weekly Steam leaderboards?

5308960.name: Ace of Jianghu
5308960.short_description: Reading wuxia is one thing. Living it is another. Shaolin, Wudang, Unorthodox Alliance, Heavenly Demon Cult. Become one of four and step into a jianghu of hidden currents. You hold cards; you fight with martial arts. Your road changes who you meet and the story. In the jianghu, a man is just a card.

5318390.name: Brain Party
5318390.short_description: Brain Party is a multiplayer puzzle party game. Compete online with other players for first place by total score. Unlock higher difficulties and beat your personal bests in solo challenges, or take on fresh daily challenges and climb the global leaderboard.

5332290.name: Build Christmas
5332290.short_description: Decorate a cozy North Pole village for Christmas. String lights on rooftops, trees, bridges and trains, and fill the snow with festive decorations. Underneath runs a light production sim: keep the elf workshops making presents and get the sleighs loaded before Christmas Eve.

5341880.name: Just Farm
5341880.short_description: Farming games can be complicated. This one isn’t. No empire to manage, no endless chores, no agricultural career waiting for you. Just relax, get in the tractor, and farm.

5355450.name: FLOWFALL Inertia
5355450.short_description: One long fall through neon, music and motion. Morph your glowing shape through gates timed to an original soundtrack, choose your route where the shaft splits, and chase FLOW until the whole world lights up. Race up to three friends online, or sink into it alone.

5362770.name: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft
5362770.short_description: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft is a toilet-humour clicker set in a bubbling sewer laboratory. Click to make dookie, build ten ridiculous factories from the Whoopie Cushion to the Methane Volcano, snatch random power-ups and grow your stinkiest empire yet.

5364730.name: Apex Armada
5364730.short_description: A spaceship auto battler where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose from 16 alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

5377410.name: King Dies Rich
5377410.short_description: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

5377460.name: UPSHOT
5377460.short_description: Every hit splits them. Every split makes it worse. UPSHOT is a 1–4 player arena shooter where bouncing balls keep breaking into smaller, faster ones. Clear room after room against the clock, open mystery gift boxes and take down a giant boss every fifth room, solo or in co-op.

5378030.name: La Muraille 1806
5378030.short_description: A Napoleonic-era Roguelite Tower Defense. Lead the defense of the Wall against the hordes of the apocalypse. Command the united armies of Europe, deploy living lines of defense, map out range cards, and halt tens of thousands of enemies. Ready! Present! Fire! Commander, win humanity one more dawn.

5378110.name: One More Lawn
5378110.short_description: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

5383190.name: Car Parkour 4 Together
5383190.short_description: Team up with up to 3 players and tackle parkour courses in a town swallowed by water! Take on the Sunken Bloom and Drowned Wastes maps, overcome obstacles, create chaos with your cars, and choose between collision-free or collision-enabled gameplay with the Immunity feature!

5383300.name: Bullet Glory
5383300.short_description: A neon arena score-attack shooter. Clear bullet storms, unlock 12 ships with distinct specials, team up in local co-op, and study leaderboard replays to push your score higher.

5385160.name: Lanternborn
5385160.short_description: ▎ The city of Caldera froze one minute before midnight, and the Hollows came out of the dark. Carry the last light through ever-changing streets, light the lamps, break the Bells and decide how the longest night ends. A dark-fantasy action roguelite with a story.

5385330.name: Taise-CityVsBus
5385330.short_description: This city has been swallowed by apocalyptic chaos. The crew entered the streets before you and are still fighting. You are the bus driver. Drive through the city and rescue the scattered crew in this exhilarating apocalyptic bus action game!

5396640.name: LITTLE KNIGHT: HOMECOMING
5396640.short_description: Return home as a little knight, rescue your neighbors and rebuild your raided village. A storybook 2D action game where combos, charged strikes, rolls and parries carry you through 16 boss fights.

5400830.name: Animal Cubes: Tidy Up Dreams
5400830.short_description: A cozy organization simulator in a dream: sort 6344 cubic animals, 120 unique species onto the right shelves. Turn a chaotic dream into a perfectly organized collection.

5403780.name: Punch Riot
5403780.short_description: A first-person party brawler for up to 20 players! Punch rivals out of crumbling arenas or launch them into goals with wacky weapons. Play every mode solo against AI, or invite Steam friends. Multiplayer starts with 2 human players, with AI filling empty slots.

5404940.name: Road Riot
5404940.short_description: Vehicular combat survivor game. Dodge swarming enemies, evolve absurd weapons and smash huge bosses. Hot Mods change every drive and random modifiers make enemies unpredictable. Collect scrap, upgrade your garage, unlock new cars. Get wrecked. Come back louder.

5406570.name: Fish Market Tidy Up!
5406570.short_description: A squall has scattered the morning catch across an old harbour fish market. Put every fish back in its crate: each one you sort plays a note, every full crate sings its tune. A cozy first-person tidying game with a living hall, hidden curiosities and upgrades.

5475030.name: Wrestle Bounce Online
5475030.short_description: Hold. Release. BONK! A one-button ragdoll physics wrestling game where the first head to hit the mat loses. Duel a friend on one keyboard, beat the AI, win tournaments or take on real players online for coin prizes. Easy to learn, impossible to play without laughing.

5489480.name: JustLayIt
5489480.short_description: Just Lay It is a train survival strategy game where you lay tracks, gather resources, and fight monsters to keep a train running across the desert. Defend against waves of enemies and design efficient routes to reach your destination safely. The moment the train stops, survival ends.

5492150.name: Big Scoop: Trash Cleaning Simulator
5492150.short_description: The ocean is drowning in plastic. Steer your boat, scoop up trash, sell at port and grow from a 3.6 m Skiff to a 70 m Megascoop with over 40 boats in your fleet. Play solo or in a crew of up to 4 online, and clean it all up until the sea turns turquoise again.

5494850.name: Age of Me
5494850.short_description: An idle civilization game for desktop and mobile. From your first settlement to distant worlds, every discovery brings a new possibility. Build, research, and expand in an idle game designed for desktop and mobile, with offline production that keeps your civilization growing between visits.

5495980.name: The Traitor's Anvil
5495980.short_description: A pixel art roguelite auto battler about a framed royal blacksmith. Smelt, hammer and assemble every weapon and armor by hand, arm five heroes and a rebel squad, set their formation, then lead them across five lands to topple the usurper king. Forge all 40 legends.

5496660.name: Toll Idle
5496660.short_description: Build the busiest toll plaza on the road. Start with one cash booth and collect every fare by hand, then grow to ten lanes of automated Tollpass traffic. A relaxing idle game you can finish in about four hours, from quiet mornings to a glowing plaza at night.

5497380.name: Refund Me TD 2
5497380.short_description: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

5503160.name: TOO EZ!
5503160.short_description: An illustrated music video, and this time you play it! Aim with your mouse and click to the beat. That's it. New to rhythm games? Start with TOO EZ! You can do it. TOO EZ!

5503690.name: Dice & Fate Duel
5503690.short_description: Roll dice, build combos, and bend fate in a single-player turn-based dice-card duel. 30 cards, distinct AI opponents, and a heavy dose of RNG. Please note before buying: luck matters, the difficulty is high, and even good decisions can lose to the dice.

5509790.name: Million Blocks
5509790.short_description: Destroy exactly one million blocks in this minimalist black-and-white idle clicker. Click or automate, upgrade six endless branches, prestige, evolve, and climb the tier system

5513230.name: Puzzle Duel: Animal Gem Battle
5513230.short_description: Click gems in order to unleash skills! Puzzle Duel is a fast 1v1 battle where puzzles meet fighting games. Build your skill deck, pick a cute animal fighter, knock rivals into the air with ultimates, and climb the ranked ladder in 45-second matches.

5514080.name: Under the Aurora
5514080.short_description: A mystery quest exploring life, death, and the path to return.

5528360.name: Bings
5528360.short_description: Dive into a nostalgic notebook world in Bings. Navigate challenging physics-based puzzles and overcome obstacles in this sketch-art style precision game. Test your reflexes, time your moves perfectly, and conquer every doodle-filled level.
